title: Prevalence and associated factors of sleep quality in a middle eastern country undergoing an economic - Political unrest and war conflicts.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to quantify the prevalence of poor sleep quality and its associated factors among the general population in Lebanon, a middle-eastern country witnessing economic-political instability and a rise in the prevalence of mental health disorders.
METHODS: An online cross-sectional survey study targeting Lebanese residents 18 to 80 years old. Sleep quality was measured using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), depression the Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9), and anxiety the Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale (GAD-7). PSQI as an outcome variable compared poor to good sleep quality.
RESULTS: Data was collected from 582 participants with a mean age of 34.5 ± 14.9 years, and 63.8% females. According to the PSQI, the prevalence of poor sleep quality was estimated to be 63.6%. Binary logistic regression analysis indicated that moderate (OR = 4.69, CI = 2.33-9.41) to severe anxiety (OR = 8.75, CI = 3.44-22.26), moderate (OR = 3.56, CI = 1.60-7.97) to severe depression (OR = 3.13, CI = 1.26-7.76), diabetes (OR = 3.18, CI = 1.14-8.91) and sleep apnea (OR = 3.13, CI = 1.07-9.18) were significantly associated with a higher odds of poor sleep quality. Sociodemographic, lifestyle factors and other co-morbidities were no more significantly associated with poor sleep after adjustment in the multivariate regression analysis.
CONCLUSIONS: There is a high prevalence of poor sleep quality among our sampled population in Lebanon, and a strong correlation with poor mental health, namely symptoms of anxiety and depression. These findings may warrant strategic interventions for patient care, such as routine sleep quality screening for individuals suffering from mental health disorders as well as chronic diseases namely diabetes, in high-stress communities.

标题：中东国家经历经济政治动荡与战争冲突期间睡眠质量流行率及其相关因素
摘要：目的：本研究旨在量化黎巴嫩（一个经历经济政治不稳定和精神健康障碍患病率上升的中东国家）普通人群中睡眠质量差的流行率及其相关因素。方法：一项针对18至80岁黎巴嫩居民的在线横断面调查研究。睡眠质量采用匹兹堡睡眠质量指数（PSQI）测量，抑郁采用患者健康问卷（PHQ-9），焦虑采用广泛性焦虑障碍量表（GAD-7）。以PSQI作为结果变量，比较睡眠质量差与睡眠质量良好者。结果：共收集582名参与者的数据，平均年龄34.5±14.9岁，63.8%为女性。根据PSQI，睡眠质量差的流行率估计为63.6%。二元逻辑回归分析表明，中度（OR=4.69，CI=2.33-9.41）至重度焦虑（OR=8.75，CI=3.44-22.26）、中度（OR=3.56，CI=1.60-7.97）至重度抑郁（OR=3.13，CI=1.26-7.76）、糖尿病（OR=3.18，CI=1.14-8.91）和睡眠呼吸暂停（OR=3.13，CI=1.07-9.18）与睡眠质量差的更高几率显著相关。在多变量回归分析调整后，社会人口学因素、生活方式因素及其他合并症与睡眠质量差不再显著相关。结论：在我们抽样的黎巴嫩人群中，睡眠质量差的流行率很高，且与不良心理健康（即焦虑和抑郁症状）密切相关。这些发现可能提示在高压力社区中需要采取战略性患者护理干预，例如对患有精神健康障碍及慢性疾病（即糖尿病）的个体进行常规睡眠质量筛查。
关键词：睡眠质量；心理健康；焦虑；抑郁；黎巴嫩

title: Engagement with WeChat-Based Remote Psychological Counseling and Patient-Reported Outcomes After Uterine Artery Embolization in China: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Psychological symptoms and impaired quality of life may persist after uterine artery embolization (UAE), while sustained in-person support can be difficult to access. We examined whether self-selected engagement with a WeChat-based counseling program was associated with patient-reported outcomes after UAE.
METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included 267 women who underwent UAE for uterine fibroids in China and selected WeChat follow-up. Engagement was classified by the 12-month mean completion percentage across individual counseling, educational messages, and professionally moderated support groups: low (<50%), medium (50-79%), or high (≥80%). The primary outcome was WHOQOL-BREF quality of life at 12 months; PHQ-9 depression, GAD-7 anxiety, and PSQI sleep scores were secondary outcomes. Mixed-effects models evaluated longitudinal associations.
RESULTS: At 12 months, mean WHOQOL-BREF scores were 74.2, 78.4, and 74.9 in the low-, medium-, and high-engagement groups. The adjusted medium-versus-low difference in change from baseline was 3.98 points (95% CI 3.39-4.57), within the 3-5-point clinical-importance range. PHQ-9 differences in change were statistically significant but smaller than the 5-point minimum clinically important difference. PSQI change did not differ significantly between groups.
CONCLUSION: Within a self-selected WeChat cohort, engagement level was associated with change in quality of life, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, but not sleep quality. Selection bias, reverse causation, residual confounding, and the absence of a non-WeChat comparator preclude causal or dosing conclusions. Prospective trials should test individualized intervention intensity and clinical benefit.

标题：基于微信的远程心理咨询参与度与中国子宫动脉栓塞术后患者报告结局的关系：一项回顾性队列研究
摘要：背景：子宫动脉栓塞术（UAE）后可能持续存在心理症状和生活质量受损，而持续的线下支持难以获得。本研究考察了自我选择的微信心理咨询项目参与度是否与UAE术后患者报告结局相关。方法：这项单中心回顾性队列纳入了267名因子宫肌瘤接受UAE并选择微信随访的中国女性。参与度根据12个月内个体咨询、教育信息和专业主持的支持小组的平均完成百分比分为三组：低（<50%）、中（50-79%）、高（≥80%）。主要结局为12个月时的WHOQOL-BREF生活质量评分；次要结局包括PHQ-9抑郁、GAD-7焦虑和PSQI睡眠评分。采用混合效应模型评估纵向关联。结果：12个月时，低、中、高参与组的WHOQOL-BREF平均得分分别为74.2、78.4和74.9。调整后中-低组自基线的变化差值为3.98分（95% CI 3.39-4.57），处于3-5分的临床重要差异范围内。PHQ-9的变化差异具有统计学显著性，但小于5分的最小临床重要差异。PSQI变化在组间无显著差异。结论：在自我选择的微信队列中，参与度与生活质量、抑郁症状和焦虑症状的变化相关，但与睡眠质量无关。选择偏倚、反向因果、残余混杂以及缺乏非微信对照组限制了对因果或剂量效应的结论。未来前瞻性试验应检验个体化干预强度及其临床获益。
关键词：微信远程心理咨询；参与度；子宫动脉栓塞术；患者报告结局；数字心理干预

title: Changes in Mental Health Networks Among High-Risk Suicide Groups in Korea Before and After the COVID-19 Pandemic.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Suicide remains a critical global public health issue, and the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic has intensified mental health challenges, potentially increasing suicide risk. This study aimed to analyze the changes in mental health networks of high-risk suicide groups in Korea before and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
METHODS: Using data from the Korean Cohort for the Model Predicting Suicide and Suicide-Related Behavior, we analyzed 1,179 participants, including individuals with recent suicide attempts and those experiencing suicidal ideation. Network analysis was conducted using EBICglasso algorithms separately for men and women before and after the COVID-19 pandemic, to examine the relationships between key mental health variables including depression (Patient Health Questionnaire-9), anxiety (Beck Anxiety Inventory), stress (Stress Questionnaire for Korean National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey-Short Form), impulsivity (Barratt Impulsiveness Scale-11), and suicidal ideation (Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale).
RESULTS: After the pandemic, significant increases in the severity and intensity of suicidal ideation were observed in both sexes (P < 0.001). Overall network connectivity decreased, while strong interconnections between depression, anxiety, and stress persisted in both sexes. After the pandemic, betweenness centrality increased for anxiety in women and depression in men. The bootstrapped edge-weighted confidence intervals mostly remained within acceptable thresholds (< 0.2), ensuring network reliability.
CONCLUSION: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to structural changes in the mental health network of high-risk suicide groups, with anxiety emerging as a more central factor in women and depression in men, highlighting them as key intervention targets. These findings underscore the need for tailored mental health strategies to mitigate suicide risk in populations affected by the pandemic.

标题：COVID-19疫情前后韩国高危自杀群体心理健康网络的变化
摘要：背景：自杀仍然是一个关键的全球公共卫生问题，而2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）疫情加剧了心理健康挑战，可能增加自杀风险。本研究旨在分析COVID-19疫情前后韩国高危自杀群体心理健康网络的变化。方法：利用韩国自杀及自杀相关行为预测模型队列的数据，我们分析了1179名参与者，包括近期有自杀未遂经历者和存在自杀意念者。采用EBICglasso算法分别对男性和女性在COVID-19疫情前后的数据进行网络分析，以考察抑郁（患者健康问卷-9）、焦虑（贝克焦虑量表）、压力（韩国国民健康营养调查简式压力问卷）、冲动性（巴瑞特冲动性量表-11）和自杀意念（哥伦比亚自杀严重度评定量表）等关键心理健康变量之间的关系。结果：疫情后，两性自杀意念的严重程度和强度均显著增加（P < 0.001）。整体网络连通性下降，而两性中抑郁、焦虑和压力之间的强关联仍然存在。疫情后，女性的焦虑和男性的抑郁在介数中心性方面均有增加。自举边权重置信区间大多保持在可接受阈值内（< 0.2），确保网络可靠性。结论：COVID-19疫情导致高危自杀群体心理健康网络发生结构性变化，焦虑在女性中成为更核心的因素，而抑郁在男性中更为核心，凸显了它们作为关键干预靶点的地位。这些发现强调需要针对性的心理健康策略，以减轻受疫情影响人群的自杀风险。
关键词：心理健康网络；自杀风险；COVID-19；网络分析；抑郁与焦虑

title: Baseline prediction of two-year prevention and remission of anxiety, depression, and eating disorders in college students receiving a digital guided self-help intervention: derivation and external validation of a machine learning algorithm across 26 population-based cohorts.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: We examined whether machine learning identified baseline variables that predicted two-year prevention and remission from anxiety, depression, and eating disorders following digital cognitive-behavioral therapy guided self-help (D-CBTgsh).
METHODS: Undergraduates at risk for or meeting criteria for anxiety, depression, and eating disorders who were randomized to population-based screening and D-CBTgsh were examined. A five-step hybrid feature selection strategy reduced 863 baseline questionnaire items to 37 spanning demographics, mental health problems, treatment motivation, and treatment targets. Five supervised machine learning algorithms were trained and tested using nested cross-validation among students from 13 U.S. colleges (n = 1472) to discriminate who did versus did not achieve two-year prevention and remission of all anxiety, depression, and eating disorders. External validation was conducted in a separate set of 13 U.S. colleges (n = 823).
RESULTS: When externally validated, random forest outperformed all models in discriminative power, calibration, and clinical utility. Predictors of no disorders at two years included lower levels of behavioral avoidance, generalized anxiety interference, social fear, social anxiety interference, depressed mood, fear of observation, number of worry topics, perseverative thinking, and binge eating, along with higher feelings of calm/peacefulness, perceived need for treatment, and intention to seek help. Demographic predictors of no disorders were being male at birth, fewer financial difficulties, and a lower current body mass index.
CONCLUSION: This predictive algorithm, using 37 single items, developed a scalable self-report measure that could be readily adopted by college campuses to help optimize and scale service delivery across campuses.

标题：基于基线特征预测大学生接受数字化 guided self-help 干预后两年焦虑、抑郁及进食障碍的预防与缓解：跨26个人群队列的机器学习算法推导与外部验证
摘要：引言：我们考察了机器学习是否能识别基线变量，以预测大学生在接受数字化认知行为疗法引导式自助干预（D-CBTgsh）后两年内焦虑、抑郁及进食障碍的预防与缓解情况。方法：研究对象为存在焦虑、抑郁及进食障碍风险或符合诊断标准的大学生，他们被随机分配至人群筛查及D-CBTgsh组。采用五步混合特征选择策略，将863个基线问卷条目缩减为37个，涵盖人口学特征、心理健康问题、治疗动机和治疗靶标。基于美国13所高校的学生（n=1472），使用嵌套交叉验证训练并测试五种监督式机器学习算法，以区分是否能在两年内实现所有焦虑、抑郁及进食障碍的预防与缓解。在另外13所美国高校（n=823）中进行外部验证。结果：在外部验证中，随机森林在判别力、校准度和临床实用性方面优于所有模型。两年后无任何障碍的预测因素包括：较低的行为回避、广泛性焦虑干扰、社交恐惧、社交焦虑干扰、抑郁情绪、被观察恐惧、担忧主题数量、持续性思维及暴食水平，以及较高的平静/平和感、感知治疗需求和求助意向。人口学预测因素包括出生时为男性、较少的经济困难和较低的当前体质指数。结论：该预测算法使用37个单项条目，开发出可扩展的自评测量工具，高校可便捷采用，以帮助优化和扩大校园心理服务的传递。
关键词：机器学习；数字化干预；心理健康；预测模型；大学生

title: Expected breathlessness is overestimated compared to experienced: a mobile ecological momentary assessment study.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Chronic breathlessness is common and often leads to avoidance of symptom-provoking activities. Expectations of breathlessness influence behaviour and symptom perception, but the accuracy of these expectations remains unclear. The aim of this study was to examine the relationship between expected and experienced breathlessness, the moderating role of mental states, determinants of expectation accuracy and the influence of recent symptoms on future expectations.
METHODS: In this longitudinal study, 83 participants with chronic breathlessness rated expected and experienced breathlessness (on 0-10 numerical rating scales (NRS)) using a mobile ecological momentary assessment app over 7 days. Associations were analysed using linear and mixed regression models.
RESULTS: Expected breathlessness was significantly associated with subsequently experienced breathlessness (β=0.51, 95% CI 0.35-0.68) but was systematically overestimated (mean±sd expected 4.7±1.9 versus experienced 2.9±1.7; mean absolute difference 2.0±1.5). Depressive symptoms attenuated the association (β=0.40, 95% CI 0.23-0.58), whereas anxiety, wellbeing and self-efficacy were not associated with either the strength or the accuracy of expectations. Expected breathlessness for the upcoming week was strongly related to the experience during the study week (β=0.85, 95% CI 0.61-1.08, R2=0.48), suggesting recent experience shapes expectations more than expectations predict future breathlessness.
CONCLUSION: Individuals with chronic breathlessness overestimated future breathlessness by a mean of 2 NRS points. Indication of depressive symptoms influenced the strength of the association, but accuracy appears unaffected by mental state indicators. These findings highlight the need to address and recalibrate symptom expectations in clinical care.

标题：预期的呼吸困难被高估：一项移动生态瞬时评估研究
摘要：背景与目的：慢性呼吸困难常见且常导致患者回避诱发症状的活动。对呼吸困难的预期影响行为与症状感知，但这些预期的准确性尚不明确。本研究旨在检验预期与经历呼吸困难之间的关系、心理状态的调节作用、预期准确性的决定因素以及近期症状对未来预期的影响。方法：本纵向研究纳入83名慢性呼吸困难患者，使用移动生态瞬时评估应用程序在7天内对预期和经历的呼吸困难进行评分（0-10数字评定量表）。采用线性回归和混合回归模型分析关联。结果：预期呼吸困难与随后经历的呼吸困难显著相关（β=0.51，95% CI 0.35-0.68），但被系统性高估（预期均值±标准差4.7±1.9 vs 经历2.9±1.7；平均绝对差异2.0±1.5）。抑郁症状削弱了该关联（β=0.40，95% CI 0.23-0.58），而焦虑、幸福感和自我效能感与预期的强度或准确性均无关联。对接下来一周的预期呼吸困难与研究周内经历密切相关（β=0.85，95% CI 0.61-1.08，R²=0.48），提示近期经历对预期的塑造作用大于预期对未来呼吸困难的预测作用。结论：慢性呼吸困难患者平均将未来呼吸困难高估2个NRS分值。抑郁症状指征影响关联强度，但准确性似乎不受心理状态指标影响。这些发现强调了临床护理中处理和重新校准症状预期的必要性。
关键词：生态瞬时评估；呼吸困难；症状预期；心理状态；纵向测量

title: Digital Walls or Digital Bridges? Telehealth for Mental Health Equity Among Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: The expansion of telehealth in mental health nursing raises questions about reducing or exacerbating health inequities. For Palestinians living in the West Bank and Gaza facing movement restrictions, infrastructure fragmentation, and chronic trauma, this question is pressing. This conceptual discussion paper critically examines whether telehealth is a "digital wall" reinforcing barriers or a "digital bridge" expanding equitable access.
METHODS: This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed literature and United Nations reports. Literature was purposively selected based on conceptual relevance to digital equity, conflict-affected settings, and psychiatric mental health (PMH) nursing, including literature specifically addressing the role of PMH nurses (PMHNs) in conflict zones. The Digital Health Equity Framework guides the thematic analysis organized around infrastructure, affordability, privacy, cultural appropriateness, and community resilience. This is not a systematic review.
RESULTS: Available evidence suggests telehealth may function as a barrier or facilitator depending on context. Infrastructure, economic, privacy, and cultural barriers risk making telehealth exclusionary. Conversely, telehealth may bridge access by reducing travel through checkpoints and enabling continuity during military escalations. The critical and underrecognized barrier of inadequate training in telemedicine practice threatens adoption across all provider levels in Palestine. PMHNs occupy a critical mediating role.
CONCLUSIONS: Telehealth is neither inherently equitable nor inequitable. PMHNs should assess digital access as a social determinant, offer low-bandwidth alternatives, and advocate for structural investments. Capacity building to address the training gap is essential for telehealth integration. Telehealth equity in conflict-affected settings depends less on technology than on whether systems are designed around patients' actual conditions and community resilience.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：数字之墙还是数字之桥？约旦河西岸和加沙巴勒斯坦人心理健康公平性的远程医疗
摘要：目的：远程医疗在心理健康护理领域的扩展引发了关于其是否减少或加剧健康不公平性的疑问。对于生活在约旦河西岸和加沙、面临行动限制、基础设施碎片化和长期创伤的巴勒斯坦人而言，这一问题尤为紧迫。本文作为概念性讨论论文，批判性地审视远程医疗究竟是强化障碍的“数字之墙”，还是扩大公平可及性的“数字之桥”。方法：本文综合同行评审文献和联合国报告。文献基于与数字公平、冲突影响环境及精神心理健康护理的概念相关性进行有目的性筛选，包括专门探讨精神心理健康护士在冲突地区作用的文献。以数字健康公平框架为指导，围绕基础设施、可负担性、隐私、文化适宜性和社区韧性进行主题分析。本文非系统综述。结果：现有证据表明，远程医疗的功能取决于具体情境，既可能成为障碍也可能成为促进因素。基础设施、经济、隐私和文化方面的障碍可能导致远程医疗具有排斥性。相反，远程医疗可通过减少检查站通行需求、在军事升级期间维持服务连续性来弥合可及性差距。巴勒斯坦各级服务提供者中远程医疗实践培训不足这一关键且被低估的障碍，威胁着远程医疗的采纳。精神心理健康护士发挥着关键的桥梁作用。结论：远程医疗本身既非固有公平也非固有失公平。精神心理健康护士应将数字可及性视为社会决定因素，提供低带宽替代方案，并倡导结构性投资。能力建设以解决培训缺口对远程医疗整合至关重要。在冲突影响环境中，远程医疗公平性更多取决于系统是否围绕患者的实际状况和社区韧性进行设计，而非技术本身。
关键词：远程医疗；心理健康公平；冲突环境；数字健康公平；精神心理健康护理

title: The Effects of Non-Pharmacological Interventions on Depression Among Community-Dwelling Individuals With Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
summary:
AIMS AND OBJECTIVES: To compare and rank the effectiveness of various non-pharmacological interventions on depression for community-dwelling individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI).
BACKGROUND: Depression is a significant and persistent mental health problem among community-dwelling individuals with SCI. There is increasing evidence that non-pharmacological interventions are safe and effective for alleviating depression. However, the efficacy and comparative effectiveness of various non-pharmacological interventions for community-dwelling individuals with SCI remain unclear.
DESIGN: Systematic review and network meta-analysis (NMA) according to PRISMA-NMA guidance.
METHODS: We included randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of community-dwelling individuals with SCI comparing non-pharmacological interventions versus usual care/waiting list and reporting depressive symptoms using validated scales. China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, Chinese Biomedical Literature Database, China Science and Technology Journal Database, the Cochrane Library, PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, ProQuest and Scopus were systematically retrieved. Pairwise meta-analyses were performed using Review Manager 5.4.1, and the network meta-analysis was conducted using Stata 15.1.
RESULTS: Thirty-two RCTs involving 2200 participants were identified from database inception to May 2026. Compared with the control group, combination therapy (SMD = -0.86, 95% CI: -1.46 to -0.27), exercise therapy (SMD = -0.66, 95% CI: -1.16 to -0.15), psychological interventions (SMD = -0.41, 95% CI: -0.70 to -0.13) and self-management education (SMD = -0.33, 95% CI: -0.61 to -0.05) showed statistically significant effects, whereas vocational rehabilitation was not (SMD = -0.03, 95% CI: -1.00 to 0.95). Combination therapy had the highest SUCRA (89.1%, mean rank = 1.5), followed by exercise therapy (76.9%, mean rank = 2.2), psychological interventions (55.5%, mean rank = 3.2), self-management education (44.0%, mean rank = 3.8) and vocational rehabilitation (24.7%, mean rank = 4.8).
CONCLUSION: Combination therapy had the highest ranking probability. However, all comparisons were rated as very low certainty according to CINeMA. The findings should be interpreted with caution.
RELEVANCE TO CLINICAL PRACTICE: Community nurses may consider integrating exercise, self-management education and brief psychological support into individualized depression management for individuals with SCI. Support should be tailored according to depressive symptom severity, functional status, secondary complications, patient preferences, safety considerations and available community resources. Nurse-led or nurse-coordinated care may include depressive symptom screening, exercise planning, self-management coaching, motivational interviewing, scheduled follow-up and referral to mental health professionals when indicated.

标题：非药物干预对社区脊髓损伤患者抑郁症状的影响：一项系统评价与网络荟萃分析
摘要：目的与目标：比较并排序各类非药物干预对社区脊髓损伤（SCI）患者抑郁症状的疗效。背景：抑郁是社区SCI患者中显著且持续的心理健康问题。越来越多证据表明，非药物干预对缓解抑郁安全有效，但各类非药物干预对社区SCI患者的疗效及相对优劣尚不明确。设计：遵循PRISMA-NMA指南的系统评价与网络荟萃分析（NMA）。方法：纳入针对社区SCI患者的随机对照试验（RCT），比较非药物干预与常规照护/等待名单，并使用经验证量表报告抑郁症状。系统检索了中国知网、万方数据、中国生物医学文献数据库、中国科技期刊数据库、Cochrane图书馆、PubMed、Web of Science、Embase、ProQuest及Scopus。使用Review Manager 5.4.1进行成对荟萃分析，使用Stata 15.1进行网络荟萃分析。结果：从建库至2026年5月共纳入32项RCT，涉及2200名参与者。与对照组相比，联合治疗（SMD=-0.86，95% CI：-1.46至-0.27）、运动疗法（SMD=-0.66，95% CI：-1.16至-0.15）、心理干预（SMD=-0.41，95% CI：-0.70至-0.13）和自我管理教育（SMD=-0.33，95% CI：-0.61至-0.05）均显示出统计学显著效应，而职业康复未达显著（SMD=-0.03，95% CI：-1.00至0.95）。联合治疗的SUCRA最高（89.1%，平均秩次=1.5），其次为运动疗法（76.9%，平均秩次=2.2）、心理干预（55.5%，平均秩次=3.2）、自我管理教育（44.0%，平均秩次=3.8）和职业康复（24.7%，平均秩次=4.8）。结论：联合治疗具有最高的排序概率。然而，根据CINeMA，所有比较均被评定为极低确定性。研究结果应谨慎解读。临床实践相关性：社区护士可考虑将运动、自我管理教育和简短心理支持整合到SCI患者的个体化抑郁管理中。支持应根据抑郁症状严重程度、功能状态、继发并发症、患者偏好、安全性考量及可用社区资源进行个体化调整。护士主导或护士协调的照护可包括抑郁症状筛查、运动计划制定、自我管理辅导、动机性访谈、定期随访及必要时转介心理健康专业人员。试验注册：PROSPERO：CRD42022342155。
关键词：脊髓损伤；抑郁；非药物干预；网络荟萃分析；社区护理

title: Understanding local perspectives on child mental health to strengthen school-based interventions in Darjeeling, India.
summary: BackgroundChild mental health needs in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) often go unmet due to a scarcity of specialists. In Darjeeling, West Bengal, India, Tealeaf (Teachers Leading the Frontlines), a task-shifting model in which teachers serve as lay counselors, has shown early promise. We explored stakeholders' culturally held beliefs about causes of child mental health concerns to contextualize Tealeaf's ongoing trial.MethodsWe conducted twelve semi-structured interviews (March-April 2022) with purposively selected principals, teachers, and caregivers. Using qualitative description, transcripts underwent deductive content analysis with codes mapped to the Culturally-Infused Engagement (CIE) model; analyses focused on perceived causes of child mental health concerns.ResultsParticipants attributed children's difficulties to biological factors and the home environment, noting that parenting guidance and peer influences could shape divergent outcomes across children. Younger children were perceived to experience stress and sadness related to academics. Stakeholders described children's emotional awareness and expressive ability as still developing, influencing expectations for classroom support.ConclusionsUnderstanding communities' culturally held beliefs is foundational to interpreting Tealeaf's effects and adapting school-based supports. Findings clarify contextual mechanisms and leverage points for a task-shifted system of care, informing how Tealeaf can engage sustainably with Darjeeling's cultural context and similar LMIC settings.

标题：理解印度大吉岭地区儿童心理健康的本地视角以强化学校干预
摘要：背景：在中低收入国家，儿童心理健康需求常因专科资源匮乏而得不到满足。在印度西孟加拉邦的大吉岭地区，Tealeaf项目（教师引领前线）——一种教师担任非专业咨询师的任务转移模式——已展现出初步成效。本研究探讨了利益相关者关于儿童心理健康问题成因的文化信念，以情境化Tealeaf正在进行的试验。方法：我们于2022年3月至4月对目的性选样的校长、教师和照护者进行了十二次半结构化访谈。采用定性描述方法，将转录文本进行演绎内容分析，编码映射至文化融入参与模型，分析重点聚焦于儿童心理健康问题的感知成因。结果：参与者将儿童困难归因于生物学因素和家庭环境，并指出养育指导和同伴影响可导致儿童间不同发展结果。年幼儿童被认为会经历与学业相关的压力和悲伤。利益相关者描述儿童的情绪觉察和表达能力仍在发展中，这影响了他们对课堂支持的期望。结论：理解社区的文化信念是诠释Tealeaf效果和调整学校支持的基础。研究发现阐明了任务转移照护系统的情境机制和杠杆点，为Tealeaf与大吉岭文化背景及类似中低收入环境可持续互动提供了依据。
关键词：儿童心理健康；学校干预；任务转移；文化信念；中低收入国家

title: Social media engagement, weight perception, and mental distress in Canadian emerging adults: A cross-sectional study.
summary: Objective: To examine whether social media (SM) moderates the association between weight perception and mental distress among emerging adults. Participants: University students aged 18-25. Methods: A cross-sectional survey assessing depressive and anxiety symptoms, SM engagement, weight perception, and sociodemographic characteristics. Ordinal logistic regression models were fitted while accounting for the false discovery rate. Results: Lower SM engagement was associated with lower odds of severe depressive and anxiety symptoms, with stronger associations observed for depression. Perceiving oneself as overweight, relative to normal, was associated with more severe depressive symptoms. No moderating effect of SM engagement was detected. Self-identified disability status and perceived financial stress demonstrated the strongest associations with mental distress. Conclusions: SM engagement and weight perception were independently associated with mental distress, but subjective structural stressors (i.e., self-identified disability and perceived financial stress), showed stronger associations, highlighting the importance of considering contextual factors in emerging adult mental health.

标题：加拿大新兴成人社交媒体参与、体重感知与心理困扰：一项横断面研究
摘要：目的：考察社交媒体是否调节新兴成人中体重感知与心理困扰之间的关联。研究对象：18-25岁的大学生。方法：采用横断面调查评估抑郁和焦虑症状、社交媒体参与、体重感知及社会人口学特征。拟合有序逻辑回归模型并控制错误发现率。结果：较低的社交媒体参与与重度抑郁和焦虑症状的较低几率相关，其中对抑郁的关联更强。与自认为正常体重相比，自认为超重与更严重的抑郁症状相关。未检测到社交媒体参与的调节效应。自报残疾状况和感知经济压力与心理困扰的关联最强。结论：社交媒体参与和体重感知与心理困扰独立相关，但主观结构性压力源（即自报残疾和感知经济压力）显示出更强的关联，凸显了在新兴成人心理健康中考虑情境因素的重要性。

title: Effectiveness of an interactive music tablet intervention to reduce procedural anxiety in children: a randomized controlled trial.
summary: Procedural anxiety in children is common and associated with maladaptive behavior, reduced cooperation, and increased perioperative stress. Although music-based interventions show promise, few are designed for routine clinical care. We evaluated an interactive tablet-based music intervention ("MuMa") for reducing procedural anxiety in children aged 3-11 undergoing elective surgery. We conducted a single-center, parallel-group, randomized controlled trial including 80 children undergoing elective surgery and their caregivers. Participants were randomized to receive the MuMa intervention preoperatively or standard care. Primary outcomes were child (modified Yale Preoperative Anxiety Scale) and caregiver anxiety (State-Trait Anxiety Inventory), assessed before and after the intervention. Secondary outcomes included heart rate variability, compliance during anesthesia induction, postoperative agitation, and behavioral changes at 1, 4, and 12 weeks post-procedure. Trial registration: German Clinical Trials Registry (DRKS00027873), registered 13 May 2022. Here we show that the intervention reduces preoperative anxiety by 38% (standardized mean difference -0.8; 95% CI -1.2 to -0.3) and integrates readily into routine perioperative workflows. Effects are greatest in children with high baseline anxiety (SMD -1.7; 95% CI -2.8 to -0.5) and in those aged 3-6 years (SMD -0.9; 95% CI -1.5 to -0.3). No clinically relevant differences are observed for secondary outcomes. This interactive music intervention significantly reduces procedural anxiety in children, particularly among younger participants and those with high baseline anxiety. Its low resource requirements and ease of implementation support its potential as a scalable non-pharmacological strategy in pediatric perioperative care. Further research should evaluate its generalizability across diverse settings.

标题：交互式音乐平板干预减少儿童程序性焦虑的有效性：一项随机对照试验
摘要：儿童程序性焦虑较为常见，与适应不良行为、合作度降低及围手术期应激增加相关。尽管音乐类干预显示出一定前景，但少有专为常规临床护理设计的方案。我们评估了一种基于平板的交互式音乐干预（“MuMa”）对3-11岁接受择期手术儿童程序性焦虑的缓解效果。我们开展了一项单中心、平行组、随机对照试验，纳入80名接受择期手术的儿童及其照护者。参与者被随机分配接受术前MuMa干预或常规护理。主要结局为干预前后评估的儿童焦虑（改良耶鲁术前焦虑量表）和照护者焦虑（状态-特质焦虑量表）。次要结局包括心率变异性、麻醉诱导期依从性、术后躁动及术后1、4、12周的行为变化。试验注册：德国临床试验注册库（DRKS00027873），注册日期为2022年5月13日。研究结果显示，该干预使术前焦虑降低38%（标准化均数差-0.8；95% CI -1.2至-0.3），并能轻松融入常规围手术期工作流程。干预效果在基线焦虑水平较高的儿童（SMD -1.7；95% CI -2.8至-0.5）及3-6岁儿童（SMD -0.9；95% CI -1.5至-0.3）中最为显著。次要结局未观察到具有临床意义的差异。该交互式音乐干预可显著降低儿童程序性焦虑，尤其对年龄较小及基线焦虑水平较高的儿童效果更佳。其资源需求低、易于实施的特点支持其作为儿科围手术期护理中可推广的非药物策略的潜力。未来研究应评估其在多样化场景中的可推广性。
关键词：程序性焦虑；交互式音乐干预；儿童；随机对照试验；围手术期护理

title: Day-level associations of nicotine and cannabis vaping and co-vaping with sleep duration and quality among young adults: A smartphone-based daily diary study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Nicotine and cannabis vaping are increasingly prevalent among young adults, and aiding sleep is a common reason for cannabis use. This study examined relationships between daily nicotine/cannabis vaping patterns and sleep.
METHODS: From 2023 to 2024, 111 California young adults (aged 18-29; mean age = 23.9±3.0; 64% female; 31.5% non-Hispanic White) who vaped nicotine/cannabis ≥20 days/month completed 30 consecutive days of smartphone-based surveys. Self-reported sleep outcomes included 1) sleep duration (inadequate <7 versus adequate ≥7 hours) and 2) sleep quality (0=terrible to 10=excellent). Daily vaping patterns were non-vaping, nicotine-only vaping, cannabis-only vaping, or same-day co-vaping. Generalized mixed-effects models examined day-level associations between vaping patterns and sleep that night, adjusting for other substance use and baseline covariates.
RESULTS: Of 2147 daily assessments, 51.7% reported inadequate sleep; mean sleep quality was 6.1±2.1. Nicotine-only vaping was most frequently reported (42.5% of the days), followed by same-day co-vaping (32.1%), non-vaping (16.1%), and cannabis-only vaping (9.3%). Nicotine-only vaping days had greater odds of inadequate sleep versus non-vaping (OR=1.40, 95%CI: 1.01-1.94) and versus cannabis-only days (1.93 [1.31-2.85]). Days with same-day co-vaping had greater odds of inadequate sleep compared with cannabis-only vaping (1.50 [1.01-2.23]). Associations between sleep quality and daily vaping patterns were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: Nicotine vaping was associated with inadequate sleep duration compared to non-vaping or cannabis-only vaping. Despite perceptions of cannabis as a sleep aid, cannabis vaping did not improve sleep quality compared to non-vaping. These findings highlight the need for educational efforts or interventions addressing sleep health among young adults who vape nicotine and/or cannabis.

标题：年轻人尼古丁与大麻电子烟及共同使用与睡眠时长和质量的日间关联：一项基于智能手机的每日日记研究
摘要：目的：尼古丁和大麻电子烟在年轻人中日益普遍，而助眠是使用大麻的常见原因。本研究考察了每日尼古丁/大麻电子烟使用模式与睡眠之间的关系。方法：2023至2024年间，111名加州年轻人（年龄18-29岁；平均年龄23.9±3.0岁；64%为女性；31.5%为非西班牙裔白人）每月电子烟使用尼古丁/大麻≥20天，完成了连续30天的智能手机调查。自我报告的睡眠结局包括：1）睡眠时长（不足<7小时 vs 充足≥7小时）和2）睡眠质量（0=极差至10=极好）。每日电子烟使用模式分为：未使用、仅尼古丁、仅大麻、同日共同使用。采用广义混合效应模型检验电子烟使用模式与当晚睡眠之间的日间关联，并调整其他物质使用和基线协变量。结果：在2147次每日评估中，51.7%报告睡眠不足；平均睡眠质量为6.1±2.1。仅尼古丁电子烟使用报告频率最高（占42.5%的天数），其次为同日共同使用（32.1%）、未使用（16.1%）和仅大麻电子烟（9.3%）。与未使用日相比，仅尼古丁电子烟使用日睡眠不足的几率更高（OR=1.40，95%CI：1.01-1.94），与仅大麻日相比亦更高（1.93 [1.31-2.85]）。同日共同使用日与仅大麻电子烟使用日相比，睡眠不足的几率更高（1.50 [1.01-2.23]）。睡眠质量与每日电子烟使用模式之间的关联未达到统计显著性。结论：与未使用或仅大麻电子烟相比，尼古丁电子烟使用与睡眠时长不足相关。尽管大麻被视为助眠物质，但与未使用相比，大麻电子烟并未改善睡眠质量。这些发现凸显了对电子烟使用尼古丁和/或大麻的年轻人开展睡眠健康教育或干预的必要性。
关键词：电子烟；睡眠时长；睡眠质量；每日日记；年轻人

title: MELODY trial: study protocol for a 12-week randomised controlled trial of adjunctive melatonin, digital cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia or pill placebo to improve depressive symptoms in young adults with mood disorders.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Sleep and circadian rhythm disturbances are proposed to be pathophysiological mechanisms underlying some cases of depressive and bipolar (mood) disorders. An unresolved clinical question is whether sleep and circadian-based therapies are effective antidepressants for young adults (18-30 years) with a mood disorder.
METHOD AND ANALYSIS: MELODY (Melatonin for Depression in Youth) is an investigator-initiated, single-centre, phase 3, randomised controlled trial with two blinded pharmacological arms (melatonin vs placebo) and one open-label digital intervention arm (digital cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (dCBT-I)). The trial is testing whether 12 weeks of adjunctive melatonin or dCBT-I are more effective than pill placebo at reducing depressive symptoms in 660 young people aged 18-30 years with a Structured Clinical Interview for (Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, fifth edition; SCID-5) diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder or Bipolar Disorder type II, moderate to severe depressive symptoms and significant sleep or sleep-wake complaints. The week 12 primary outcome is depressive symptoms (Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology, Adolescent version). Secondary outcomes include partial remission of the Major Depressive Episode (SCID-5) and change in other mental health symptoms, sleep, functioning or quality of life. A subset of participants will undergo in-home assessment of sleep physiology (Sleep Profiler) and in-lab assessment of circadian rhythms (dim-light melatonin onset) to examine biological changes. A 6-month follow-up will explore durability of treatment effects. Mediation analyses will test whether sleep or circadian rhythm changes play a causal role in antidepressant effects.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: MELODY has been reviewed and approved by the Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) of the Sydney Local Health District (HREC Approval Number: X23-0450, Protocol version: 1.4, 7/7/25). The findings of the MELODY trial will be disseminated into the scientific and clinical communities via refereed publications, talks and other professional and media outlets. The Brain and Mind Centre's Lived Experience Working Group will contribute to dissemination of MELODY's findings via youth-friendly methods (eg, social media videos, explainers).

translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：[心理健康与数字心理干预]
优先级：常规收录
标题：MELODY试验：一项为期12周的随机对照试验研究方案——评估褪黑素辅助治疗、数字认知行为疗法治疗失眠或安慰剂对青年情感障碍患者抑郁症状的改善效果
摘要：目的：睡眠与昼夜节律紊乱被认为是部分抑郁障碍和双相情感障碍（情感障碍）病例的病理生理机制。一个尚未解决的临床问题是，基于睡眠和昼夜节律的治疗是否能有效抗抑郁，针对年龄18-30岁患有情感障碍的年轻人。
方法与分析：MELODY（青年抑郁症褪黑素治疗）是一项由研究者发起的单中心3期随机对照试验，包含两个盲法药物组（褪黑素组与安慰剂组）和一个开放标签的数字干预组（数字认知行为疗法治疗失眠，dCBT-I）。该试验旨在检验为期12周的辅助褪黑素或dCBT-I治疗是否在减轻660名年龄18-30岁、经《精神障碍诊断与统计手册第五版》（DSM-5）结构化临床访谈（SCID-5）确诊为重度抑郁障碍或II型双相情感障碍、存在中重度抑郁症状及显著睡眠或睡眠-觉醒问题的年轻人的抑郁症状方面优于口服安慰剂。第12周的主要结局指标为抑郁症状（青少年版抑郁症状快速自评量表）。次要结局指标包括重度抑郁发作的部分缓解（SCID-5）以及其他心理健康症状、睡眠、功能或生活质量的变化。部分参与者将接受居家睡眠生理评估（Sleep Profiler）和实验室昼夜节律评估（暗光褪黑素起始时间），以考察生物学变化。为期6个月的随访将探索治疗效果的持久性。中介分析将检验睡眠或昼夜节律变化是否在抗抑郁效应中发挥因果作用。
伦理与传播：MELODY试验已经悉尼地方卫生区人类研究伦理委员会（HREC）审查并批准（HREC批准号：X23-0450，方案版本：1.4，日期：2025年7月7日）。MELODY试验的研究结果将通过同行评审出版物、学术报告及其他专业和媒体渠道向科学界和临床社区传播。大脑与心智中心的生活经验工作组将通过面向青年的方式（如社交媒体视频、科普解说）参与MELODY研究结果的传播。
试验注册号：ACTRN12624000017527
关键词：数字认知行为疗法；褪黑素；抑郁症状；情感障碍；随机对照试验

title: Dissociation as a marker of emotion dysregulation: An examination in adolescent psychiatric inpatients using ecological momentary assessment.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Dissociation is a transdiagnostic symptom and hypothesized to serve as a short-term regulatory mechanism in response to emotional stress. The present study examined the momentary dynamics between dissociation, negative affect, and cortisol in the day-to-day lives of adolescent psychiatric inpatients.
METHODS: Forty-eight adolescents (mean age: 15.85 years, SD: 1.15, 81% female) were recruited from psychiatric inpatient units. Following a diagnostic baseline assessment, participants completed twelve signal-contingent ecological momentary assessments per day over five consecutive days, each separated by one hour, reporting on dissociation and negative affect. Salivary cortisol was sampled concurrently. Data were analysed using Residual Dynamic Structural Equation Modelling.
RESULTS: No significant cross-lagged effects between dissociation and negative affect emerged. However, a significant contemporaneous association indicated that these variables co-occurred (st.est. = 0.236, 95%-CI: 0.191-0.280). Neither emotion regulation difficulties, borderline personality disorder nor childhood trauma assessed at baseline significantly moderated the cross-lagged or contemporaneous effects. A small cross-lagged effect of the cortisol × dissociation interaction on negative affect emerged (st.est. = -0.056, 95%CI: -0.081 to -0.028), indicating that higher levels of dissociation in combination with elevated cortisol levels predicted lower subsequent negative affect.
DISCUSSION: These findings provide partial support for theoretical conceptualization of dissociation as a marker for emotion dysregulation and underscore the need for studies employing combined psychological and biological assessments with higher sample frequencies than a one-hour interval to more precisely capture the short-lived temporal dynamics among dissociation, affect, and endocrine stress responses.

标题：解离作为情绪失调的标志：基于生态瞬时评估的青少年精神科住院患者研究
摘要：背景：解离是一种跨诊断症状，被假设为应对情绪压力的短期调节机制。本研究考察了青少年精神科住院患者日常生活中解离、负性情绪与皮质醇之间的瞬时动态关系。方法：从精神科住院病房招募48名青少年（平均年龄：15.85岁，SD：1.15，81%为女性）。在诊断基线评估后，参与者连续五天每天完成十二次信号依从性生态瞬时评估，每次间隔一小时，报告解离和负性情绪，并同步采集唾液皮质醇样本。数据采用残差动态结构方程模型进行分析。结果：解离与负性情绪之间未出现显著的交叉滞后效应。然而，显著的同期关联表明这些变量同时发生（标准化估计值=0.236，95%置信区间：0.191-0.280）。基线评估的情绪调节困难、边缘型人格障碍或童年创伤均未显著调节交叉滞后或同期效应。皮质醇×解离交互作用对负性情绪存在较小的交叉滞后效应（标准化估计值=-0.056，95%CI：-0.081至-0.028），表明较高水平的解离结合升高的皮质醇水平可预测随后较低的负性情绪。讨论：这些发现为解离作为情绪失调标志的理论概念化提供了部分支持，并强调需要采用心理与生物学联合评估、且采样频率高于一小时间隔的研究，以更精确地捕捉解离、情感和内分泌应激反应之间短暂的瞬态动态。
关键词：解离；情绪失调；生态瞬时评估；青少年；皮质醇

title: User acceptability of biometric emotion-sensing technologies: The role of perceived intrusiveness and psycho-attitudinal segmentation.
summary: Emotion-sensing technologies are increasingly deployed in consumer contexts, yet their adoption is shaped by concerns related to privacy, bodily exposure, and emotional surveillance. While dominant acceptance models such as TAM, UTAUT, and the Privacy Calculus emphasize cognitive predictors, less attention has been given to embodied and attitudinal mechanisms associated with biometric sensing. This study examines how perceived intrusiveness relates to the acceptability of four emotion-sensing technologies (facial analysis, voice analysis, eye-tracking, and heart-rate variability) and how psycho-attitudinal dispositions structure user evaluations. Using a within-subject experimental design (N = 56) and scenario-based assessments, we conducted repeated-measures ANOVAs, correlation and mediation analyses, and k-means clustering. Results indicate that perceived intrusiveness is negatively associated with comfort, ethical acceptability, and intention to use. Heart-rate variability was evaluated as less intrusive and more acceptable than facial analysis, with voice and eye-tracking occupying intermediate positions. Mediation analyses suggest that privacy priority and technology distrust are linked to evaluations through perceived intrusiveness, whereas technological enthusiasm shows more direct associations. Three psycho-attitudinal profiles were identified, differing systematically in acceptance patterns. These findings introduce the concept of symbolic bodily exposure as an interpretive lens for understanding differentiated reactions to biometric modalities and contribute to a more context-sensitive perspective on emotion-sensing adoption.

标题：用户对生物特征情绪感知技术的接受度：感知侵入性与心理—态度细分的作用
摘要：情绪感知技术在消费情境中的应用日益增多，然而其采纳受到与隐私、身体暴露和情绪监控相关的关切所影响。尽管TAM、UTAUT和隐私计算等主流接受模型强调认知预测因素，但较少关注与生物特征感知相关的具身性和态度性机制。本研究考察了感知侵入性如何与四种情绪感知技术（面部分析、语音分析、眼动追踪和心率变异性）的接受度相关，以及心理—态度倾向如何结构化用户评价。采用被试内实验设计（N = 56）和基于情境的评估，我们进行了重复测量方差分析、相关与中介分析以及k均值聚类。结果表明，感知侵入性与舒适度、伦理可接受性和使用意愿呈负相关。心率变异性被评为侵入性较低且比面部分析更可接受，语音和眼动追踪居于中间位置。中介分析表明，隐私优先和技术不信任通过感知侵入性与评价相关联，而技术热情则呈现更直接的联系。研究识别出三种心理—态度剖面，其接受模式存在系统性差异。这些发现引入了符号性身体暴露的概念，作为理解对不同生物特征模态差异化反应的诠释视角，并为情绪感知采纳提供了更具情境敏感性的视角。

title: How do young chinese physicians cope with stress under standardized training? Investigating perceived stress, depression, and their interrelationships.
summary: Resident physicians undergoing standardized residency training (SRT) in China face substantial occupational stress, yet the extent of their psychological burden and the pathways linking stress to depressive symptoms remain incompletely characterized. This multicenter, cross-sectional study examined the psychological burden and its underlying pathways among 504 resident physicians in China's SRT system. Participants from teaching hospitals in southern China completed validated questionnaires assessing perceived stress (PSS-10), burnout (MBI-GS), effort-reward imbalance (ERI), and depressive symptoms (PHQ-9), and the data were analyzed using path analysis with bias-corrected bootstrapping to test for serial mediation. The prevalence of psychological problems was high: 38.49% reported high perceived stress, 83.13% experienced burnout (37.5% moderate or severe), 30.16% exhibited effort-reward imbalance, and 27.58% screened positive for probable depression. Mean scores were 17.61 ± 6.36 for perceived stress, 43.26 ± 13.04 for burnout, 0.94 ± 0.65 for ERI, and 7.83 ± 6.47 for depressive symptoms. All four variables were significantly and positively correlated (ρ = 0.338-0.631). The path analysis indicated a serial mediation pattern: higher perceived stress was associated with higher ERI (β = 0.43), higher ERI with greater burnout (β = 0.49), and greater burnout with more severe depressive symptoms (β = 0.37); perceived stress was also directly associated with depressive symptoms (β = 0.21). In conclusion, resident physicians in China experience a substantial psychological burden, characterized by a sequential association linking stress, effort-reward imbalance, burnout, and depressive symptoms. Because the design was cross-sectional, these pathways reflect associations rather than causal effects. Safeguarding trainee well-being and healthcare quality will require targeted interventions that reduce effort-reward imbalance through improved compensation and job security, mitigate burnout through workload management, and ensure access to mental health resources.

标题：规范化培训下中国青年医师如何应对压力？——感知压力、抑郁及其相互关系研究
摘要：接受规范化培训（SRT）的中国住院医师面临巨大的职业压力，但其心理负担的严重程度及压力与抑郁症状之间的关联路径尚未被充分阐明。这项多中心横断面研究考察了504名中国SRT体系住院医师的心理负担及其潜在路径。来自中国南部教学医院的参与者完成了验证过的问卷，评估感知压力（PSS-10）、职业倦怠（MBI-GS）、付出-回报失衡（ERI）和抑郁症状（PHQ-9），并采用带偏差校正自助法的路径分析检验序列中介效应。心理问题检出率较高：38.49%报告高感知压力，83.13%经历职业倦怠（37.5%为中重度），30.16%存在付出-回报失衡，27.58%筛查为可能抑郁。感知压力、职业倦怠、ERI和抑郁症状的平均得分分别为17.61±6.36、43.26±13.04、0.94±0.65和7.83±6.47。四个变量之间均呈显著正相关（ρ=0.338-0.631）。路径分析表明存在序列中介模式：较高的感知压力与较高的ERI相关（β=0.43），较高的ERI与更严重的职业倦怠相关（β=0.49），更严重的职业倦怠与更明显的抑郁症状相关（β=0.37）；感知压力也与抑郁症状直接相关（β=0.21）。总之，中国住院医师承受着显著的心理负担，其特征为压力、付出-回报失衡、职业倦怠和抑郁症状之间的序列关联。由于采用横断面设计，这些路径反映的是关联而非因果关系。保障受训者福祉和医疗质量需要通过改善薪酬和职业保障来减少付出-回报失衡，通过工作量管理减轻职业倦怠，并确保心理健康资源的可及性。

title: Mental health and psychosocial support among refugee children and adolescents with HIV in West Nile Uganda: An exploratory study.
summary: Refugee populations face disruptions in social services, particularly HIV- related care such as access to Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy. Uganda hosts the highest number of refugees in Africa. These children and adolescents (CAs) are faced with several mental health and psychosocial challenges that are amplified by their humanitarian context. Multiple health and social welfare partners support Children and Adolescents with HIV (CA-HIV) in overcoming these challenges. However, no clear documentation exists on the mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) services available to aid the care-seeking process and design. We therefore set out to explore MHPSS services for CA-HIV in the refugee settlements of West Nile, Uganda. This study utilized an exploratory-descriptive qualitative approach. Participants included CA-HIV, their caretakers and people involved in offering MHPSS services to them. Altogether, we conducted 4 in-depth interviews and 9 focus group discussions. Study participants were recruited from refugee settlements in West Nile, Uganda and were invited to participate in focus group discussions, key informant interviews and in-depth interviews. The proceedings from these discussions and interviews were audio recorded, transcribed, and translated to English when necessary. Analysis by inductive thematic analysis was done using NVivo software. Three key themes emerged: Perceptions and markers of mental unwellness (including etiology, signs and symptoms), MHPSS and its related challenges among refugee CA-HIV (arising due to both the HIV serostatus and refugee status of the CA) and the role of the self, specialized and non-specialized service providers towards the MHPSS wellbeing of this population. MHPSS markers, challenges and interventions are multifaceted. The interventions involve specialized personnel, non-specialized personnel and the children themselves. All these ought to be carefully considered as we seek to address the contextual MHPSS challenges faced by refugee CA-HIV.

标题：乌干达西尼罗河地区感染HIV的难民儿童和青少年心理健康与社会心理支持：一项探索性研究
摘要：难民人群面临社会服务中断的问题，尤其是与HIV相关的照护，如高效抗逆转录病毒治疗的获取。乌干达是非洲收容难民数量最多的国家。这些儿童和青少年（CAs）面临多重心理健康和社会心理挑战，且其人道主义背景使这些挑战进一步加剧。多个健康和社会福利合作伙伴支持感染HIV的儿童和青少年（CA-HIV）克服这些挑战。然而，目前关于可用于辅助就医过程和服务设计的心理健康与社会心理支持（MHPSS）服务缺乏明确记录。因此，我们着手探索乌干达西尼罗河地区难民安置点中面向CA-HIV的MHPSS服务。本研究采用探索性描述性质性研究方法。参与者包括CA-HIV、其照护者以及为其提供MHPSS服务的人员。我们共进行了4次深度访谈和9次焦点小组讨论。研究参与者从乌干达西尼罗河地区的难民安置点招募，并被邀请参加焦点小组讨论、关键知情人访谈和深度访谈。讨论和访谈过程被录音，转录，必要时翻译成英文。使用NVivo软件进行归纳性主题分析。共提炼出三个核心主题：心理不健康的感知与标志（包括病因、体征和症状）、难民CA-HIV群体中MHPSS及其相关挑战（源于CA的HIV血清状态和难民身份）、以及自我、专业和非专业服务提供者在促进该群体MHPSS福祉中的作用。MHPSS的标志、挑战和干预措施是多方面的。干预涉及专业人员、非专业人员以及儿童自身。在寻求应对难民CA-HIV所面临的情境化MHPSS挑战时，所有这些因素都应被仔细考量。

title: Inferring Causality in Aperiodic and Periodic Components of Brain and Cardiac Dynamics.
summary:
UNLABELLED: Background: Aperiodic $1/f-$like neural activity is thought to reflect fundamental properties of population-level excitation-inhibition balance, yet no existing framework provides directional causal inference between this component and neuroautonomic dynamics. Current brain-heart models also lack formulations accounting for both aperiodic and oscillatory spectral components.
OBJECTIVES: To develop a mathematical framework for directional causal inference between time-resolved aperiodic ($1/f-$like) electroencephalographic (EEG) components and heartbeat dynamics. We also aim to extend the same formalism to periodic narrow-band EEG oscillations.
METHODS: We introduce the directional causality for brain-heart interplay (DiCa-BHI) framework, a stochastic modelling approach in which each EEG spectral parameter is treated as a time-varying process governed by autoregressive dynamics with exogenous neuroautonomic inputs. Aperiodic exponent, offset, and oscillatory peak amplitudes are modelled within a parametric spectral representation, while heartbeat dynamics are characterized via an extended, stochastic integral pulse frequency modulation model. Directional causal coefficients are estimated using a Granger-predictive causal ARX formalism. Validation employed synchronized EEG-ECG recordings from 27 healthy adults undergoing supine rest, postural changes, and emotional video elicitation. Subject-specific estimations are performed and then compared across experimental conditions.
RESULTS: The aperiodic $1/f-$-like EEG component exhibited predominant bottom-up heart-to-brain causality, attenuated during orthostasis but strengthened during emotional stimulation across widespread cortical regions. Conversely, periodic narrowband components showed strong top-down brain-to-heart dominance, exceeding 90% for vagal and 70% for sympathovagal contributions.
CONCLUSIONS: DiCa-BHI provides a novel methodological framework for directional causal inference in the $1/f-$ aperiodic component of neural activity and generalizes seamlessly to narrow-band oscillatory components.
SIGNIFICANCE: The framework advances mathematical modelling of the brain-heart axis and provides a quantitative tool for applications in cardiology, neurology, and psychophysiological research.

相关性：是

优先级：重点推荐
标题：推断大脑与心脏动力学中周期性及非周期性成分的因果关系
摘要：无标注：背景：非周期性1/f样神经活动被认为反映了群体水平兴奋-抑制平衡的基本特性，但现有框架尚无对神经自主动力学与该成分之间进行定向因果推断的方法。当前的脑-心模型也缺乏同时考虑非周期性和振荡频谱成分的表述。目的：开发一种数学框架，用于时间分辨的非周期性（1/f样）脑电图（EEG）成分与心跳动力学之间的定向因果推断。我们还旨在将该形式体系扩展到周期性窄带EEG振荡。方法：我们引入了脑-心交互定向因果性（DiCa-BHI）框架，这是一种随机建模方法，其中每个EEG频谱参数被视为由带有外源性神经自主输入的自回归动力学所调控的时间变化过程。非周期性指数、偏移和振荡峰值振幅在参数化频谱表示中建模，而心跳动力学则通过扩展的随机积分脉冲频率调制模型来描述。使用Granger预测性因果ARX形式体系估计定向因果系数。验证采用了27名健康成人在仰卧静息、体位改变和情绪视频诱发下的同步EEG-ECG记录。进行个体特异性估计，并在实验条件间进行比较。结果：非周期性1/f样EEG成分表现出主要自下而上的心脏到大脑因果性，在直立位时减弱，但在情绪刺激期间在广泛皮层区域增强。相反，周期性窄带成分表现出强烈的自上而下的大脑到心脏主导性，迷走神经贡献超过90%，交感迷走贡献超过70%。结论：DiCa-BHI为神经活动1/f非周期性成分的定向因果推断提供了新颖的方法学框架，并可无缝推广至窄带振荡成分。意义：该框架推进了脑-心轴的数学建模，并为心脏病学、神经病学和精神生理学研究提供了定量工具。
关键词：脑-心交互，定向因果推断，非周期性神经活动，Granger因果性，频谱动力学

title: Learning to self-soothe, feel safe, and be connected: participant perspectives of a mindful self-compassion program for people with multiple sclerosis.
summary:
PURPOSE: People with multiple sclerosis (PwMS) often experience high rates of stress, anxiety, and depression, with low quality of life. Mindful self-compassion (MSC) training may offer a promising approach to support mental health in this population. This study explored the experiences of PwMS participating in an online MSC course as part of a feasibility trial to assess its accessibility, perceived effects, and suggested areas for improvement.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Qualitative interpretive methods were used. Semi-structured Zoom interviews were completed with 17 PwMS and three MSC facilitators after the course. Transcripts underwent reflexive thematic analysis by a team of researchers.
RESULTS: Four themes were constructed: (1) "the ticking time bomb": motivations for mindful self-compassion, (2) navigating the MSC course: benefits, challenges, and accessibility, (3) a community of trust: finding support and common humanity, and (4) wishing for more: filling the gap in MS care.
CONCLUSIONS: PwMS found MSC to be a meaningful and acceptable intervention that supported emotional well-being, social connection, and daily coping. MSC may complement standard MS care by addressing psychosocial needs that are often overlooked. Tailored delivery and long-term accessibility could enhance its integration into supportive care pathways.

标题：学会自我安抚、感到安全并建立联结：多发性硬化症患者对正念自我慈悲项目的参与者视角
摘要：目的：多发性硬化症患者（PwMS）常伴有高水平的压力、焦虑和抑郁，生活质量较低。正念自我慈悲（MSC）训练可能为这一人群的心理健康支持提供一种有前景的方法。本研究作为可行性试验的一部分，探索了PwMS参与线上MSC课程的经历，以评估其可及性、感知效果及建议改进之处。方法：采用质性解释性研究方法。课程结束后，研究团队对17名PwMS和3名MSC引导者进行了半结构化Zoom访谈。转录文本由研究团队进行反思性主题分析。结果：构建了四个主题：（1）“定时炸弹”：参与正念自我慈悲的动机；（2） navigating MSC课程：益处、挑战与可及性；（3）信任的社区：寻找支持与共同人性；（4）期待更多：填补MS照护中的空白。结论：PwMS认为MSC是一种有意义且可接受的干预，能够支持情绪幸福感、社会联结和日常应对。MSC可通过解决常被忽视的心理社会需求来补充标准MS照护。定制化交付和长期可及性可促进其融入支持性照护路径。
关键词：正念自我慈悲；多发性硬化症；心理健康；质性研究；数字心理干预

title: An Umbrella Review of Artificial Intelligence Applications in Mental Health Care.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in mental health care to address rising demand, workforce shortages and access barriers; however, evidence remains scattered across multiple systematic reviews, limiting synthesis and practical application.
OBJECTIVE: To synthesise evidence on AI applications in mental health care, including trends, uses, benefits, challenges and risk-mitigation strategies, guided by an ethics of care framework.
METHODS: This umbrella review of systematic reviews followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Five databases (Web of Science, Scopus, PubMed, PsycINFO and CINAHL) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between 2021 and 2025, with additional studies identified through backward and forward citation tracking. Eligible studies were systematic reviews examining artificial intelligence (AI) applications in mental health care involving human participants. Exclusion criteria included non-systematic reviews, non-AI studies, grey literature and non-English publications. Three reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts and full texts according to predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Methodological quality was assessed using the AMSTAR-2 tool, and data were extracted on AI type, mental health focus, end-user applications, benefits and challenges. Extracted data were analysed thematically using an iterative coding process to identify recurring patterns on AI type, mental health focus, applications, benefits and challenges.
RESULTS: Twenty-seven systematic reviews with over 14 million participants were included. Findings converged across four primary themes. First, AI enhances early detection and risk stratification, particularly for depression, anxiety, stress, PTSD and suicidal ideation. Second, AI-enabled digital tools, such as chatbots and mobile platforms, expand access and engagement by supporting symptom monitoring, self-management and continuity of care. Third, structural and ethical fragilities were noted, including data bias, limited external validity, methodological heterogeneity and insufficient transparency. Fourth, AI demonstrated greatest value when embedded within human-centred, hybrid care models that preserve clinical judgement, relational care and accountability. Evidence supporting AI applications was stronger for screening and predictive tasks than for sustained therapeutic interventions. Among the 54 reviews assessed for methodological quality, 27 achieved moderate or high confidence ratings on the AMSTAR-2 tool, with stronger evidence observed in reviews evaluating AI interventions for early detection and risk prediction.
CONCLUSION: Artificial intelligence (AI) has significant potential to enhance mental health nursing by supporting early identification of symptoms, improving access to care and strengthening clinical decision-making. For nursing practice, responsible implementation requires rigorous validation, equity-focused design, transparency and sustained human oversight. Integrating AI within an ethics-of-care framework ensures that these technologies support person-centred, relational nursing care rather than replacing the critical role of nurses in therapeutic engagement and clinical judgement.

相关性：是
主题标签：["心理健康与数字心理干预"]
优先级：常规收录
标题：人工智能在心理健康照护中应用的伞形综述
摘要：背景：人工智能（AI）越来越多地被应用于心理健康照护，以应对日益增长的需求、劳动力短缺和获取障碍；然而，相关证据分散于多项系统综述中，限制了综合分析与实际应用。目的：在关怀伦理学框架指导下，综合AI在心理健康照护中应用的证据，包括趋势、用途、益处、挑战及风险缓解策略。方法：本伞形综述遵循PRISMA 2020指南，检索了五个数据库（Web of Science、Scopus、PubMed、PsycINFO和CINAHL），纳入2021至2025年间发表的同行评审研究，并通过前后引文追踪补充额外研究。符合条件的研究为考察AI在人参与者心理健康照护中应用的系统综述。排除标准包括非系统综述、非AI研究、灰色文献及非英文出版物。三名评审员根据预设的纳入和排除标准独立筛选标题、摘要和全文。采用AMSTAR-2工具评估方法学质量，并提取关于AI类型、心理健康重点、最终用户应用、益处和挑战的数据。通过迭代编码过程对提取数据进行主题分析，以识别AI类型、心理健康重点、应用、益处和挑战方面的重复模式。结果：共纳入27项系统综述，涉及超过1400万名参与者。研究结果汇聚为四个主要主题。第一，AI增强了早期检测和风险分层能力，特别是在抑郁、焦虑、压力、创伤后应激障碍和自杀意念方面。第二，AI赋能的数字工具（如聊天机器人和移动平台）通过支持症状监测、自我管理和护理连续性，扩大了服务获取并提高了参与度。第三，存在结构和伦理层面的脆弱性，包括数据偏差、外部效度有限、方法学异质性及透明度不足。第四，AI在以人为本的混合照护模式中嵌入时展现出最大价值，该模式保留临床判断、关系性照护和问责机制。AI应用在筛查和预测任务中的证据强于持续性治疗干预。在评估方法学质量的54项综述中，27项在AMSTAR-2工具上达到中度或高度置信评级，评估AI用于早期检测和风险预测干预的综述显示出更强证据。结论：人工智能在支持症状早期识别、改善照护获取和加强临床决策方面具有显著潜力，可增强心理健康护理实践。对护理实践而言，负责任地实施需要严格验证、以公平为导向的设计、透明度及持续的人类监督。将AI整合于关怀伦理学框架内，可确保这些技术支持以人为本的关系性护理，而非取代护士在治疗性参与和临床判断中的关键角色。
关键词：人工智能；心理健康照护；伞形综述；数字心理干预；关怀伦理学

title: Evaluation of the effectiveness of EMDR therapy for children and adolescents in Ukraine during war.
summary: Background: In Ukraine, an entire generation of children is directly or indirectly affected by chronic exposure to potentially traumatic events due to the ongoing war, and many children may develop trauma-related disorders including posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) therapy was implemented for therapists treating children and adolescents in Ukraine. The aim of this study was to investigate the effectiveness of this evidence-based treatment for children and adolescents living amid ongoing war.Objective: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effectiveness of EMDR therapy for children and adolescents living under ongoing war conditions in Ukraine.Methods: EMDR for Children and Adolescents (C&A) is implemented in Ukraine by EMDR C&A trainers from three European countries (the Netherlands, Germany, and Italy), who trained Ukrainian therapists. Outcome data from N = 151 children and adolescents (62.9% female, M = 10.87 years; SD = 4.34, range 1-17) treated by n = 32 therapists have been analysed. Children and parents completed the CATS-2 to measure self - and caregiver-reported symptoms of PTSD before and after treatment. The data collection period occurred from June 2023 to January 2025.Results: At the end of treatment, the patients reported significant reductions in PTSD symptoms, with large pre-post effect sizes for DSM-5 PTSD (d self-report = 1.83; d caregiver report = 1.93), ICD-11 PTSD (d self-report = 1.62; d caregiver report = 1.57), ICD-11 CPTSD (d self-report = 1.63; d caregiver report = 1.74), and DSM-5 pre-school PTSD (d = 1.72).Conclusion: Despite the methodological limitations of this study, the results suggest that EMDR can be delivered effectively to children and adolescents in regions impacted by ongoing war. Future studies should replicate these findings and evaluate the effects of EMDR during war conditions using a randomised controlled design.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：战争期间乌克兰儿童与青少年EMDR疗法有效性评估
摘要：背景：在乌克兰，由于持续战争，整整一代儿童直接或间接受到慢性潜在创伤事件暴露的影响，许多儿童可能发展出包括创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）在内的创伤相关障碍。眼动脱敏与再加工（EMDR）疗法已被引入乌克兰，供治疗儿童和青少年的治疗师使用。本研究旨在考察这种循证治疗对生活在持续战争中的儿童和青少年的有效性。目的：本研究旨在评估EMDR疗法对生活在乌克兰持续战争条件下的儿童和青少年的有效性。方法：EMDR儿童与青少年（C&A）疗法由来自三个欧洲国家（荷兰、德国和意大利）的EMDR C&A培训师在乌克兰实施，他们培训了乌克兰治疗师。分析了由32名治疗师治疗的N=151名儿童和青少年的结局数据（62.9%为女性，M=10.87岁；SD=4.34，范围1-17岁）。儿童和父母在治疗前后完成CATS-2，以测量自我报告和照护者报告的PTSD症状。数据收集时间为2023年6月至2025年1月。结果：治疗结束时，患者报告PTSD症状显著减少，DSM-5 PTSD的前后效应量大（d自我报告=1.83；d照护者报告=1.93），ICD-11 PTSD（d自我报告=1.62；d照护者报告=1.57），ICD-11复杂性PTSD（d自我报告=1.63；d照护者报告=1.74），以及DSM-5学龄前PTSD（d=1.72）。结论：尽管本研究存在方法学局限性，但结果表明EMDR可在受持续战争影响的地区有效施用于儿童和青少年。未来研究应使用随机对照设计重复这些发现并评估战争条件下EMDR的效果。
关键词：EMDR疗法；儿童与青少年；战争；创伤后应激障碍；心理干预

title: A pragmatic randomized controlled trial of self-directed online writing interventions for posttraumatic stress symptoms in a real-world digital setting.
summary: Background: Public health and other large-scale crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, have intensified the global mental health burden, creating unprecedented demand for accessible interventions for posttraumatic stress symptoms (PTSS).Objective: We evaluated the feasibility and effectiveness of two self-directed online writing interventions embedded within China's WeChat ecosystem during the COVID-19 pandemic through a pragmatic randomised controlled trial.Methods: Between December 2021 and August 2022, 1,526 adults were screened for PTSS via a Tencent Medinfo Mini-Program. Eligible participants (n = 211) were randomised to Guided Narrative Technique-Writing (GNT-W, n = 100) or Expressive Writing (EW, n = 111). Both interventions comprised three self-directed daily writing sessions delivered entirely online without human support. Primary outcome was PTSD symptom severity (PTSD Checklist-Short), assessed at baseline, post-intervention, 2-week, and 1-month follow-ups.Results: While initial engagement followed typical digital health patterns (64.5% overall attrition), participants who initiated treatment showed strong adherence (77% completion). Both interventions were associated with significant within-group reductions in PTSS severity (GNT-W: b = -0.43, p = .023, d = -0.43; EW: b = -0.60, p = .001, d = -0.58), with no significant between-group difference (group × time: b = 0.18, p = .48). GNT-W did not confer additional benefit over EW protocol on PTSS severity.Conclusions: Both self-directed writing interventions were associated with within-group reductions in PTSS; without an inactive control condition, however, these changes cannot be firmly attributed to the interventions. GNT-W showed no advantage over the simpler EW protocol. These findings offer preliminary support for embedding scalable, low-barrier writing interventions in widely used digital platforms.Chinese Clinical Trial Registry: ChiCTR2000034836.

优先级：常规收录
标题：一项在真实世界数字环境中针对创伤后应激症状的自主在线写作干预的实用性随机对照试验
摘要：背景：公共卫生及其他大规模危机（如COVID-19大流行）加剧了全球心理健康负担，对可及的创伤后应激症状（PTSS）干预措施产生了前所未有的需求。目的：通过一项实用性随机对照试验，评估在COVID-19大流行期间嵌入中国微信生态系统的两种自主在线写作干预的可行性和有效性。方法：2021年12月至2022年8月期间，通过腾讯医疗信息小程序对1,526名成年人进行PTSS筛查。符合条件的参与者（n=211）被随机分配至引导叙事技巧写作（GNT-W，n=100）或表达性写作（EW，n=111）。两种干预均包括三次完全在线、无人工支持的自主每日写作课程。主要结果为创伤后应激障碍症状严重程度（PTSD检查表简版），在基线、干预后、2周和1个月随访时进行评估。结果：虽然初始参与遵循典型的数字健康模式（总体流失率64.5%），但开始治疗的参与者表现出较强的依从性（完成率77%）。两种干预均与PTSS严重程度的组内显著降低相关（GNT-W：b=-0.43，p=.023，d=-0.43；EW：b=-0.60，p=.001，d=-0.58），组间差异不显著（组×时间：b=0.18，p=.48）。GNT-W在PTSS严重程度上未比EW方案带来额外收益。结论：两种自主写作干预均与PTSS的组内降低相关；但由于缺乏非活跃对照组，这些变化不能确凿归因于干预本身。GNT-W相比更简单的EW方案未显示出优势。这些发现为在广泛使用的数字平台中嵌入可扩展、低门槛的写作干预提供了初步支持。中国临床试验注册号：ChiCTR2000034836。
关键词：创伤后应激症状，写作干预，数字化心理干预，随机对照试验，微信平台

title: Exploratory Continuous-Time Modeling (Expct): Extracting Dynamic Features from Irregularly Spaced Time Series.
summary: When collecting intensive longitudinal data in the social, behavioral and biomedical sciences irregularly spaced data (i.e., data that are not collected at equal intervals) are the norm rather than the exception. However, most of the techniques and models that are used to analyze these data in practice were designed for equally spaced data. Although continuous time vector autoregressive models (CT-VAR) have been recently used to examine the relationship between variables across time differences, the current implementation of these models makes strong assumptions about the functional relationships between variables within the system. The current paper introduces the novel exploratory continuous-time models (expct), which allow for the continuous estimation of multivariate (or univariate) predictors with multivariate outcomes with regularly or irregularly-spaced data. As demonstrated in the Monte-Carlo simulation study, the expct models are able to efficiently model complex auto- and cross-regressive system dynamics without bias. The expct model: (1) addresses intensive data across virtually any time scheme, (2) allows for data collected at different time scales to predict themselves and one another, and (3) makes fewer assumptions about the functional forms of the longitudinal system dynamics between variables.

标题：探索性连续时间建模（Expct）：从不规则间隔时间序列中提取动态特征
摘要：在社会科学、行为科学和生物医学科学中收集密集型纵向数据时，不规则间隔数据（即非等间隔采集的数据）是常态而非例外。然而，实践中用于分析这些数据的大多数技术和方法都是为等间隔数据设计的。尽管连续时间向量自回归模型（CT-VAR）近年来已被用于考察变量在不同时间差下的关系，但当前这些模型的实现方式对系统内变量间的函数关系做出了强假设。本文介绍了新颖的探索性连续时间模型（expct），该模型允许对多变量（或单变量）预测变量与多变量结果进行连续估计，并可处理规则或不规则间隔的数据。蒙特卡洛模拟研究表明，expct模型能够无偏地高效建模复杂的自回归和交叉回归系统动态。expct模型：（1）适用于几乎任何时间方案的密集型数据；（2）允许在不同时间尺度上收集的数据进行自身预测和相互预测；（3）对变量间纵向系统动态的函数形式做出了更少的假设。
关键词：连续时间模型；不规则间隔数据；密集型纵向数据；动态特征提取；向量自回归

title: Message Formats and Source Cues in Digital Mental Health Communication: Socioeconomic Differences in Engagement Intentions.
summary: Digital platforms are central to mental health communication, yet little is known about whether digital message characteristics shape engagement uniformly across socioeconomic groups. This research examines how the format and source characteristics of digital mental health messages influence information- and help-seeking intentions under stigma-sensitive conditions-and whether these effects are socially stratified. Two experiments with Korean young adults examined message format, emotional tone, corrective content, and speaker type. Study 1 compared two popular digital message formats-a narrative-message format and a short-form video format-paired with positive, negative, or neutral emotional framing. Among the two formats examined, participants exposed to the narrative-message format showed greater increases in both information- and help-seeking intentions than those exposed to the short-form video format, while emotional effects were conditional and varied across education-income intersections. Study 2 examined source cues by comparing AI and institutional speakers delivering corrective or non-corrective content. Corrective messages increased help-seeking intentions primarily when delivered by AI speakers, whereas institutional correction was more persuasive among higher-income participants. Across both studies, the observed message effects were systematically moderated by socioeconomic position. These findings suggest that digital mental health campaigns may reproduce or mitigate engagement inequalities depending on how different message formats and source characteristics align with audience resources and trust orientations.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：数字心理健康传播中的信息格式与来源线索：社会经济差异对参与意向的影响
摘要：数字平台是心理健康传播的核心渠道，然而关于数字信息特征是否在不同社会经济群体中产生统一的参与效应，目前知之甚少。本研究考察了数字心理健康信息的格式与来源特征如何影响污名敏感情境下的信息寻求与帮助寻求意向，以及这些效应是否具有社会分层性。两项以韩国年轻成年人为对象的实验考察了信息格式、情绪基调、纠正性内容及发言者类型。研究一比较了两种流行的数字信息格式——叙事性信息格式与短视频格式——并分别配以积极、消极或中性情绪框架。在所考察的两种格式中，接触叙事性信息格式的参与者在信息寻求和帮助寻求意向上均比接触短视频格式者表现出更大提升，而情绪效应则具有条件性，并随教育与收入交叉水平而变化。研究二通过比较AI发言者与机构发言者传递纠正性或非纠正性内容来考察来源线索。纠正性信息主要在由AI发言者传递时提升帮助寻求意向，而机构来源的纠正在高收入参与者中更具说服力。两项研究均显示，所观察到的信息效应系统性地受到社会经济地位的调节。这些发现表明，数字心理健康传播活动可能因不同信息格式和来源特征与受众资源及信任取向的匹配程度，而再现或缓解参与不平等。
关键词：数字心理健康传播；信息格式；来源线索；社会经济差异；参与意向

title: Fetal mental programming: maternal psychological homeostasis as a placenta-mediated determinant of cognitive and emotional development - an integrative perspective.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Fetal programming has traditionally been interpreted through metabolic and endocrine paradigms, while maternal psychological regulation remains underdeveloped as a biological determinant of neurodevelopment. Emerging evidence from placental biology, epigenetics, and fetal neuroimaging suggests that maternal psychological states may act not only as contextual exposures but also as dynamic physiological signals during pregnancy.
CONTENT: This article proposes an integrative perspective in which maternal psychological homeostasis is conceptualized as a multidimensional regulatory state encompassing endocrine, immune, autonomic, and circadian processes. We hypothesize that the placenta functions as an active signal-processing interface, translating maternal physiological signals into developmental cues. Potential mechanisms include glucocorticoid signaling, inflammatory pathways, and epigenetic regulation, which may influence fetal neural connectivity, stress-response systems, and early neurobehavioral organization. Although converging findings support biological plausibility, the evidence remains heterogeneous, with uncertainties regarding causality and timing.
SUMMARY: Within this framework, fetal mental programming may arise, in part, from maternal psychological regulation as it is integrated within placental biology, involving interacting and temporally sensitive regulatory layers rather than a single pathway.
OUTLOOK: Future research should prioritize longitudinal human studies, validation of placental biomarkers, and identification of sensitive developmental windows. Improved understanding may support integration of mental health into perinatal care and inform early preventive strategies.

标题：胎儿心理编程：母体心理稳态作为胎盘介导的认知与情绪发展决定因素——一个整合视角
摘要：背景：胎儿编程传统上通过代谢和内分泌范式进行解释，而母体心理调节作为神经发育的生物学决定因素仍未得到充分发展。来自胎盘生物学、表观遗传学和胎儿神经影像学的新兴证据表明，母体心理状态在妊娠期间不仅可作为情境性暴露因素，还可作为动态生理信号发挥作用。内容：本文提出一个整合视角，将母体心理稳态概念化为一个涵盖内分泌、免疫、自主神经和昼夜节律过程的多维调节状态。我们假设胎盘作为一个主动的信号处理界面，将母体生理信号转化为发育线索。潜在机制包括糖皮质激素信号传导、炎症通路和表观遗传调控，这些机制可能影响胎儿神经连接、应激反应系统和早期神经行为组织。尽管汇聚的研究结果支持其生物学合理性，但证据仍存在异质性，且在因果关系和时序方面存在不确定性。总结：在该框架内，胎儿心理编程可能部分源于母体心理调节，并通过胎盘生物学加以整合，涉及相互作用的且对时间敏感的调节层次，而非单一通路。展望：未来研究应优先开展纵向人体研究、验证胎盘生物标志物，并识别敏感发育窗口。深入理解可能有助于将心理健康整合到围产期保健中，并为早期预防策略提供依据。
关键词：胎儿编程；母体心理稳态；胎盘介导；神经发育；心脑轴

title: Resting-State Heart Rate Variability and Symptom-Level Conditional Associations in Hospitalized Patients with Musculoskeletal Pain: An Exploratory Cross-Sectional Network Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pain, depressive and anxiety symptoms, sleep disturbance, and autonomic regulation may coexist in hospitalized patients with musculoskeletal pain. This study integrated item-level symptoms with resting-state photoplethysmography-derived heart rate variability (HRV) to characterize their regularized association structure.
METHODS: This exploratory cross-sectional study retained 172 adults hospitalized with musculoskeletal pain-related conditions. Pain-duration information was available for all participants, and 169 complete cases entered the primary 58-node network. Regularized partial rank associations were estimated from Spearman correlations using EBICglasso (γ = 0.50) without additional thresholding. Sensitivity analyses examined participants with pain lasting at least 3 months and the influence of overlapping insomnia items.
RESULTS: Median pain duration was 4.00 months (IQR, 0.57-24.33; range, 0.50-365.00), and 91 of 172 participants (52.9%) had pain lasting at least 3 months. The primary network retained 332 of 1653 possible edges. Prominent within- and cross-domain connections involved pain intensity and mood, gastrointestinal, cognitive, somatic, and insomnia symptoms. HRV indices formed a comparatively distinct physiological cluster; only 24 of 441 possible HRV-symptom edges were retained, all with absolute weights below 0.029. Strength and expected-influence estimates showed low bootstrap stability (CS coefficients = 0.000 and 0.207, respectively). In the ≥3-month subgroup, correlations with the primary network were 0.868 for edge weights, 0.552 for strength, 0.729 for expected influence, and 0.925 for bridge expected influence. Network structure and bridge patterns were partly preserved, but centrality rankings were more duration-sensitive. After overlapping insomnia items were removed, the global structure remained similar, but pain-related sleep interference fell from fourth to 27th in bridge expected influence.
CONCLUSION: Item-level network analysis identified closely connected pain and psychological symptom patterns, whereas short-term PPG-derived HRV showed sparse and weak direct network connectivity with clinical symptoms. Sleep-related bridging was partly attributable to overlapping insomnia content. These exploratory findings support multidimensional inpatient assessment but require validation in larger longitudinal studies.

标题：静息态心率变异性与住院肌肉骨骼疼痛患者症状层面条件关联：一项探索性横断面网络分析
摘要：背景：疼痛、抑郁及焦虑症状、睡眠紊乱和自主神经调节可能在住院肌肉骨骼疼痛患者中共存。本研究将条目层面症状与静息态光电容积描记法衍生心率变异性（HRV）整合，以刻画其正则化关联结构。方法：这项探索性横断面研究纳入了172名因肌肉骨骼疼痛相关疾病住院的成人。所有参与者均具备疼痛持续时间信息，169例完整病例进入主要58节点网络。基于Spearman相关使用EBICglasso（γ = 0.50）估计正则化偏秩关联，未进行额外阈值化处理。敏感性分析考察了疼痛持续至少3个月的参与者以及重叠失眠条目的影响。结果：疼痛持续时间中位数为4.00个月（IQR，0.57-24.33；范围，0.50-365.00），172名参与者中有91人（52.9%）疼痛持续至少3个月。主要网络保留了1653条可能边中的332条。显著的域内和跨域连接涉及疼痛强度与情绪、胃肠、认知、躯体及失眠症状。HRV指标构成一个相对独立的生理聚类；441条可能的HRV-症状边中仅保留了24条，所有绝对权重均低于0.029。强度与预期影响力估计的bootstrap稳定性较低（CS系数分别为0.000和0.207）。在≥3个月亚组中，与主要网络的相关性为：边权重0.868、强度0.552、预期影响力0.729、桥接预期影响力0.925。网络结构和桥接模式部分保留，但中心性排序对持续时间更敏感。移除重叠失眠条目后，全局结构保持相似，但疼痛相关睡眠干扰在桥接预期影响力中从第4位降至第27位。结论：条目层面网络分析识别出紧密连接的疼痛与心理症状模式，而短期PPG衍生的HRV与临床症状表现出稀疏且弱的直接网络连接。睡眠相关桥接部分归因于重叠的失眠内容。这些探索性发现支持多维度的住院评估，但需在更大规模纵向研究中验证。
关键词：心率变异性；网络分析；肌肉骨骼疼痛；症状结构；静息态

title: A strengths-based resilience intervention for first-year nursing students: A mixed-methods quasi-experimental evaluation of short-term outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Nursing students are highly vulnerable to stress, anxiety, and mental health challenges, particularly during their transition into academic and clinical training. Strengths-based resilience interventions have been shown to enhance coping and well-being in student populations but are underexplored in non-Western nursing education contexts. Grounded in Self-Determination Theory and social ecological theory, this study aimed to examine the short-term outcomes of the Changing Minds, Changing Lives (CMCL) strengths-based resilience program among first-year nursing students in a non-Western context.
METHOD: This mixed-methods quasi-experimental study included 53 first-year nursing students allocated to intervention (n = 27) or comparison (n = 26) groups according to their existing class sections; one section was assigned to each condition. The intervention group received a 10-session strengths-based resilience program over five weeks. Quantitative outcomes were measured pre- and post-intervention using validated instruments: the Thai Perceived Stress Scale (T-PSS-10), Thai Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale (CD-RISC-25), Emotional Self-Awareness Scale (ESA), and Perceived Cohesion Questionnaire (PCQ). Outcomes were assessed immediately before and after the five-week program; no longer-term follow-up was conducted. Repeated-measures MANOVA with post hoc Bonferroni tests assessed group and time effects, and analyses of covariance adjusting for baseline scores were conducted as sensitivity analyses. Qualitative data were collected via reflective writings and final presentations and analyzed using conventional content analysis.
RESULTS: The groups were not equivalent at baseline: the intervention group reported higher perceived stress and lower resilience. Significant group × time interaction effects were found across all four outcomes, indicating that resilience, emotional self-awareness, and perceived university belonging increased, and perceived stress decreased, to a significantly greater degree in the intervention group than in the comparison group. Univariate interaction effect sizes were large (partial η2 =0.15-0.40), and all effects remained statistically significant after adjustment for baseline scores. Qualitative findings revealed four themes: focus on strength, not weakness; sharing, listening, and learning from each other; understanding yourself and understanding others; and transformational learning.
CONCLUSION: Participation in the CMCL strengths-based resilience program was associated with short-term improvements in self-reported perceived stress, resilience, emotional self-awareness, and perceived university belonging. The translated and contextually adapted program was feasible to deliver within the first-year curriculum. Because allocation followed intact class sections, baseline differences were present, and no attention-matched comparison condition or longer-term follow-up was included, the findings should be regarded as preliminary.

主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：基于优势的韧性干预对一年级护理学生的效果：短期结果的混合方法准实验评估
摘要：背景：护理学生在进入学术和临床培训的过渡期尤其容易遭受压力、焦虑和心理健康问题的困扰。基于优势的韧性干预已被证明能增强学生群体的应对能力和幸福感，但在非西方护理教育情境中的研究尚不充分。本研究以自我决定理论和社会生态学理论为基础，旨在检验“改变思维，改变生活”（CMCL）基于优势的韧性项目在非西方情境中一年级护理学生中的短期效果。方法：这项混合方法准实验研究纳入53名一年级护理学生，根据其现有班级分组被分配至干预组（n=27）或对照组（n=26）；每组各对应一个班级。干预组接受了为期五周、共10次课程的基于优势的韧性项目。定量结果在干预前后使用经验证的工具进行测量，包括：泰国版感知压力量表（T-PSS-10）、泰国版康纳-戴维森韧性量表（CD-RISC-25）、情绪自我意识量表（ESA）和感知凝聚力问卷（PCQ）。结果在五周项目开始前和结束后立即评估；未进行长期随访。采用重复测量多元方差分析及事后Bonferroni检验评估组别和时间效应，并以基线分数为协变量进行协方差分析作为敏感性分析。定性数据通过反思性写作和最终展示收集，并采用传统内容分析法进行分析。结果：两组在基线时并不等价：干预组报告了更高的感知压力和更低的韧性。所有四项结果均发现显著的组别×时间交互效应，表明干预组的韧性、情绪自我意识和感知大学归属感提升程度以及感知压力降低程度均显著大于对照组。单变量交互效应量较大（偏η²=0.15-0.40），且在调整基线分数后所有效应仍具有统计学显著性。定性研究发现四个主题：关注优势而非弱点；相互分享、倾听和学习；理解自己与理解他人；以及转化性学习。结论：参与CMCL基于优势的韧性项目与自我报告的感知压力、韧性、情绪自我意识和感知大学归属感的短期改善相关。该翻译并经情境化调整的项目可在一年级课程中可行实施。由于分组遵循完整班级划分，存在基线差异，且未包含注意力匹配对照组或长期随访，研究结果应视为初步结论。
关键词：韧性干预；护理学生；压力；情绪自我意识；心理健康

title: Utility of a Measure of Resilience As a Preoperative Screening Tool to Rule Out Elevated Psychological Symptom Burden.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Psychosocial health is an important predictor of surgical outcomes. Resilience, defined as the ability to "bounce back" from adversity, has been associated with various outcomes, but no consensus exists on measuring resilience in surgical populations. The Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale (CD-RISC), a widely used instrument, has not been explored in relation to other psychometric scales. This study compared CD-RISC with measures of psychological symptom burden to inform future evaluations of whether interventions that improve resilience also improve postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: This cross-sectional study analyzed secondary data from the baseline assessment within a larger randomized controlled trial, comprising 265 adults scheduled for major abdominal or pelvic surgery who completed preoperative research surveys, including the CD-RISC-10; Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) Anxiety, Depression, Sleep Disturbance short forms; and Pain Catastrophizing Scale (PCS). Patients were stratified into low, normal, and high resilience groups using ±1 standard deviation thresholds. Group differences were tested using multivariable analysis of variance (MANOVA) with follow-up analysis of variance (ANOVAs). Spearman's correlations quantified associations between resilience and symptom burden. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses evaluated whether CD-RISC scores predicted elevated symptom burden.
RESULTS: Multivariable analysis showed significant differences between CD-RISC strata across all measures (Pillai's trace = 0.29, F(8, 520) = 11.0, P < .001, = 0.15). Follow-up analyses revealed the strongest effects for anxiety (F(2, 262) = 38.8, P < .001, = 0.23) and depression (F(2, 262) = 39.4, P < .001, = 0.23), and modest effects for sleep disturbance (F(2, 262) = 10.9, P < .001, = 0.08) and pain catastrophizing (F(2, 262) = 10.9, P < .001, = 0.08). Spearman's correlations demonstrated moderate negative associations between resilience versus anxiety (ρ = -0.48 [-0.57 to -0.38], P < .001) and depression (ρ = -0.50 [-0.59 to -0.40], P < .001); and modest negative associations versus sleep disturbance (ρ = -0.30 [-0.42 to -0.18], P < .001) and pain catastrophization (ρ = -0.31 [-0.42 to -0.19], P < .001). CD-RISC showed fair discrimination for ruling out elevated symptom burden using a composite of PROMIS and PCS scores (area under the curve [AUC] = 0.71 [0.63-0.78], specificity = 0.86 [0.81-0.90], cutoff ≤28).
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative resilience measured with CD-RISC demonstrates moderate negative associations with measures of anxiety and depression in preoperative patients. CD-RISC could be used as a brief preoperative screening tool to rule out elevated psychological symptom burden. Future studies should assess whether perioperative interventions to increase resilience can positively influence recovery outcomes such as risk of persistent postoperative opioid use.
