标题：心理韧性测量作为术前筛查工具排除高心理症状负担的效用
摘要：背景：心理社会健康是手术结局的重要预测因素。心理韧性被定义为从逆境中“反弹”的能力，已与多种结局相关联，但在手术人群中测量心理韧性尚无共识。Connor-Davidson心理韧性量表（CD-RISC）是一种广泛使用的工具，但尚未与其他心理测量量表进行关联探索。本研究将CD-RISC与心理症状负担测量进行比较，为未来评估改善心理韧性的干预措施是否也能改善术后结局提供依据。方法：这项横断面研究分析了更大规模随机对照试验中基线评估的次要数据，包括265名计划接受大型腹部或盆腔手术的成人，他们完成了术前研究调查，包括CD-RISC-10、患者报告结局测量信息系统（PROMIS）焦虑、抑郁、睡眠障碍短表以及疼痛灾难化量表（PCS）。患者根据±1个标准差阈值分为低、正常和高心理韧性组。使用多变量方差分析（MANOVA）及后续方差分析（ANOVAs）检验组间差异。Spearman相关分析量化了心理韧性与症状负担之间的关联。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估CD-RISC评分是否能预测升高的症状负担。结果：多变量分析显示，CD-RISC分层在所有测量指标上均存在显著差异（Pillai's trace = 0.29，F(8, 520) = 11.0，P < .001，偏η² = 0.15）。后续分析显示焦虑（F(2, 262) = 38.8，P < .001，偏η² = 0.23）和抑郁（F(2, 262) = 39.4，P < .001，偏η² = 0.23）的效应最强，睡眠障碍（F(2, 262) = 10.9，P < .001，偏η² = 0.08）和疼痛灾难化（F(2, 262) = 10.9，P < .001，偏η² = 0.08）的效应中等。Spearman相关分析显示，心理韧性与焦虑（ρ = -0.48 [-0.57至-0.38]，P < .001）和抑郁（ρ = -0.50 [-0.59至-0.40]，P < .001）呈中等负相关；与睡眠障碍（ρ = -0.30 [-0.42至-0.18]，P < .001）和疼痛灾难化（ρ = -0.31 [-0.42至-0.19]，P < .001）呈轻度负相关。CD-RISC在使用PROMIS和PCS评分复合指标排除高症状负担方面显示出良好的判别能力（曲线下面积[AUC] = 0.71 [0.63-0.78]，特异度 = 0.86 [0.81-0.90]，截断值≤28）。结论：术前CD-RISC测量的心理韧性与术前患者的焦虑和抑郁测量呈中度负相关。CD-RISC可作为简短的术前筛查工具，用于排除升高的心理症状负担。未来研究应评估围手术期增强心理韧性的干预措施是否能积极影响恢复结局，如持续术后阿片类药物使用的风险。
关键词：心理韧性；术前筛查；心理症状负担；CD-RISC；术后结局

title: Individual-Level Modeling of Depressive Symptom Severity Using Smartphone and Wearable Data: Time-Aware 1-Year Study With Feature-Group Contributions.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Smartphones and wearables can continuously capture behavioral and physiological data in everyday life. Such mobile-sensing data may help track depressive symptoms more closely than occasional retrospective questionnaires, but prior findings have been mixed. Inconsistent findings do not preclude the presence of predictive relationships in specific individuals or time periods. In addition, it remains unclear which broader sensor domains, rather than single features, contribute most to prediction at the individual level.
OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study is to evaluate whether smartphone and wearable data improve prospective prediction of daily depressive symptom severity beyond a person-specific baseline and, where improvement is observed, to identify contributing sensor feature groups.
METHODS: Data from the MONDY (secure and open platform for AI-based health care apps) n-of-1 study were analyzed, including adults with recurrent major depressive disorder who provided up to 12 months of daily self-reported depressive symptom ratings, together with continuous smartphone and smartwatch data. To capture individual-specific patterns, separate participant-specific (idiographic) linear and nonlinear models were developed for each individual. Performance was evaluated using repeated temporally separated training and test periods against a person-specific baseline model predicting the mean symptom score from the training period. Explainability analyses were restricted to models showing improvement over baseline, and summarized at the level of sensor feature groups.
RESULTS: Among 11 participants with sufficient data, linear models improved predictive performance over the person-specific baseline in 8 (73%) participants, and nonlinear models did so in a different set of 8 (73%) participants. Improvements over the person-specific baseline, expressed as reductions in mean absolute error (change in mean absolute error relative to baseline), ranged from 0.05 to 1.23 points for linear models and from 0.12 to 1.07 points for nonlinear models on the adapted Patient Health Questionnaire-2 scale. Predictive performance varied substantially between individuals, and although nonlinear models exhibited greater aggregate feature-group contributions, this did not translate into a consistent overall predictive advantage over linear models. Feature-group importance profiles were heterogeneous, and no single sensor domain dominated across all participants.
CONCLUSIONS: Multimodal smartphone and wearable data can provide individual-specific predictive signals for daily depressive symptom severity in a subset of patients when evaluated under prospective, time-aware conditions. Both predictive performance and contributing sensor domains vary markedly across individuals, and no single modeling approach is uniformly superior. These findings suggest that previously reported associations in mobile-sensing research, often arising from heterogeneous study designs and feature representations, may not consistently translate into prospective prediction, and highlight the importance of evaluation frameworks that assess predictive signal at the temporal individual-participant level.

优先级：常规收录
标题：基于智能手机与可穿戴设备的个体层面抑郁症状严重程度建模：带特征组贡献的时间感知1年研究
摘要：背景：智能手机和可穿戴设备能够在日常生活中持续捕获行为与生理数据。此类移动感知数据可能比偶发的回顾性问卷更密切地追踪抑郁症状，但以往研究结果不一。不一致的发现并不排除在特定个体或时间段内存在预测关系的可能性。此外，目前尚不清楚哪些更广泛的传感器域（而非单一特征）在个体层面对预测贡献最大。目的：本研究旨在评估智能手机和可穿戴数据能否在个体特异性基线之外改善每日抑郁症状严重程度的预测，并在观察到改善时识别贡献显著的传感器特征组。方法：分析了MONDY（基于AI的医疗保健应用的安全开放平台）n-of-1研究数据，纳入患有复发性重度抑郁障碍的成人，提供长达12个月的每日自我报告抑郁症状评分，以及持续的智能手机和智能手表数据。为捕获个体特异性模式，为每名受试者分别开发了参与者特异性（个体化）线性和非线性模型。使用重复的时间分离训练与测试周期，以预测训练期平均症状评分的个体特异性基线模型为参照评估性能。可解释性分析仅限于较基线有改善的模型，并在传感器特征组层面进行汇总。结果：在11名数据充足的参与者中，线性模型在8名（73%）参与者中优于个体特异性基线的预测性能，非线性模型在另一组8名（73%）参与者中实现改善。相对于基线的改善以平均绝对误差的降低（较基线的平均绝对误差变化）表示，线性模型范围为0.05至1.23分，非线性模型范围为0.12至1.07分（基于改编版患者健康问卷-2量表）。预测性能在个体间差异显著；尽管非线性模型展现出更大的聚合特征组贡献，但这并未转化为相对于线性模型一致的整体预测优势。特征组重要性图谱呈异质性，没有任何单一传感器域在所有参与者中占主导地位。结论：在前瞻性、时间感知条件下评估时，多模态智能手机和可穿戴数据能够在部分患者中为每日抑郁症状严重程度提供个体特异性预测信号。预测性能和贡献传感器域在个体间差异显著，且没有任何单一建模方法普遍占优。这些发现表明，移动感知研究中既往报告的关联（往往源自异质性研究设计和特征表征）可能无法一致地转化为前瞻性预测，并凸显了在时间维度上的个体参与者层面评估预测信号的评价框架的重要性。
关键词：移动感知；抑郁症状；个体化建模；可穿戴设备；生态瞬时评估

title: Mapping PTSD across the symptom spectrum: Affective, emotion regulation and cumulative trauma predictors in Syrian refugees: A quantile regression approach.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: This study examined whether affective factors, emotion regulation strategies, cumulative trauma exposure, resilience and perceived social support are differentially associated with PTSD symptom severity across the symptom spectrum in Syrian refugees.
DESIGN: Cross-sectional study.
METHODS: Participants were 461 adult Syrian refugees residing in Türkiye (M = 41.54, SD = 12.08), of whom 73.5% (n = 339) were women. Quantile regression was used to examine whether associations with affective variables, emotion regulation strategies, cumulative trauma exposure, resilience and perceived social support varied across the PTSD symptom distribution.
RESULTS: Depression and anxiety were associated with PTSD symptoms across all quantiles, indicating that transdiagnostic affective distress is a stable correlate across the severity continuum. By contrast, emotion regulation strategies showed heterogeneous associations across symptom levels. Cognitive reappraisal demonstrated a stronger inverse association with PTSD at higher symptom levels, whereas expressive suppression was more strongly associated with severe symptoms. Type II traumas, reflecting repeated relational and identity-related adversities, were associated primarily with lower-to-moderate PTSD severity, whereas Type III traumas, reflecting chronic and ongoing stress exposure, were associated with moderate-to-severe symptom levels. Resilience and perceived social support were not independently associated with PTSD after accounting for emotional distress and cumulative trauma exposure.
CONCLUSIONS: The findings highlight the importance of considering symptom heterogeneity when examining PTSD in refugee populations. Emotion regulation processes and cumulative trauma exposure demonstrated severity-specific associations, suggesting that assessment and intervention planning may benefit from considering where individuals fall along the PTSD symptom continuum rather than relying solely on average population-level effects.

相关性：是
主题标签：["心理健康与数字心理干预"]
优先级：常规收录
标题：跨越症状谱系绘制PTSD图谱：叙利亚难民中的情感、情绪调节与累积创伤预测因素——一项分位数回归研究
摘要：目的：本研究考察了情感因素、情绪调节策略、累积创伤暴露、复原力和感知社会支持是否与叙利亚难民PTSD症状严重程度在症状谱系上存在差异性关联。设计：横断面研究。方法：参与者为461名居住在土耳其的成年叙利亚难民（M = 41.54，SD = 12.08），其中73.5%（n = 339）为女性。采用分位数回归考察情感变量、情绪调节策略、累积创伤暴露、复原力和感知社会支持与PTSD症状分布各分位点之间的关联是否有所不同。结果：抑郁和焦虑与PTSD症状在所有分位点均相关，表明跨诊断的情感困扰是贯穿严重程度连续体的稳定相关因素。相比之下，情绪调节策略在不同症状水平上表现出异质性关联。认知重评在较高症状水平上与PTSD呈更强的负向关联，而表达抑制则与严重症状的相关性更强。II型创伤（反映重复性的人际与身份相关逆境）主要与轻至中度PTSD严重程度相关，而III型创伤（反映慢性和持续性压力暴露）与中至重度症状水平相关。在控制了情绪困扰和累积创伤暴露后，复原力和感知社会支持与PTSD无独立关联。结论：研究结果强调了在难民群体中考察PTSD时考虑症状异质性的重要性。情绪调节过程和累积创伤暴露表现出严重程度特异性的关联，提示评估和干预规划可能受益于考虑个体在PTSD症状连续体中的位置，而非仅仅依赖总体平均水平效应。
关键词：PTSD；分位数回归；情绪调节；累积创伤；难民心理健康

title: Empirical evidence for gut microbial influence on human brain neurochemistry via the gut-brain axis.
summary: The gut microbiome produces metabolites with potential neuroactive properties, many of which act locally within the gut. While preclinical studies suggest these microbial pathways can influence cognitive and emotional processes, human evidence remains limited. This study investigates associations between gut microbiome-derived neuroactive functional potential and in vivo brain neurotransmitter concentrations in healthy young females. Using proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (¹H-MRS), we quantified GABA and glutamate levels in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC), anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), and inferior occipital gyrus (IOG). Parallel metagenomic profiling characterised microbial functional potential for pathways related to the synthesis and degradation of GABA, glutamate, short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), p-cresol, and inositol. Region-specific associations were observed between these microbial pathways and cortical GABA and glutamate levels, including excitatory/inhibitory (E/I) balance, a key marker of neuroplasticity and mental health. Notably, microbial glutamate degradation and inositol synthesis potential were associated with IOG E/I balance, while additional pathways including GABA metabolism, p-cresol production, and SCFA synthesis showed distinct associations across regions. Exploratory analyses also identified links between microbial functional potential and anxiety, depressive symptoms, and sleep quality. Together, these findings provide new human evidence that variation in microbial functional potential corresponds with regional cortical neurochemistry and psychological wellbeing, highlighting the gut-brain axis as a promising avenue for mechanistically informed microbiome-based- interventions.

标题：肠道微生物通过肠脑轴影响人类大脑神经化学的实证证据
摘要：肠道微生物组产生具有潜在神经活性的代谢物，其中许多在肠道内局部发挥作用。虽然临床前研究表明这些微生物通路可影响认知和情绪过程，但人类证据仍然有限。本研究调查了健康年轻女性中肠道微生物组来源的神经活性功能潜力与体内脑神经递质浓度之间的关联。利用质子磁共振波谱（¹H-MRS），我们量化了背外侧前额叶皮层（dlPFC）、前扣带回皮层（ACC）和枕下回（IOG）中的GABA和谷氨酸水平。平行宏基因组分析表征了与GABA、谷氨酸、短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、对甲酚和肌醇合成及降解通路相关的微生物功能潜力。在这些微生物通路与皮层GABA和谷氨酸水平之间观察到区域特异性关联，包括兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡——这是神经可塑性和心理健康的关键标志物。值得注意的是，微生物谷氨酸降解和肌醇合成潜力与IOG区E/I平衡相关，而包括GABA代谢、对甲酚产生和SCFA合成在内的其他通路在不同区域显示出不同的关联。探索性分析还发现了微生物功能潜力与焦虑、抑郁症状和睡眠质量之间的联系。综上所述，这些发现提供了新的人类证据，表明微生物功能潜力的变异与区域皮层神经化学和心理幸福感相对应，凸显了肠脑轴作为基于机制的微生物组干预措施的一个有前景的途径。
关键词：肠脑轴；神经递质；微生物组；心理健康；磁共振波谱

title: Prevalence of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms and associated factors among university students in Egypt: a cross-sectional study.
summary: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder that persists in adulthood, affecting academic performance and daily functioning. Despite its significance, limited research has explored the prevalence of ADHD-like symptoms among university students in Egypt. This study aims to estimate the prevalence of ADHD Symptoms among Egyptian university students and identify associated factors. A cross-sectional study was conducted using an online self-administered questionnaire among students aged ≥ 18 years or older from various Egyptian universities. The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS) was used to assess ADHD symptoms. A non-probability convenience sampling technique was applied, and multivariable logistic regression was performed to determine associated risks of ADHD positivity. A total of 3,136 responses were collected, with 2,383 valid responses included in the final analysis. The estimated prevalence of ADHD SYMPTOMS was 37.9% (95% CI: 36.0%-39.9%), obesity (OR = 2.09, 95% CI: 1.14-3.95, p = 0.019), smoking (OR = 1.93, 95% CI: 1.25-3.01, p = 0.003), sleep disorders (OR = 2.12, 95% CI: 1.77-2.55, p < 0.001), childhood trauma (OR = 1.42, 95% CI: 1.18-1.71, p < 0.001), and history of mental health conditions (OR = 1.71, 95% CI: 1.34-2.18, p < 0.001). Regular exercise was associated with lower odds of ADHD (OR = 0.55, 95% CI: 0.44-0.70, p < 0.001). Prevalence of ADHD-like symptoms among Egyptian university students is notably high, with multiple lifestyle and psychosocial factors showing significant associations with its occurrence. These findings highlight the need for increased awareness, early screening, and targeted interventions to support affected students. Future research should further investigate the cultural and educational influences on ADHD in Egypt.

标题：埃及大学生注意缺陷/多动障碍症状的患病率及其相关因素：一项横断面研究
摘要：注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）是一种常见的神经发育障碍，可持续至成年期，影响学业表现和日常功能。尽管其重要性显著，但关于埃及大学生中ADHD样症状患病率的研究仍十分有限。本研究旨在评估埃及大学生ADHD症状的患病率并识别其相关因素。研究采用横断面设计，通过在线自填问卷对来自埃及多所大学、年龄≥18岁的学生进行调查。使用成人ADHD自评量表（ASRS）评估ADHD症状。采用非概率便利抽样方法，并通过多变量逻辑回归分析确定ADHD阳性的相关风险因素。共收集3，136份问卷，其中2，383份有效问卷纳入最终分析。ADHD症状的估计患病率为37.9%（95% CI： 36.0%-39.9%），肥胖（OR = 2.09， 95% CI： 1.14-3.95， p = 0.019）、吸烟（OR = 1.93， 95% CI： 1.25-3.01， p = 0.003）、睡眠障碍（OR = 2.12， 95% CI： 1.77-2.55， p < 0.001）、童年创伤（OR = 1.42， 95% CI： 1.18-1.71， p < 0.001）及精神健康问题史（OR = 1.71， 95% CI： 1.34-2.18， p < 0.001）与ADHD症状显著相关。规律运动与ADHD风险降低相关（OR = 0.55， 95% CI： 0.44-0.70， p < 0.001）。埃及大学生中ADHD样症状的患病率显著较高，且多种生活方式和社会心理因素与其发生显著相关。这些发现提示需要提高认知、开展早期筛查并实施针对性干预以支持受影响学生。未来研究应进一步探讨埃及ADHD的文化与教育影响因素。
关键词：注意缺陷/多动障碍；大学生；患病率；心理健康；横断面研究

title: Machine learning classification of emotional videos via autonomic arousal based on pupil diameters, electrodermal activity and heart rate.
summary: We evaluated the ability of Electrodermal Activity (EDA), Heart Rate Variability (HRV), and Pupil Diameter (PD) to detect emotional states via machine learning to determine whether simple arousal metrics can distinguish complex emotional labels: Amusement, Awe, Disgust, Nurturant Love, and Sadness. In a laboratory session, participants (N = 47) selected the most appropriate emotional label out of five immediately after viewing 10 short videos. Classifications relied solely on the three psychophysiological measures and by applying three machine learning models: Support Vector Machine (SVM/SVC), Random Forest (RF), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Features included baseline-corrected average pupil diameter (PD) and electrodermal activity (EDA) peaks. Noisy heart rate variability (HRV) data were excluded to prevent signal-to-noise ratio degradation. PD reflects sympathetic noradrenergic activation and reciprocal coupling within the Autonomic Nervous System (ANS), providing a stable state estimate. In the core 'affect circumplex', SVC achieved peak accuracy, and PD achieved the highest feature importance score across architectures. Results revealed a many-to-one mapping where discrete valence states produced indistinguishable physiological signatures: high-arousal states (Amusement, Sadness) and low-arousal states (Awe, Disgust) were conflated. Notably, Awe triggered PD constriction, mirroring Disgust's profile. Tactical removal of the cardiovascular features significantly improved RF and XGBoost performance. These findings suggest that simple arousal metrics, and specifically pupillometry, can classify affect without using complex time-series analysis. Non-invasive sensors may facilitate the development of sensitive computerized systems calibrated to objective physiological data.

标题：基于瞳孔直径、皮肤电活动和心率通过自主神经唤醒进行情绪视频的机器学习分类
摘要：我们评估了皮肤电活动（EDA）、心率变异性（HRV）和瞳孔直径（PD）通过机器学习检测情绪状态的能力，以确定简单的唤醒指标能否区分复杂的情绪标签：愉悦、敬畏、厌恶、养育之爱和悲伤。在实验室环境中，参与者（N=47）在观看10个短视频后立即从五个选项中选择最合适的情绪标签。分类仅依赖这三种心理生理测量指标，并应用了三种机器学习模型：支持向量机（SVM/SVC）、随机森林（RF）和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）。特征包括基线校正后的平均瞳孔直径（PD）和皮肤电活动（EDA）峰值。噪声较大的心率变异性（HRV）数据被排除以避免信噪比退化。PD反映了交感神经去甲肾上腺素能激活及自主神经系统（ANS）内的交互耦合，提供了稳定的状态估计。在核心“情感环状模型”中，SVC达到了峰值准确率，PD在所有架构中获得了最高的特征重要性评分。结果揭示了一种多对一的映射关系，即不同的效价状态产生了难以区分的生理特征：高唤醒状态（愉悦、悲伤）和低唤醒状态（敬畏、厌恶）被混淆。值得注意的是，敬畏引发了瞳孔收缩，与厌恶的特征相似。战术性地移除心血管特征显著提升了RF和XGBoost的性能。这些发现表明，简单的唤醒指标——尤其是瞳孔测量——可以在不使用复杂时间序列分析的情况下对情感进行分类。非侵入式传感器可能有助于开发以客观生理数据校准的敏感计算机化系统。
关键词：机器学习分类；自主神经唤醒；瞳孔直径；皮肤电活动；情绪识别

title: [AI-Supported Systems in Mental Health Care: Digital Innovation or Loss of Human Care?].
summary: The increasing implementation of AI-supported systems in mental healthcare raises complex ethical, clinical, and societal questions. This manuscript examines the opportunities, risks, and limitations of such technologies, taking into account relational process factors as well as clinical outcomes and real-world conditions of care delivery. AI-supported systems can help bridge waiting times, provide low-threshold psychoeducational interventions, promote motivation, symptom stabilization, and treatment engagement, and facilitate access for underserved or difficult-to-reach patient populations. They offer flexible, location- and time-independent support, strengthen self-efficacy, and may help reduce stigma-related barriers. At the same time, several risks must be considered: potential limitations in the therapeutic alliance between patients and therapists, parasocial substitution, increased social isolation, the emergence of a potential two-tier healthcare system, and ethical challenges associated with unforeseen deteriorations in patients' conditions. Evidence-based studies, including randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses, demonstrate moderate but consistent improvements in symptoms of depression, anxiety, and loneliness, as well as positive effects in resource-limited settings and waiting-list contexts. The manuscript emphasizes that the effectiveness of AI systems can only be fully realized through their integration with human therapeutic support, ethical reflection, and appropriate structural implementation conditions. The aim is a differentiated, evidence-based, and ethically informed integration in which AI systems complement rather than replace the therapeutic relationship, thereby ensuring equitable access to care, quality of therapeutic relationships, and sustainable health outcomes alike.

优先级：常规收录
标题：心理健康照护中的AI支持系统：数字创新还是人文关怀的缺失？
摘要：AI支持系统在心理健康照护中的日益普及引发了复杂的伦理、临床和社会问题。本文考察了此类技术的机会、风险与局限性，兼顾关系性过程因素、临床结局及照护实施的真实世界条件。AI支持系统有助于缩短等待时间、提供低门槛的心理教育干预、促进动机、症状稳定和治疗参与，并改善服务不足或难以触及的患者群体的可及性。它们提供灵活、不受时空限制的支持，增强自我效能感，并可能有助于减少污名化相关障碍。与此同时，必须考虑若干风险：患者与治疗师之间治疗联盟的潜在局限、拟社会性替代、社会隔离加剧、潜在的双轨医疗体系的出现，以及与患者病情意外恶化相关的伦理挑战。包括随机对照试验和荟萃分析在内的循证研究表明，AI系统对抑郁、焦虑和孤独症状有中等但一致的改善，并在资源有限和等待名单情境中显示出积极效果。本文强调，AI系统的有效性只有通过与人类治疗支持、伦理反思和适当的结构性实施条件相结合才能充分实现。其目标是一种分化的、循证且符合伦理的整合方式，使AI系统补充而非替代治疗关系，从而同时保障照护的可及公平性、治疗关系质量与可持续的健康结局。
关键词：AI支持系统；心理健康照护；数字心理干预；治疗联盟；伦理

title: Estimating Longitudinal Changes in Workday Happiness From Daily Report Texts Among Employees: Retrospective Feasibility Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Workday happiness is associated with workplace performance and burnout, but frequent questionnaire-based assessment is burdensome in real-world workplace settings. Free-text daily reports may provide a lower-burden way to monitor day-to-day changes in workday happiness.
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to examine whether daily diary text can be used to estimate longitudinal within-person changes in workday happiness and explore text-related factors associated with model performance, such as average sentence length and lexical diversity.
METHODS: We collected free-text daily reports and self-reported workday happiness scores from employees in 2 Japanese companies. Company A provided training data from 92 participants over 2 months (1725 reports), and company B provided test data from 11 participants over 6 months (652 reports). We used 2 text-based approaches: a bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT)-based regression model trained on company A data and a locally deployed Japanese large language model (Llama) used in a zero-shot setting. Model performance was evaluated for each participant using the Pearson correlation coefficient between self-reported and estimated workday happiness scores, with r=0.40 used as a pragmatic feasibility benchmark. Mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) were also calculated on the original workday happiness scale from 0 to 10.
RESULTS: A total of 81.8% (9/11) of the participants met or exceeded the feasibility benchmark of r=0.40. Positive correlations were observed for 81.8% (9/11) of the participants; for 9.1% (1/11) of the participants, the correlation coefficient could not be calculated because the self-reported score remained constant, and 9.1% (1/11) showed a small negative correlation. Participant-level correlations ranged from -0.06 to 0.65 for the BERT model and from -0.05 to 0.81 for the local large language model. Error-based metrics also varied across participants: BERT MAE ranged from 1.04 to 2.78, and RMSE ranged from 1.25 to 3.50, whereas Llama MAE ranged from 0.76 to 4.39, and RMSE ranged from 1.06 to 4.64.
CONCLUSIONS: Our study suggests that daily report text supports low-burden, longitudinal estimation of individual-level workday happiness. However, performance varied across participants, and further work is needed to improve generalizability, reduce attrition, address possible measurement bias, and clarify appropriate workplace use.

相关性：是
主题标签：["EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量", "心理健康与数字心理干预"]
优先级：常规收录
标题：基于员工每日报告文本估算工作日幸福感的纵向变化：回顾性可行性研究
摘要：背景：工作日幸福感与工作表现和倦怠相关，但在真实工作环境中频繁进行问卷评估负担较重。自由文本的每日报告可能提供一种较低负担的方式来监测工作日幸福感的日常变化。
目的：本研究旨在检验每日日记文本是否可用于估算工作日幸福感的个体内纵向变化，并探讨与模型性能相关的文本因素，如平均句子长度和词汇多样性。
方法：我们收集了两家日本公司员工的自由文本每日报告和自我报告的工作日幸福感评分。A公司提供了92名参与者为期2个月的训练数据（1725份报告），B公司提供了11名参与者为期6个月的测试数据（652份报告）。我们使用了两种基于文本的方法：基于A公司数据训练的BERT回归模型，以及在零样本设置中使用的本地部署日语大语言模型（Llama）。模型性能通过自我报告与估算工作日幸福感评分之间的皮尔逊相关系数对每位参与者进行评估，以r=0.40作为实用可行性基准。同时计算了原始工作日幸福感量表（0至10分）上的平均绝对误差（MAE）和均方根误差（RMSE）。
结果：81.8%（9/11）的参与者达到或超过了r=0.40的可行性基准。81.8%（9/11）的参与者观察到正相关；9.1%（1/11）的参与者因自我报告评分保持不变而无法计算相关系数，9.1%（1/11）显示出较小的负相关。参与者水平的相关系数在BERT模型中为-0.06至0.65，在本地大语言模型中为-0.05至0.81。基于误差的指标也因参与者而异：BERT的MAE范围为1.04至2.78，RMSE范围为1.25至3.50；而Llama的MAE范围为0.76至4.39，RMSE范围为1.06至4.64。
结论：本研究表明，每日报告文本支持对个体水平工作日幸福感进行低负担的纵向估算。然而，性能因参与者而异，仍需进一步工作以提高泛化能力、减少流失、解决可能的测量偏差，并明确适当的工作场所应用场景。
关键词：工作日幸福感，文本分析，生态瞬时评估，大语言模型，纵向监测

title: Immediate and Sustained Improvements in Mood and Stress Associated With Yuna, an AI-Powered Digital Mental Health Intervention: Real-World Retrospective Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: AI-powered digital mental health interventions (DMHIs) are a promising approach to address barriers to traditional mental health care. However, real-world evidence of their immediate and sustained benefits remains limited.
OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this real-world, retrospective study is to explore patterns of perceived mood and stress change associated with the use of Yuna, an AI-powered DMHI. We aimed to (1) describe user demographics and session characteristics, (2) quantify the magnitude of mood and stress change within sessions and over time with continued Yuna use, and (3) identify session-level factors associated with changes in mood and stress.
METHODS: Adult Yuna users (aged ≥18 y) who initiated at least one session with the Yuna app were included in this study. Users self-reported mood and stress on Visual Analog Scales (VASs; range 0-1) before and after sessions. Linear mixed effects models were used to explore the immediate, within-session improvements in mood and stress, and the sustained, between-session changes in symptoms of mood and stress. Linear mixed effects models were also used to examine session-level predictors of within-session improvements, including baseline symptom severity, session duration, total number of unique therapeutic approaches used, safety guardrail activation, and gender.
RESULTS: A total of 5549 real-world users were included (2901/5549, 52.3% female; mean sessions 3.44, SD 9.83). Users demonstrated significant, immediate within-session improvements in both mood (d=0.55) and stress (d=0.56), with sensitivity analyses yielding consistent results. Between-session analyses revealed gradual improvements in baseline mood (d=-0.009) and stress (d=-0.011). Baseline symptom severity was the strongest predictor of immediate, within-session change (mood: β=.118, SE 0.003; P<.001; stress: β=.131, SE 0.004; P<.001), followed by session duration (mood: β=.027, SE 0.003; P=.003; stress: β=.029, SE 0.003; P<.001). A greater number of unique therapeutic approaches used was associated with smaller improvements in both outcomes (mood: β=-0.007, SE 0.003; P=.043; stress: β=-0.011, SE 0.003; P=.002).
CONCLUSIONS: Use of Yuna, an AI-powered DMHI, was associated with perceived within-session improvements in mood and stress, with preliminary evidence of gradual improvements in mood and stress across repeated sessions. However, the absence of a control group and potential selection bias preclude causal conclusions. These findings offer promising, real-world evidence for AI-powered DMHIs as accessible, on-demand support tools. Prospective, controlled designs are needed to establish causal effects and evaluate the sustainability of observed improvements.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：AI驱动的数字心理健康干预Yuna相关的情绪和压力即时及持续改善：真实世界回顾性研究
摘要：背景：AI驱动的数字心理健康干预（DMHI）是解决传统心理健康护理障碍的一种有前景的方法。然而，关于其即时和持续获益的真实世界证据仍然有限。目的：这项真实世界回顾性研究旨在探索与AI驱动的DMHI Yuna使用相关的感知情绪和压力变化模式。我们旨在：（1）描述用户人口统计学特征和会话特征，（2）量化会话内及持续使用Yuna过程中情绪和压力变化的幅度，以及（3）识别与会话内情绪和压力变化相关的会话层面因素。方法：纳入至少启动一次Yuna应用会话的成年用户（年龄≥18岁）。用户在会话前后通过视觉模拟量表（VAS；范围0-1）自我报告情绪和压力。采用线性混合效应模型探讨会话内情绪和压力的即时改善，以及会话间情绪和压力症状的持续变化。线性混合效应模型还用于检验会话内改善的会话层面预测因素，包括基线症状严重程度、会话时长、使用的独特治疗方法总数、安全护栏激活和性别。结果：共纳入5549名真实世界用户（女性2901/5549，占52.3%；平均会话次数3.44，标准差9.83）。用户在情绪（d=0.55）和压力（d=0.56）方面均表现出显著的即时会话内改善，敏感性分析结果一致。会话间分析显示基线性情绪（d=-0.009）和压力（d=-0.011）逐渐改善。基线症状严重程度是即时会话内变化的最强预测因素（情绪：β=.118，SE 0.003；P<.001；压力：β=.131，SE 0.004；P<.001），其次是会话时长（情绪：β=.027，SE 0.003；P=.003；压力：β=.029，SE 0.003；P<.001）。使用更多独特治疗方法与两种结局的较小改善相关（情绪：β=-0.007，SE 0.003；P=.043；压力：β=-0.011，SE 0.003；P=.002）。结论：使用AI驱动的DMHI Yuna与会话内感知的情绪和压力改善相关，并提供了跨重复会话情绪和压力逐渐改善的初步证据。然而，缺乏对照组和潜在的选择偏倚排除了因果结论。这些发现为AI驱动的DMHI作为可及、按需支持工具提供了有前景的真实世界证据。未来需要前瞻性、对照设计以确定因果效应并评估所观察改善的可持续性。
关键词：AI驱动的数字心理健康干预；情绪改善；压力缓解；真实世界研究；会话内变化

title: Closer, but less accurate: Relationship closeness and empathic accuracy in parent-adolescent dyads.
summary: Empathic accuracy (EA), the ability to correctly perceive another's emotional state, is crucial for emotional communication in parent-adolescent relationships. A total of 112 dyads (adolescent Mage = 14.13; 54.5% girls) participated in a 28-day daily diary study conducted between July 2022 and May 2023. We used the multilevel Actor-Partner Interdependence Model to assess how baseline and daily perceived closeness-reported by both parents and adolescents-predicted parent and adolescent EA in daily life. Results showed that greater perceived closeness predicted lower EA for both the perceiver and their partner, particularly for negative emotions. This is consistent with the motivated inaccuracy perspective: closeness may dampen attention to negative emotions to avoid relational discomfort. Conversely, on days when closeness was low, dyads exhibited greater EA, suggesting compensatory efforts to reconnect.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量
优先级：常规收录
标题：更亲密，但更不准确：亲子二元关系中关系亲密性与共情准确性
摘要：共情准确性（EA），即正确感知他人情绪状态的能力，对于亲子关系中的情绪沟通至关重要。共112对亲子（青少年平均年龄=14.13岁；54.5%为女孩）参与了2022年7月至2023年5月间进行的为期28天的每日日记研究。我们采用多层行动者-伴侣相互依赖模型，评估父母和青少年报告的基线及每日感知亲密性如何预测日常生活中父母和青少年的共情准确性。结果显示，感知亲密性越高，感知者及其伴侣的共情准确性越低，尤其对负面情绪而言。这与动机性不准确视角一致：亲密性可能会抑制对负面情绪的注意以避免关系不适。相反，在亲密性较低的时日，亲子表现出更高的共情准确性，提示存在弥补性情感修复的努力。
关键词：共情准确性；亲子关系；亲密性；每日日记；多层行动者-伴侣相互依赖模型

title: Parental Marital Conflict and Adolescent Academic Procrastination: Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia Reactivity Matters.
summary: The present study examined the association between parental marital conflict and adolescent academic procrastination, and the moderating role of baseline and reactive respiratory sinus arrhythmia. Participants included 346 Chinese middle school students (Mage = 12.50 years, SD = 0.62; 45.10% girls). Physiological data were captured to reflect participants' respiratory sinus arrhythmia (RSA) levels. Parental marital conflict and adolescent academic procrastination were assessed through adolescent reports. Results revealed that parental marital conflict and adolescents' RSA reactivity were interactively related to academic procrastination. Specifically, the positive association between parental marital conflict and academic procrastination was stronger among adolescents with lower (not higher) RSA reactivity. However, baseline RSA did not moderate the relation between marital conflict and academic procrastination. Findings highlight the buffering role of RSA reactivity in the association between parental marital conflict and adolescent academic procrastination.

优先级：常规收录
标题：父母婚姻冲突与青少年学业拖延：呼吸性窦性心律不齐反应性的作用
摘要：本研究考察了父母婚姻冲突与青少年学业拖延之间的关联，以及基线水平和反应性呼吸性窦性心律不齐的调节作用。参与者为346名中国中学生（平均年龄12.50岁，标准差0.62；45.10%为女生）。研究者采集生理数据以反映参与者的呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）水平。父母婚姻冲突和青少年学业拖延通过青少年自我报告进行测量。结果显示，父母婚姻冲突与青少年RSA反应性交互作用于学业拖延。具体而言，父母婚姻冲突与学业拖延之间的正向关联在RSA反应性较低（而非较高）的青少年中更为显著。然而，基线RSA并未调节婚姻冲突与学业拖延之间的关系。研究结果凸显了RSA反应性在父母婚姻冲突与青少年学业拖延关联中的缓冲作用。
关键词：父母婚姻冲突；学业拖延；呼吸性窦性心律不齐；反应性；青少年

title: Group and online application of the Unified Protocol in Argentina: controlled pilot study.
summary: Emotional disorders (ED), including anxiety and depression, are highly prevalent in Argentina and share dysfunctional emotional regulation mechanisms. The Unified Protocol (UP) is a transdiagnostic intervention designed to address these common processes. This is the first randomized controlled trial (RCT) to evaluate its effectiveness on a group and online format in the Argentinian population. A parallel-group RCT was conducted with 39 participants (mean age = 33.54; 67% women) diagnosed with various EDs according to DSM-5 criteria. Subjects were randomly assigned to a treatment group (n = 22), which received 10 90-min sessions of the UP, or to a waiting list control group (n = 23). Mixed linear models assessed changes in emotional dysregulation (DERS), anxiety (BAI), depression (BDI-II), hopelessness (BHS), affect (PANAS), neuroticism (IPIP-FFM), mindfulness (MAAS), and quality of life (MQLI). At post-treatment (week 10), the intervention group showed significant improvements across all outcomes compared with controls. Significant reductions were observed in emotional dysregulation, anxiety, depression, hopelessness, neuroticism, and negative affect, alongside increases in positive affect, mindfulness, and quality of life. Participants reported high satisfaction and perceived usefulness. Findings support the effectiveness and acceptability of the UP group online format in the Argentine context, facilitating the scalability of evidence-based treatments.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：阿根廷统一方案的小组及在线应用：对照试点研究
摘要：情绪障碍（ED），包括焦虑和抑郁，在阿根廷高度流行，并共享功能失调的情绪调节机制。统一方案（UP）是一种跨诊断干预，旨在针对这些共同过程。这是首个在阿根廷人群中评估其小组及在线形式有效性的随机对照试验（RCT）。研究采用平行组RCT设计，共纳入39名根据DSM-5标准诊断为各类情绪障碍的参与者（平均年龄=33.54岁；67%为女性）。受试者被随机分配至治疗组（n=22），接受10次每次90分钟的UP干预，或等候名单对照组（n=23）。混合线性模型评估了情绪失调（DERS）、焦虑（BAI）、抑郁（BDI-II）、无助感（BHS）、情感（PANAS）、神经质（IPIP-FFM）、正念（MAAS）和生活质量（MQLI）的变化。在治疗结束后（第10周），干预组在所有结局指标上均较对照组显示出显著改善。情绪失调、焦虑、抑郁、无助感、神经质和负性情感显著降低，同时正性情感、正念和生活质量显著提升。参与者报告了较高的满意度和感知有用性。研究结果支持UP小组在线形式在阿根廷情境下的有效性和可接受性，有助于循证治疗的可扩展性。
关键词：统一方案；情绪障碍；在线干预；情绪调节；跨诊断治疗

title: Development and Validation of the Digital Mentalizing Questionnaire: A Multidimensional Self-Report for Online Social Networks.
summary: Digital interactions are increasingly central to human social life, yet existing measures of mentalizing-defined as the capacity to interpret one's own and others' mental states-are primarily designed for face-to-face contexts and fail to capture the unique cognitive-affective demands of online social networks. This research introduces the Digital Mentalizing Questionnaire (DMQ), the first multidimensional, theory-driven instrument specifically developed to assess mentalizing processes in digital environments. Across three studies (N1 = 278, N2 = 375, N3 = 341; participants in Studies 1, 2, and 3 were predominantly female adults with mean ages of 32.95 [SD = 12.10] and 30.89 [SD = 10.68] years, respectively, and varied educational backgrounds), the DMQ demonstrated a robust five-factor structure encompassing Digital Self-Mentalizing, Digital Other-Mentalizing, Digital Emotion Regulation, Digital Anticipatory Mentalizing, and Digital Identity Integration. Exploratory factor analysis (Study 1) and confirmatory factor analysis confirmed structural validity, while internal consistency (α = .67-.86), composite reliability, and 1-month test-retest reliability (r = .58-.79) indicated strong psychometric stability. Measurement invariance across gender further confirmed the scale's applicability for comparative research (Study 2). Convergent validity was supported through theoretically coherent correlations with established mentalizing measures (Reflective Functioning Questionnaire, Mentalization Questionnaire, Mentalization Emotion Questionnaire, Bergen Social Media Addiction Scale) and negative associations with transdiagnostic psychopathology indicators (Study 3). The DMQ offers a validated, ecologically relevant framework for assessing digital mentalizing, bridging classical theory with contemporary online social cognition. Its application holds promise for advancing cyberpsychology research, informing digital well-being interventions, and understanding the socio-cognitive mechanisms underlying online behavior.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：数字心智化问卷的编制与验证：一项针对在线社交网络的多维自评工具
摘要：数字互动日益成为人类社会生活的核心，然而现有对心智化（即解释自身及他人心理状态的能力）的测量主要针对面对面情境设计，未能捕捉在线社交网络中独特的认知-情感需求。本研究引入了数字心智化问卷（DMQ），这是首个专门用于评估数字环境中心智化过程的多维、理论驱动工具。通过三项研究（N1=278，N2=375，N3=341；研究1、2和3的参与者以女性成年人为主，平均年龄分别为32.95岁[SD=12.10]和30.89岁[SD=10.68]，教育背景多样），DMQ展现出稳健的五因子结构，涵盖数字自我心智化、数字他人心智化、数字情绪调节、数字预期心智化和数字身份整合。探索性因子分析（研究1）和验证性因子分析确认了结构效度，而内部一致性（α=.67-.86）、组合信度和1个月重测信度（r=.58-.79）表明其具有良好的心理测量稳定性。跨性别的测量不变性进一步确认了该量表在比较研究中的适用性（研究2）。聚合效度通过与既有心智化测量工具（反思功能问卷、心智化问卷、心智化情绪问卷、卑尔根社交媒体成瘾量表）的理论一致相关，以及与跨诊断精神病理学指标的负向关联得到支持（研究3）。DMQ为评估数字心智化提供了一个经过验证且具有生态效度的框架，将经典理论与当代在线社会认知相衔接。其应用有望推进网络心理学研究、为数字幸福感干预提供依据，并加深对在线行为背后的社会认知机制的理解。
关键词：数字心智化；在线社交网络；心理测量；数字幸福感；自我报告

title: Emotion Regulation is Associated with Symptoms of Racial Trauma Among Minoritized People.
summary: Race-based traumatic stress (RBTS) can develop after prolonged exposure to racial discrimination and shares similar symptoms to post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). However, there is a scarcity of research investigating specific psychological processes associated with RBTS that may inform intervention development. As PTSD and RBTS have shared symptomology, it is possible that psychological processes implicated in PTSD may also be implicated in RBTS. The current study examined if mindfulness, distress tolerance, and emotion regulation difficulties were significantly associated with RBTS symptoms in a sample of racially diverse participants. Both undergraduate (n = 97) and online (n = 123) participants from minoritized racial backgrounds completed an online battery of measures that included measures of RBTS symptoms, mindfulness, distress tolerance, and emotion regulation difficulties. Results indicated that only emotion regulation difficulties were significantly associated with RBTS symptoms. The specific elements of emotion regulation difficulties that were associated with RBTS symptoms were lack of emotional clarity and lack of emotional awareness. Post hoc mediation analyses revealed that emotion regulation difficulties mediated the relationship between distress tolerance and RBTS symptoms and the relationship between mindfulness and RBTS symptoms. Our finding that distress tolerance and mindfulness were not associated with RBTS symptoms suggests possible discrepancies in the mechanisms underlying RBTS and PTSD. Furthermore, our findings suggest that interventions that focus on improving emotion regulation difficulties, specifically emotional clarity and emotional acceptance, may represent effective interventions for RBTS.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：["心理健康与数字心理干预"]
优先级：常规收录
标题：情绪调节与少数族裔群体种族创伤症状的关联
摘要：基于种族的创伤应激（RBTS）可在长期暴露于种族歧视后发展形成，其症状与创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）相似。然而，目前关于与RBTS相关的具体心理过程的研究甚少，而这些过程可能为干预开发提供信息。由于PTSD与RBTS具有共同症状学特征，PTSD相关心理过程也可能与RBTS相关。本研究在种族多样化的参与者样本中考察了正念、痛苦耐受和情绪调节困难是否与RBTS症状显著相关。来自少数族裔背景的本科生（n=97）和在线参与者（n=123）完成了一系列在线测量，包括RBTS症状、正念、痛苦耐受和情绪调节困难的量表。结果表明，仅情绪调节困难与RBTS症状显著相关。与RBTS症状相关的情绪调节困难的具体维度为情绪清晰度缺乏和情绪觉察缺乏。事后中介分析显示，情绪调节困难中介了痛苦耐受与RBTS症状之间以及正念与RBTS症状之间的关系。我们发现痛苦耐受和正念与RBTS症状无显著关联，提示RBTS与PTSD的潜在机制可能存在差异。此外，我们的发现表明，聚焦于改善情绪调节困难（特别是情绪清晰度和情绪接纳）的干预措施可能是RBTS的有效干预方法。
关键词：种族创伤应激；情绪调节困难；正念；痛苦耐受；心理干预

title: A systematic review of state loneliness in daily life using intensive longitudinal methods.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Loneliness, including its associations with mental health, is recognised as a major global public health concern. While much research has focused on chronic loneliness, state loneliness - experienced in moment-to-moment contexts - remains underexplored. This gap is important, as daily experiences may provide critical opportunities for intervention. Intensive data collection approaches such as Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA), Experience Sampling Method (ESM) and Daily Diary are well-suited for moment-to-moment capture and a review of their use for illuminating loneliness would be valuable for characterizing the state of the art and identifying gaps. This review thus synthesised findings from the intensive data collection approach to explore factors that may influence state loneliness and its consequences for mental health/well-being across all ages, providing valuable insights for targeted interventions.
METHOD: This review follows the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA). Four databases (PsycINFO, PubMed, Web of Science, and EMBASE) were searched from inception to 25th May 2026. Abstracts and full texts were screened, and the quality of the included studies was assessed. Data extraction was conducted independently by two reviewers.
RESULTS: One hundred and seventeen studies were included in this review, addressing measurement practices and quality (RQ1-2), predictors and correlates of state loneliness (RQ3), and mental health and wellbeing outcomes (RQ4). State loneliness was predominantly assessed using single items with varied response formats; most items met expert-based formulation criteria, though empirical psychometric evidence was rarely reported. Associations were observed between state loneliness and mental health outcomes (e.g., internalising, suicidality) and social interaction, with several studies reporting effects in both directions, though the nature of these associations varied with study design and analytic approach. Other factors, including physical health, age, and gender, were also linked to state loneliness.
DISCUSSION: Taken together, the review provides an improved understanding of the factors that may influence loneliness and its consequences for mental health/well-being. The results of the review could help to inform targeted prevention and intervention strategies for all age ranges, facilitating the mitigation of loneliness.

主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量；心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：重点推荐
标题：采用密集纵向方法对日常生活中状态孤独感的系统综述
摘要：背景：孤独感，包括其与心理健康的关联，已被视为一个重大的全球公共卫生问题。尽管大量研究聚焦于慢性孤独感，但在即时情境中体验到的状态孤独感仍未得到充分探索。这一空白至关重要，因为日常体验可能为干预提供关键机会。生态瞬时评估（EMA）、经验取样法（ESM）和日常日记等密集数据收集方法非常适合即时捕捉，对其在揭示孤独感方面的应用进行综述，将有助于刻画当前研究现状并识别研究空白。本综述综合了密集数据收集方法的研究发现，探讨可能影响状态孤独感的因素及其对各年龄段人群心理健康/幸福感的后果，为针对性干预提供有价值的见解。方法：本综述遵循系统综述和荟萃分析首选报告条目（PRISMA）。检索了四个数据库（PsycINFO、PubMed、Web of Science 和 EMBASE），检索时间从建库至2026年5月25日。对摘要和全文进行筛选，并评估纳入研究的质量。数据提取由两名评审员独立完成。结果：本综述纳入117项研究，涵盖测量实践与质量（研究问题1-2）、状态孤独感的预测因素与相关因素（研究问题3）以及心理健康与幸福感结局（研究问题4）。状态孤独感主要采用单一条目并以多样的反应格式进行评估；大多数条目符合专家制定的表述标准，但经验性心理测量学证据鲜有报告。状态孤独感与心理健康结局（如内化问题、自杀倾向）和社会互动之间存在关联，多项研究报告了双向效应，但这些关联的性质因研究设计和分析方法而异。其他因素，包括身体健康、年龄和性别，也与状态孤独感存在关联。讨论：总体而言，本综述增进了对可能影响孤独感的因素及其对心理健康/幸福感后果的理解。综述结果有助于为各年龄段的针对性预防和干预策略提供信息，促进孤独感的缓解。
关键词：状态孤独感；生态瞬时评估；经验取样法；密集纵向测量；心理健康

title: Investigating the mobile messenger app-based intervention delivered by a therapeutic companion agent for young adults with depressive symptoms: A proof-of-concept and quasi-experimental study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Despite the clinical potential of digital interventions for young adults with depression, low engagement remains a persistent challenge. A conversational therapeutic companion agent (TCA) can foster a digital therapeutic alliance to address this barrier.
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop a Wizard-of-Oz TCA prototype integrating behavioral activation, ecological momentary assessment/intervention (EMA/EMI), and gamification, and to evaluate its proof-of-concept feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary clinical efficacy for young adults with depressive symptoms.
METHODS: 58 Korean young adults ages 20 to 39 (50.0% female) with subclinical to moderately severe depressive symptoms (Patient Health Questionnaire-9) were recruited. The intervention group (n=29) interacted with the TCA for six weeks, while a frequency-matched passive control group (n=29) continued usual routines. Primary outcomes were feasibility (adherence) and acceptability (satisfaction). Secondary outcomes for efficacy (Beck Depression Inventory-II, Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7, Quality-of-Life Enjoyment and Satisfaction Questionnaire-Short Form) were assessed biweekly.
RESULTS: Of 58 participants, 57 completed the study. The intervention proved feasible, acceptable, and usable, achieving 69.5% strict on-time EMA adherence, 66.2% behavioral activation routine completion, a mean daily satisfaction of 3.49/5.0, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 74.02, meeting a priori benchmarks. Exploratory analyses indicated the intervention group showed significantly greater reductions in depressive symptoms and improvements in quality of life compared to controls.
CONCLUSIONS: The TCA-based intervention is feasible and acceptable, successfully cultivating a digital therapeutic alliance. While preliminary clinical signals are promising, future fully powered randomized controlled trials are required to definitively establish clinical efficacy.

标题：基于移动即时通讯应用的治疗性陪伴代理对青年抑郁症状的干预研究：概念验证与准实验研究
摘要：背景：尽管数字干预对青年抑郁症具有临床潜力，但低参与度仍是持续挑战。对话式治疗性陪伴代理（TCA）可通过建立数字治疗联盟来应对这一障碍。目的：本研究旨在开发一个整合行为激活、生态瞬时评估/干预（EMA/EMI）和游戏化元素的Wizard-of-Oz TCA原型，并评估其对青年抑郁症状的概念验证可行性、可接受性和初步临床疗效。方法：招募58名年龄20至39岁（50.0%女性）的韩国青年，其抑郁症状处于亚临床至中度严重水平（患者健康问卷-9）。干预组（n=29）与TCA互动六周，而频率匹配的被动对照组（n=29）维持日常常规。主要结局为可行性（依从性）和可接受性（满意度）。次要疗效结局（贝克抑郁量表-II、广泛性焦虑障碍-7、生活质量享受与满意度问卷-简版）每两周评估一次。结果：58名参与者中，57人完成研究。干预被证明可行、可接受且可用，实现了69.5%的严格按时EMA依从率、66.2%的行为激活常规完成率、平均每日满意度3.49/5.0，以及平均系统可用性量表（SUS）得分74.02，均达到预设基准。探索性分析表明，与对照组相比，干预组在抑郁症状减轻和生活质量改善方面表现出显著更大幅度的变化。结论：基于TCA的干预可行且可接受，成功培育了数字治疗联盟。虽然初步临床信号令人鼓舞，但未来需要充分把握度的随机对照试验以确证临床疗效。
关键词：生态瞬时评估；生态瞬时干预；数字心理干预；治疗性陪伴代理；青年抑郁

title: Comparison of Therapist-Guided Versus Self-Guided Internet-Based Stress Inoculation Therapy (ISIT) on Psychological Distress Symptoms in Women After Miscarriage in Iran: A Study Protocol of a Randomized Clinical Trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Miscarriage can lead to various psychological consequences such as grief, anxiety, depression, and psychological distress. Although women who experience a miscarriage may not have formed a bond with their unborn child, the intensity of grief following an abortion does not significantly differ from the loss of other first-degree relatives. The present study will be conducted to compare therapist-guided versus self-guided internet-based stress inoculation therapy (ISIT) on psychological distress symptoms in women after miscarriage.
METHODS: This study will be a randomized clinical trial with two parallel groups, conducted on 100 women with a history of miscarriage who are referred to prenatal clinics of educational hospitals affiliated with Babol University of Medical Sciences. Participants will be randomly assigned to two intervention groups. The first group will receive therapist-guided intervention (50 participants), consisting of 6 sessions of ISIT along with 20-25 min of weekly online counseling. The second group will receive a self-guided intervention (50 participants), consisting of only 6 sessions of ISIT without therapist guidance. The content of the SIT sessions includes techniques such as relaxation, cognitive restructuring, conceptualization, problem-solving, exercises, cognitive-behavioral methods, and stress coping. Data will be collected using demographic-reproductive characteristics questionnaires, brief symptom inventory-18 (BSI-18), and Perinatal Grief Scale at three time intervals: before the intervention, immediately after the intervention, and 3 months after the intervention. Data analysis will be performed using independent t-tests, Chi-square tests, and repeated measures analysis of variance with SPSS software version 23.
RESULTS: It is expected that the study will yield anticipated outcomes in reducing psychological distress symptoms among women following a spontaneous abortion. It is also anticipated that counseling based on this model will reduce perinatal grief during follow-ups conducted immediately post-intervention and 3 months after the intervention concludes.
CONCLUSION: The positive results of ISIT counseling on psychological distress symptoms and reducing perinatal grief during follow-ups conducted immediately post-intervention and 3 months after the intervention suggest that it will be useful for managing the complications of spontaneous abortion. Trial Registration: This trial is prospectively registered on August 25, 2025, at the Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT20230130057274N6).

标题：伊朗流产后女性治疗师引导与自助引导的网络压力接种疗法（ISIT）对心理困扰症状影响的比较：一项随机临床试验研究方案
摘要：背景与目的：流产可导致悲伤、焦虑、抑郁和心理困扰等多种心理后果。尽管经历流产的女性可能尚未与未出生的孩子建立情感联结，但流产后悲伤的强度与失去其他一级亲属相比并无显著差异。本研究将比较治疗师引导与自助引导的网络压力接种疗法（ISIT）对流产后女性心理困扰症状的影响。方法：本研究为一项两平行组的随机临床试验，研究对象为100名有流产史、转诊至巴博勒医科大学附属教学医院产前门诊的女性。参与者将被随机分配到两个干预组。第一组接受治疗师引导的干预（50名参与者），包括6次ISIT课程及每周20-25分钟的在线咨询。第二组接受自助引导的干预（50名参与者），仅包括6次ISIT课程，无治疗师指导。SIT课程内容包括放松、认知重构、概念化、问题解决、练习、认知行为方法和压力应对等技术。数据将通过人口学-生殖特征问卷、简易症状量表-18（BSI-18）和围产期悲伤量表在三个时间点收集：干预前、干预后立即及干预后3个月。数据分析将使用独立t检验、卡方检验和重复测量方差分析，采用SPSS软件版本23。结果：预期研究将在减少自然流产后女性心理困扰症状方面产生预期效果。同时预期基于该模型的咨询将在干预后立即及干预结束后3个月的随访中减少围产期悲伤。结论：ISIT咨询对心理困扰症状和减少围产期悲伤的积极结果（在干预后立即及干预结束后3个月的随访中）表明，它将有助于管理自然流产的并发症。试验注册：本试验于2025年8月25日在伊朗临床试验注册中心前瞻性注册（IRCT20230130057274N6）。
关键词：网络压力接种疗法；流产；心理困扰；围产期悲伤；数字心理干预

title: Smartphone-Delivered MBRP and Quality of Life among Individuals With Opioid Use Disorder: A Pilot Before-After Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention (MBRP) combines mindfulness practice with relapse-prevention strategies and has demonstrated efficacy in improving psychological well-being among individuals with substance use disorders. This pilot study evaluated quality-of-life changes following an audio-based mobile MBRP application delivered as an adjunct to methadone maintenance treatment (MMT) among individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-arm before-after study included 14 male participants with OUD receiving MMT at two addiction treatment clinics. Participants used the MBRP application for 8 weeks alongside routine care. Quality of life was assessed using the SF-36 at baseline, post-intervention, and 3-month follow-up. Session completion was monitored through weekly clinician-verified contacts. Substance use and relapse status were monitored descriptively as secondary clinical indicators.
RESULTS: Mean SF-36 scores increased from 40.34 ± 11.26 at baseline to 66.57 ± 13.39 post-intervention and remained above baseline at follow-up (57.76 ± 10.89). Significant improvements were observed from baseline to post-intervention (mean difference = 26.23, 95% CI: 17.73-34.73, p < 0.001, Cohen's dz = 1.78) and from baseline to follow-up (mean difference = 17.42, 95% CI: 11.84-22.99, p < 0.001, Cohen's dz = 1.80). Session-completion rate was 92.9% (mean = 7.43 sessions per participant). At follow-up, 11 participants (78.6%) remained free of documented illicit opioid use; three (21.4%) had documented relapse events, reported descriptively given the uncontrolled design.
CONCLUSION: Participation in the mobile MBRP application was associated with quality-of-life improvements remaining above baseline at 3-month follow-up, supporting feasibility in routine addiction-treatment settings. Randomized controlled trials with addiction-specific outcomes, standardized acceptability instruments, and objective engagement analytics are needed to establish effectiveness.

标题：智能手机递送的MBRP干预与阿片类药物使用障碍患者生活质量的关系：一项前后对照先导研究
摘要：背景：正念防复发（MBRP）将正念练习与防复发策略相结合，已被证明在改善物质使用障碍患者的心理健康方面具有疗效。本先导研究评估了以美沙酮维持治疗（MMT）辅助治疗形式递送的音频移动MBRP应用程序，对阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）患者生活质量变化的影响。材料与方法：本单臂前后对照研究纳入了来自两家成瘾治疗诊所的14名接受MMT的男性OUD患者。参与者在常规治疗的基础上使用MBRP应用程序8周。采用SF-36在基线、干预后和3个月随访时评估生活质量。通过每周临床医生核实的接触记录监测疗程完成情况。物质使用和复发状态作为次要临床指标进行描述性监测。结果：SF-36平均得分从基线的40.34±11.26上升至干预后的66.57±13.39，并在随访时仍高于基线水平（57.76±10.89）。从基线到干预后（平均差异=26.23，95% CI：17.73-34.73，p<0.001，Cohen's dz=1.78）以及从基线到随访（平均差异=17.42，95% CI：11.84-22.99，p<0.001，Cohen's dz=1.80）均观察到显著改善。疗程完成率为92.9%（每名参与者平均完成7.43次疗程）。随访时，11名参与者（78.6%）未出现记录的非法阿片类药物使用；3名（21.4%）有记录的复发事件，鉴于非对照设计仅作描述性报告。结论：参与移动MBRP应用程序与生活质量改善相关，且3个月随访时仍高于基线水平，支持其在常规成瘾治疗环境中的可行性。未来需采用具有成瘾特异性结局指标的随机对照试验、标准化可接受性工具和客观参与度分析来确证其有效性。

title: Maladaptive exercise: the hidden role of physical activity and sport professionals in the early detection of eating disorders.
summary: Eating disorders (EDs) are a significant public health concern, particularly among adolescents and young adults. While physical activity (PA) is generally health-promoting, maladaptive exercise, characterized by compulsive and excessive activity linked to weight control, is often a core feature of ED pathology. Despite the high prevalence of these conditions, early identification remains a critical challenge, as most cases are detected only after severe organic or psychiatric complications. PA and sport professionals, such as personal trainers and coaches, are uniquely positioned to observe early warning signs due to their frequent direct contact with at-risk individuals. This Comment, developed within the European ERASMUS+ Sport project "My Fit Friend", proposes a practical framework for equipping PA and sport professionals with tools for early detection in youths aged 11-18 years, including a structured observational diary and simulation-based training using avatar interactions. These tools allow those professionals to act as "informed sentinels", identifying fractures in global functioning and facilitating timely referrals while maintaining clear professional boundaries. We argued that integrating standardized educational interventions and observational tools into European sport policy is pivotal to bridge the gap between the gym floor and clinical intervention, transforming recreational settings into protective environments for youth mental health.

标题：适应性不良运动：体育与运动专业人员在进食障碍早期发现中的隐藏作用
摘要：进食障碍（EDs）是一项重大的公共卫生问题，尤其在青少年和年轻成人群体中。虽然体育活动（PA）总体上有利于健康，但适应性不良运动——以与体重控制相关的强迫性和过度运动为特征——往往是进食障碍病理的核心表现之一。尽管这些疾病发病率较高，但早期识别仍是关键挑战，因为大多数病例仅在出现严重器质性或精神科并发症后才被发现。体育与运动专业人员（如私人教练和教练员）因其与高风险个体频繁直接接触，处于观察早期预警信号的独特位置。本评论基于欧洲ERASMUS+体育项目“My Fit Friend”撰写，提出一个实用框架，旨在为体育与运动专业人员提供面向11-18岁青少年早期检测的工具，包括结构化观察日记和基于虚拟化身互动的模拟训练。这些工具使专业人员能够充当“知情哨兵”，识别整体功能中的断裂，并在保持明确职业边界的同时促进及时转诊。我们认为，将标准化教育干预和观察工具纳入欧洲体育政策，对于弥合健身房与临床干预之间的鸿沟、将休闲运动场所转变为青少年心理健康的保护性环境至关重要。

title: Baseline emotional distress predicts psychological response to a social media reduction intervention in distressed youth: a precision mental health approach.
summary: Reducing social media use (SMU) leads to small reductions in anxiety and depressive symptoms. However, most studies have been conducted with healthy populations, which may limit observed effects due to floor effects rather than indicating a weak causal link. Youth with elevated anxiety and depression symptoms may be more vulnerable to social media harms and benefit more from reduction, but experimental evidence remains limited for symptomatic samples. The present study examined whether youth with elevated symptoms of anxiety and depression show greater psychological benefits from reducing SMU compared to those with sub-threshold symptoms. A total of 218 out of 260 participants who were randomized to an intervention (reduce SMU to 1 h/day) or control group (no SMU restriction) for three weeks were analysed. Depressive and anxiety symptoms were assessed using CES-D and GAD-7 scales, respectively. At baseline, 75% and 46% of the sample scored above the clinical thresholds for elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms, respectively. Mixed models indicated that baseline anxiety levels moderated the intervention response. Participants above the clinical threshold exhibited significantly greater and clinically meaningful reduction in anxiety symptoms relative to controls compared to those below the threshold. Baseline depressive symptoms severity did not moderate intervention response. Results underscore the strong causal relationship between SMU and anxiety symptoms and suggest that reducing SMU may represent a potential component in the management of anxiety disorders in youth. The intervention reduced depressive symptoms overall, but findings on baseline symptom severity as a moderator of response were inconclusive and require replication.

优先级：常规收录
标题：基线情绪困扰预测社交媒体减少干预下青少年的心理反应：一种精准心理健康方法
摘要：减少社交媒体使用（SMU）可小幅降低焦虑和抑郁症状。然而，大多数研究是在健康人群中进行的，这可能因地板效应而限制了观察到的效果，而非表明因果关联较弱。具有较高焦虑和抑郁症状的青少年可能更容易受到社交媒体的危害，并可能从减少使用中获益更多，但针对有症状样本的实验证据仍然有限。本研究考察了与亚阈值症状的青少年相比，具有较高焦虑和抑郁症状的青少年是否在减少SMU中获得更大的心理获益。在随机分配至干预组（将SMU减少至每天1小时）或对照组（不限制SMU）为期三周的260名参与者中，共分析了218名。抑郁和焦虑症状分别采用CES-D和GAD-7量表进行评估。在基线时，分别有75%和46%的样本得分高于临床阈值，表明存在较高的抑郁和焦虑症状。混合模型显示，基线焦虑水平调节了干预反应。高于临床阈值的参与者相对于对照组表现出显著且具有临床意义的焦虑症状减轻，其效果优于低于阈值的参与者。基线抑郁症状严重程度并未调节干预反应。研究结果强调SMU与焦虑症状之间存在较强的因果关系，并提示减少SMU可能成为青少年焦虑障碍管理中的潜在组成部分。该干预总体上降低了抑郁症状，但关于基线症状严重程度作为反应调节因素的发现尚不确定，需进一步重复验证。
关键词：社交媒体减少干预；焦虑症状；抑郁症状；精准心理健康；青少年

title: Effectiveness of mindfulness interventions for depressive symptoms in young people: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
UNLABELLED: Depression is a leading contributor to global disease burden, with onset commonly occurring in young people. Mindfulness interventions (MIs) are an increasingly popular approach for addressing depressive symptoms in this population. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of MIs in reducing depressive symptoms and to examine whether a range of variables, including MI type, potentially influence effectiveness.
METHOD: This systematic review searched PsycINFO, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Embase for controlled trials involving participants aged 14-27 years reporting depressive symptoms. Twenty-eight studies met inclusion criteria, of which 25 were included in a meta-analysis. A random-effects model was used to estimate pooled Hedges' g at end of treatment, and MI type was examined as a moderator.
RESULTS: MIs were significantly more effective than control conditions in reducing depressive symptom severity, with a small pooled effect size (g = -0.32, p < .001). MI type did not significantly moderate outcomes, suggesting no single MI was superior in effectiveness. Despite moderate heterogeneity, effects were broadly consistent across populations, delivery modes, and comparator conditions. Narrative synthesis of follow-up data suggested that benefits may be maintained over time, although findings were mixed.
LIMITATIONS: Follow-up outcomes were not meta-analysed due to inconsistent reporting, and residual heterogeneity remained.
CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS: MIs demonstrate reliable, small effectiveness in reducing depressive symptoms in young people and represent flexible, scalable interventions. Future research should examine key moderators and isolate the specific contribution of mindfulness within multi-component interventions.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：正念干预对青少年抑郁症状的有效性：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
摘要：抑郁症是全球疾病负担的主要贡献因素，其发病常见于年轻人。正念干预（MIs）在该人群中日益成为应对抑郁症状的常用方法。本研究旨在评估正念干预在减轻抑郁症状方面的有效性，并考察包括正念干预类型在内的一系列变量是否可能影响有效性。方法：本系统综述检索了PsycINFO、MEDLINE、Web of Science和Embase数据库，纳入涉及年龄14-27岁、报告有抑郁症状的参与者的对照试验。28项研究符合纳入标准，其中25项纳入荟萃分析。采用随机效应模型估计治疗结束时的合并Hedges' g值，并将正念干预类型作为调节变量进行检验。结果：正念干预在降低抑郁症状严重程度方面显著优于对照条件，合并效应量较小（g = -0.32，p < .001）。正念干预类型未显著调节结果，提示没有单一正念干预类型在有效性上具有优势。尽管存在中度异质性，效应在总体人群、实施方式和对照条件间基本一致。随访数据的叙述性综合提示获益可能随时间维持，但结果不一致。局限性：由于报告不一致，随访结果未进行荟萃分析，且存在残余异质性。结论与启示：正念干预在减轻青少年抑郁症状方面显示出可靠但较小的有效性，并代表了灵活、可扩展的干预方式。未来研究应考察关键调节变量，并在多成分干预中分离正念的独特贡献。
关键词：正念干预；抑郁症状；青少年；荟萃分析；系统综述

title: Decreased accumbens-amygdala connectivity is associated with sleep improvement in late-life depression following mindfulness-based cognitive therapy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (MBCT) may improve sleep in major depressive disorder. This secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial examined the effects of adjunctive MBCT on sleep quality and explored neural correlates of sleep improvement in late-life depression (LLD).
METHODS: Sixty participants with LLD were randomized to 8-week MBCT plus Treatment as Usual (TAU) or TAU alone (ChiCTR1800017725). Subjective and objective sleep quality were assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) and cardiopulmonary coupling (CPC), respectively. In the MBCT+TAU group, post-treatment differences in functional connectivity between the meditation and resting states were examined, and associations with changes in sleep outcomes were analyzed.
RESULTS: Global PSQI scores showed greater short-term improvement in the MBCT+TAU group than in the TAU group (p for interaction = 0.02). At Week 8, the between-group difference in change in global PSQI scores was -3.80 (95% CI, -6.50 to -1.10), but was nonsignificant at 3-month follow-up. Stable sleep also increased more in the MBCT+TAU group (difference in change, 0.94 h; 95% CI, 0.17 to 1.71). Reduced right nucleus accumbens-left amygdala functional connectivity during meditation relative to the resting state was associated with greater increases in stable sleep duration (r = 0.45, p = 0.013).
CONCLUSION: Adjunctive MBCT was associated with greater short-term improvement in subjective and objective sleep quality in LLD. Reduced right nucleus accumbens-left amygdala functional connectivity during meditation relative to the resting state was associated with increased stable sleep duration. MBCT may represent a promising adjunctive non-pharmacological intervention for sleep disturbances in LLD.

相关性：是
主题标签：心脑轴/心脑耦合，心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：重点推荐
标题：晚年抑郁症中伏隔核-杏仁核连接减弱与正念认知疗法后睡眠改善相关
摘要：背景：正念认知疗法（MBCT）可能改善重度抑郁障碍患者的睡眠。这项随机对照试验的二次分析考察了辅助性MBCT对睡眠质量的影响，并探讨了晚年抑郁症（LLD）中睡眠改善的神经关联。
方法：六十名LLD参与者被随机分配至8周MBCT加常规治疗（TAU）组或仅TAU组（ChiCTR1800017725）。分别使用匹兹堡睡眠质量指数（PSQI）和心肺耦合（CPC）评估主观和客观睡眠质量。在MBCT+TAU组中，检查了冥想状态与静息状态之间功能连接的组内治疗后差异，并分析了这些差异与睡眠结果变化之间的关联。
结果：MBCT+TAU组的总体PSQI评分较TAU组显示出更大的短期改善（交互作用p=0.02）。在第8周时，两组总体PSQI评分变化的组间差异为-3.80（95% CI，-6.50至-1.10），但在3个月随访时差异不再显著。MBCT+TAU组的稳定睡眠时长增加也更多（变化差异为0.94小时；95% CI，0.17至1.71）。冥想相对于静息状态下右侧伏隔核-左侧杏仁核功能连接的减弱与稳定睡眠时长的更大增加相关（r=0.45，p=0.013）。
结论：辅助性MBCT与LLD患者短期主观和客观睡眠质量的更大改善相关。冥想相对于静息状态下右侧伏隔核-左侧杏仁核功能连接的减弱与稳定睡眠时长的增加相关。MBCT可能是一种有前景的针对LLD睡眠紊乱的辅助性非药物干预措施。
关键词：正念认知疗法；晚年抑郁症；睡眠质量；心脑连接；功能连接

title: Protocol of a randomized trial of "pathways," a hope intervention for people undergoing treatment for advanced lung cancer.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Advanced cancer and its treatment can disrupt personal goal pursuits and attainment, which can imperil patient quality of life and increase risk for depression. Hope interventions foster the goal-pursuit skills exemplified by high-hope individuals and, based on a pilot trial, are a promising approach to support these patients. The current Phase II trial (NCT06047301) aims to determine the efficacy of a brief, hope intervention, "Pathways," in improving depression symptoms for people undergoing treatment advanced stage lung cancer with elevated distress.
METHODS: In this two-arm randomized controlled trial, 234 people undergoing treatment for advanced stage lung cancer are randomized to Pathways or enhanced usual care. The Pathways intervention consists of a cancer resource guide and five sessions (150-180 min total) delivered primarily during infusion or by phone by nurse practitioners or social workers. Sessions focus on identifying values, setting goals, building pathways, and agency thinking. Enhanced usual care consists of receiving and reviewing the cancer resource guide with staff. Outcomes are assessed at baseline, mid-intervention, and at 2-, 6-, and 12-weeks post-intervention. The primary outcome is depression symptoms at 2 weeks. Secondary outcomes include measures of anxiety, demoralization, positive affect, meaning and peace, social and role function, and quality of life.
RESULTS: Recruitment began in November 2023; 94 patients have enrolled as of November 5, 2025.
CONCLUSION: If efficacious, Pathways may be a pragmatic point-of-care intervention to address cancer-related goal disruption and ultimately support the mental health and quality of life of patients receiving treatment for advanced lung cancer.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：“路径”希望干预方案用于晚期肺癌治疗患者的随机试验方案
摘要：目的：晚期癌症及其治疗可能干扰个人目标追求与实现，从而损害患者生活质量并增加抑郁风险。希望干预通过培养高希望个体所具备的目标追求技能，基于先导试验结果，是支持这类患者的一种有前景的方法。本II期试验（NCT06047301）旨在评估简短希望干预“路径”在改善接受晚期肺癌治疗且伴有显著心理困扰患者的抑郁症状方面的疗效。
方法：在这项两臂随机对照试验中，234名接受晚期肺癌治疗的患者被随机分配至“路径”干预组或增强常规护理组。“路径”干预包括一本癌症资源指南和五次会话（总计150–180分钟），主要于输注期间由护士或社会工作者面对面或通过电话实施。会话内容聚焦于识别价值观、设定目标、构建路径和能动性思维。增强常规护理包括接受癌症资源指南并与工作人员进行回顾。结局在基线、干预中期以及干预后2周、6周和12周进行评估。主要结局为2周时的抑郁症状。次要结局包括焦虑、失志、积极情感、意义与平和、社会与角色功能及生活质量。
结果：招募始于2023年11月；截至2025年11月5日，已有94名患者入组。
结论：若证实有效，“路径”可能成为一种实用的即时护理干预，以应对癌症相关的目标中断，最终支持接受晚期肺癌治疗患者的心理健康与生活质量。
关键词：希望干预；晚期肺癌；抑郁症状；随机对照试验；目标追求

title: AI-Based Approaches to Refugee Mental Health Care: Systematic Integrative Review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Refugees and forcibly displaced populations experience elevated rates of mental health conditions, including posttraumatic stress disorder, depression, and anxiety, while facing substantial barriers to mental health care. AI has emerged as a promising approach for mental health detection, intervention, and decision support; however, no review has specifically examined AI-based approaches to refugee mental health care.
OBJECTIVE: This systematic integrative review aimed to (1) examine how AI has been used in refugee mental health research and care, (2) synthesize the reported strengths and limitations of AI-based approaches, and (3) identify future directions for this field.
METHODS: An integrative review methodology was used following Whittemore and Knafl's framework. Systematic searches were conducted across PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, PsycINFO, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, ACM Guide to Computing Literature, IEEE Xplore, arXiv, and medRxiv from inception through June 2026. The first 100 results from Google Scholar sorted by relevance were additionally screened. Studies were included if they focused on refugee populations and applied AI technologies to refugee mental health care or assessment, while studies focusing on voluntary migrants and digital mental health not using AI were excluded. Quality appraisal was performed mainly using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Data were synthesized in accordance with the integrative review methodology.
RESULTS: Of 2726 studies identified, 23 studies were included in the review. AI-based approaches were classified into 3 functional categories: Detection, Prediction, and Classification (15/23, 65.2%); Intervention and Clinical Support (4/23, 17.4%); and Information Synthesis (5/23, 21.7%). Reported strengths of AI-based approaches included scalability, accessibility in resource-limited settings, support for early symptom detection, reduction of language barriers, and efficient synthesis of large unstructured data. Common limitations included potential biases, lack of contextual understanding, structural barriers in technology access, and concerns regarding overreliance on AI-based systems. Future directions emphasized culturally sensitive model development, larger, multimodal datasets, clinical validation, human-centered design, and implementation research.
CONCLUSIONS: Unlike previous reviews that focused primarily on digital mental health interventions or AI applications in general populations, this review provides the first comprehensive synthesis of AI-based approaches specifically for refugee mental health care. This review identified 3 functional domains that characterize the current landscape of AI applications in refugee mental health care and highlights key methodological, ethical, and implementation considerations. Despite heterogeneity in the included studies, the findings provide a foundation for future research and may inform the responsible development, evaluation, and implementation of AI-based approaches in refugee mental health care across humanitarian settings.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420251246982; https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251246982.

相关性：是
主题标签：[心理健康与数字心理干预]
优先级：常规收录
标题：基于人工智能的难民心理健康照护方法：系统整合综述
摘要：背景：难民和被迫流离失所人群的心理健康状况发生率较高，包括创伤后应激障碍、抑郁和焦虑，同时面临显著的心理健康照护障碍。人工智能已成为心理健康检测、干预和决策支持的有前景的方法；然而，尚无综述专门考察基于AI的难民心理健康照护方法。目的：本系统整合综述旨在（1）考察AI在难民心理健康研究和照护中的应用方式，（2）综合基于AI方法的报告优势与局限性，（3）识别该领域的未来方向。方法：采用Whittemore和Knafl框架的整合综述方法。系统检索了PubMed、Embase、CINAHL、PsycINFO、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、ACM Guide to Computing Literature、IEEE Xplore、arXiv和medRxiv，时间从建库至2026年6月。此外，还筛选了Google Scholar按相关性排序的前100条结果。纳入标准为：关注难民人群并将AI技术应用于难民心理健康照护或评估的研究；排除关注自愿移民及未使用AI的数字心理健康研究。质量评价主要使用混合方法评价工具。数据按照整合综述方法进行综合。结果：在识别的2726项研究中，23项纳入综述。基于AI的方法被分为3个功能类别：检测、预测与分类（15/23，65.2%）；干预与临床支持（4/23，17.4%）；信息综合（5/23，21.7%）。报告的优势包括可扩展性、在资源有限环境中的可及性、支持早期症状检测、减少语言障碍以及高效综合大型非结构化数据。常见局限性包括潜在偏倚、缺乏情境理解、技术获取的结构性障碍以及对AI系统过度依赖的担忧。未来方向强调文化敏感模型开发、更大规模多模态数据集、临床验证、以人为中心的设计和实施研究。结论：与以往主要聚焦于数字心理健康干预或一般人群中AI应用的综述不同，本综述首次针对难民心理健康照护的AI方法进行了全面综合。综述识别了当前难民心理健康照护中AI应用的3个功能领域，并强调了关键的方法学、伦理和实施考量。尽管纳入研究存在异质性，但研究结果可为未来研究奠定基础，并为人道主义环境中难民心理健康照护中AI方法的负责任的开发、评估和实施提供参考。试验注册：PROSPERO CRD420251246982；https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251246982。
关键词：人工智能；难民心理健康；数字心理干预；系统综述；人文环境

title: Leveraging Personality Assessment to Better Understand Traumatic Stress and Discrimination in Daily Life.
summary: This research explores personality assessment using experience sampling methodology (ESM) as a framework for better understanding temporal dynamics associated with different conceptualizations of traumatic stress (i.e., post-traumatic stress symptoms, race/gender/age discrimination). College student participants (N = 278) completed a 14-day diary study, which included daily measures of the Alternative Model of Personality Disorders (AMPD) and daily items capturing self-concept, interpersonal bothers, emotions, and defenses. Results indicated that traumatic stress-related scales were associated with aggregated mean levels and variability in AMPD dysfunction, aggregated mean levels of self, other, emotion, and defense variables, and moderated several within-person associations relevant for psychodynamic theory (e.g., self-other and emotion-defense patterns). We extend these findings into an ESM case study to demonstrate how to leverage sample-wide scores and patterns in person-specific data.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量；心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：利用人格评估更好地理解日常生活中的创伤应激与歧视
摘要：本研究探索以经验取样法（ESM）为基础的人格评估框架，以更好地理解与创伤应激不同概念化（即创伤后应激症状、种族/性别/年龄歧视）相关的时间动态。大学生参与者（N = 278）完成了为期14天的日记研究，包括人格障碍替代模型（AMPD）的每日测量，以及捕捉自我概念、人际困扰、情绪和防御机制的每日条目。结果表明，创伤应激相关量表与AMPD功能障碍的聚合均值水平和变异性、自我、他人、情绪和防御变量的聚合均值水平相关联，并调节了若干与心理动力学理论相关的个体内关联（如自我-他人和情绪-防御模式）。我们进一步将这些发现扩展为一个ESM案例研究，以展示如何在个体特定数据中利用样本级评分和模式。
关键词：经验取样法；创伤应激；歧视；人格评估；个体内动态

title: The effectiveness of a Mindful Yoga and Common Yoga intervention on emotion regulation and well-being of adolescents; A nonrandomized quasi-experimental study.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Yoga programs have gained wide attention in school settings to promote adolescent mental health. However, comparative evaluations of distinct yoga-based approaches are limited. This study examined the effectiveness of a Mindful Yoga and Meditation (MYM) program and the Common Yoga Protocol (CYP) in reducing psychological distress and enhancing mindfulness, emotion regulation, and overall well-being among secondary school students in India.
METHODS: The study employed a quasi-experimental design. A total of 147 students were assigned to three groups: MYM, CYP, and waitlist-control. Both interventions were conducted over 21 days, with assessments at baseline (T1), post-intervention (T2), and 3-month follow-up (T3). The outcome measures included psychological distress (K10), mindfulness (CAMM), emotion regulation (ERQ-CA), and well-being (WHO-5). A linear mixed model was employed to examine the main effects of group and time, as well as the group × time interaction, across all outcome measures.
RESULTS: Both the MYM and CYP groups showed significant improvements compared to the control group. The MYM participants demonstrated greater and more sustained gains in mindfulness (p < .001), cognitive reappraisal (p = .026), and well-being (p < .001), along with larger reductions in distress (p < .001) and expressive suppression (p < .001). While CYP was effective, its benefits were comparatively smaller and less durable when compared to MYM. No significant changes were observed in the control group.
CONCLUSION: The findings support the feasibility and effectiveness of brief school-based yoga interventions in promoting adolescent mental health. Importantly, integrating mindfulness into yoga practices (as in MYM) yielded superior outcomes, emphasizing the added value of mindful components.

主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预

标题：正念瑜伽与普通瑜伽干预对青少年情绪调节和幸福感的效果：一项非随机准实验研究
摘要：目的：瑜伽项目在学校环境中已获得广泛关注，以促进青少年心理健康。然而，对不同瑜伽方法的比较评估仍然有限。本研究考察了正念瑜伽与冥想（MYM）项目和普通瑜伽方案（CYP）在减少印度中学生心理困扰及提升正念、情绪调节和整体幸福感方面的有效性。
方法：本研究采用准实验设计。共147名学生被分配到三组：MYM组、CYP组和等待名单对照组。两种干预均持续进行21天，评估在基线（T1）、干预后（T2）和3个月随访（T3）三个时间点进行。结果测量包括心理困扰（K10）、正念（CAMM）、情绪调节（ERQ-CA）和幸福感（WHO-5）。采用线性混合模型检验所有结果测量中组别和时间的主效应，以及组别×时间的交互效应。
结果：与对照组相比，MYM组和CYP组均表现出显著改善。MYM参与者在正念（p < .001）、认知重评（p = .026）和幸福感（p < .001）方面表现出更大且更持久的提升，同时在心理困扰（p < .001）和表达抑制（p < .001）方面有更大程度的降低。虽然CYP也有效，但其收益相对较小且不如MYM持久。对照组未观察到显著变化。
结论：研究结果支持短期学校瑜伽干预在促进青少年心理健康方面的可行性和有效性。重要的是，将正念融入瑜伽练习（如MYM）产生了更优的结果，强调了正念成分的附加价值。
关键词：正念瑜伽；情绪调节；青少年心理健康；幸福感；学校干预

title: Daily Alcohol Use and Next-Day Intimate Partner Sexual Violence: Within-Person Associations and Individual Variability.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Intimate partner sexual violence (IPSV) is a widely prevalent form of sexual violence that is associated with significant mental health consequences. Although alcohol use is a well-documented risk factor for interpersonal and sexual violence broadly, research examining the bi-directional relationship between alcohol use and IPSV remains limited.
METHOD: The current study used experience sampling methods to investigate the bidirectional momentary association between daily alcohol use (i.e., whether alcohol was consumed on a given day) and IPSV among adult women in relationships characterized by intimate partner violence. Participants completed daily surveys over a 30-day period, reporting on alcohol use occurrence and experiences of IPSV since the previous survey.
RESULTS: Results of dynamic structural equation modeling demonstrated a significant between-person association, such that women who reported alcohol use on a greater proportion of days were also more likely to report IPSV. Further, there was a significant within-person cross-lagged effect such that alcohol use occurrence on one day was associated with next-day IPSV. There was significant variability in model effects suggesting that IPSV could be associated with next-day alcohol use for a subset of women.
CONCLUSION: These findings underscore the importance of nuanced, person-centered approaches in research and intervention, emphasizing the heterogeneity in the alcohol use-IPSV relation. This study highlights the need for targeted prevention strategies that account for individual variability in momentary risk processes.

相关性：是
主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量
优先级：常规收录
标题：日常饮酒与次日亲密伴侣性暴力：个体内关联及个体变异性
摘要：目的：亲密伴侣性暴力（IPSV）是一种广泛存在的性暴力形式，与显著的心理健康后果相关。尽管饮酒是人际暴力和性暴力的公认风险因素，但针对饮酒与IPSV之间双向关系的研究仍然有限。方法：本研究采用经验取样方法，考察亲密伴侣暴力关系中的成年女性日常饮酒（即某日是否饮酒）与IPSV之间的双向瞬时关联。参与者在30天期间完成每日调查，报告饮酒情况以及自上次调查以来经历的IPSV。结果：动态结构方程模型结果显示存在显著的个体间关联，即报告饮酒天数比例较高的女性也更可能报告IPSV。此外，存在显著的个体内交叉滞后效应，即某日饮酒与次日IPSV相关。模型效应存在显著变异性，提示对于部分女性，IPSV可能与次日饮酒相关。结论：这些发现强调了在研究和干预中采用精细化的、以个体为中心的方法的重要性，凸显了饮酒与IPSV关系的异质性。本研究强调需要针对瞬时风险过程中的个体变异性制定有针对性的预防策略。
关键词：亲密伴侣性暴力；饮酒；经验取样；个体内关联；动态结构方程模型

title: Large Language Models as a New Tool for Therapists in Internet-Based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy: Blinded Clinician Rating Pilot Experiment.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Internet-based cognitive behavioral therapy (iCBT) is an effective and scalable alternative to face-to-face psychotherapy, but its reach is constrained by the time therapists spend reviewing patient input and manually drafting written responses. Studies suggest that large language models (LLMs) may be capable of generating high-quality therapeutic text, with the potential to support therapists in delivering treatment. Their suitability as therapist-support tools in structured iCBT, however, remains insufficiently studied.
OBJECTIVE: This study aims to assess the quality of LLM-generated iCBT responses to patient messages by comparing them to the quality of responses produced by humans.
METHODS: In a preregistered blinded clinician rating experiment, experienced clinicians assessed the quality of human-produced vs LLM-generated therapist responses within a simulated iCBT treatment for functional somatic disorder. Raters were exposed to a stimulus material consisting of 5 fictitious patient messages, each paired with 1 human and 1 LLM-generated response. Raters assessed message/response pairs on 5 quality dimensions (overall quality, helpfulness, empathy, professionalism, and protocol adherence) and were asked to indicate the source of the response (human/LLM). Analyses were primarily descriptive, supplemented by exploratory statistical tests and descriptive thematic content analysis of open-ended text fields. The full preregistered study protocol is available at Open Science Framework.
RESULTS: A total of 61 raters provided data, while 54 were eligible and included for analysis. Human- and LLM-generated responses were rated similarly across quality dimensions on a 1-5 scale: overall quality (LLM: mean 4.00, SD 0.54 vs human: mean 3.96, SD 0.53; d=0.06), helpfulness (LLM: mean 3.85, SD 0.57 vs human: mean 3.93, SD 0.49; d=0.13), professionalism (LLM: mean 4.25, SD 0.53 vs human: mean 4.11, SD 0.53; d=0.24), protocol adherence (LLM: mean 4.13, SD 0.52 vs human: mean 4.13, SD 0.54; d=0.03) and empathy (LLM: mean 4.31, SD 0.47 vs human: mean 4.08, SD 0.50; d=0.42). Raters correctly identified the source of human-generated responses (mean 79%, SD 19.65%) more accurately than LLM-generated responses (mean 63%, SD 21.30%). In all, 30/54 (55%) raters responded to one or more open text fields. Qualitative analysis indicated that LLM-generated responses were perceived as polished but also generic and at times excessively empathetic.
CONCLUSIONS: LLM-generated responses were judged to be of comparable quality to those written by human therapists, though qualitative feedback indicated they were at times generic and insufficiently challenging. These findings provide initial support for the feasibility of using LLMs as therapist-support tools in iCBT, but further research is needed to determine whether their integration yields tangible clinical and organizational benefits.
