相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：大语言模型作为网络认知行为治疗中治疗师的新型辅助工具：盲法临床评级试点实验
摘要：背景：网络认知行为治疗（iCBT）是面对面心理治疗的一种有效且可扩展的替代方案，但其推广受到治疗师审阅患者输入内容及手动撰写书面回复所需时间的制约。研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）可能具备生成高质量治疗文本的能力，并有望在治疗实施中为治疗师提供支持。然而，其在结构化iCBT中作为治疗师辅助工具的适用性仍缺乏充分研究。
目的：本研究旨在通过比较LLM生成的iCBT回复与人工撰写的回复的质量，评估LLM生成回复的质量。
方法：在一项预注册的盲法临床评级实验中，经验丰富的临床医生在功能性躯体障碍的模拟iCBT治疗中，对人工撰写与LLM生成的治疗师回复进行了质量评估。评级者接触的刺激材料包含5条虚构的患者消息，每条消息配有一份人工回复和一份LLM生成的回复。评级者从5个质量维度（总体质量、帮助性、共情、专业性和方案依从性）对消息/回复配对进行评估，并被要求判断回复的来源（人工/LLM）。分析以描述性为主，辅以探索性统计检验和对开放式文本字段的描述性主题内容分析。完整预注册研究方案可在开放科学框架（Open Science Framework）获取。
结果：共61名评级者提供数据，其中54名符合条件并被纳入分析。在1-5分制量表上，人工与LLM生成的回复在各质量维度上的评分相近：总体质量（LLM：均值4.00，标准差0.54 vs 人工：均值3.96，标准差0.53；d=0.06）、帮助性（LLM：均值3.85，标准差0.57 vs 人工：均值3.93，标准差0.49；d=0.13）、专业性（LLM：均值4.25，标准差0.53 vs 人工：均值4.11，标准差0.53；d=0.24）、方案依从性（LLM：均值4.13，标准差0.52 vs 人工：均值4.13，标准差0.54；d=0.03）和共情（LLM：均值4.31，标准差0.47 vs 人工：均值4.08，标准差0.50；d=0.42）。评级者对人工生成回复来源的识别准确率（均值79%，标准差19.65%）高于对LLM生成回复的识别准确率（均值63%，标准差21.30%）。共30/54（55%）名评级者填写了一个或多个开放式文本字段。定性分析表明，LLM生成的回复被认为措辞精炼但内容泛化，有时共情表达过度。
结论：LLM生成的回复在质量上被评定为与人工治疗师撰写的回复相当，尽管定性反馈指出其有时较为泛化且缺乏足够挑战性。这些发现为LLM在iCBT中作为治疗师辅助工具的可行性提供了初步支持，但其整合是否能带来切实的临床和组织效益仍需进一步研究。
关键词：大语言模型；网络认知行为治疗；治疗师辅助工具；临床评级；回复质量

title: Active Video Gaming Intervention in Adults With Mobility Impairments: Concurrent Mixed Methods Single-Arm Pilot Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adults with mobility impairments have limited opportunities for physical activity due to environmental barriers and lack of accessible exercise options. Active video games (AVGs) have shown promise for increasing physical activity by integrating movement into engaging gameplay. However, most commercial AVG controllers are not usable by those with severe mobility limitations. The GAIMplank is a novel adaptive game controller that translates trunk movements into gameplay, addressing this accessibility gap and enabling seated participation for individuals with limited lower-extremity function.
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess feasibility and acceptability of a 6-week GAIMplank-based intervention in adults with mobility impairments and to evaluate participants' perceived exertion, enjoyment, and engagement during gameplay. In addition, qualitative feedback was used to characterize participants' experiences with the intervention and to provide insight into implementation considerations for adapted exergaming in this population.
METHODS: In total, 6 adults (2 female; mean age 65.2, SD 12.4 years) with mobility impairments due to stroke or Parkinson participated in a concurrent mixed methods single-arm pilot study. The intervention consisted of twice-weekly AVG sessions over 6 weeks using the GAIMplank controller to play video games. Self-report baseline measures included physical function, exercise expectations, and level of physical activity. During gameplay sessions, ratings of perceived exertion (RPEs), engagement, and enjoyment (0-10 rating scale) were collected. Additionally, physical activity and exergame enjoyment surveys were completed after sessions 1, 5, and 12. After the intervention, acceptability, appropriateness, and feasibility of the intervention (0-5 rating scale) were assessed. Qualitative data were collected through session comments and postintervention semistructured interviews. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize quantitative data, thematic analysis for qualitative data, and integration to examine convergence.
RESULTS: Participants reported moderate RPEs during gameplay (median RPE 5, IQR 3-6) and high levels of enjoyment and engagement (median scores of 9, IQR 6-10 and median 10, IQR 8-10, respectively). The intervention was well-received, with high scores on the acceptability, appropriateness, and feasibility measures. Qualitative findings highlighted engagement and enjoyment of the games, as well as participants' perceptions of mental stimulation, sustained attention, and positive emotional experiences during gameplay. Several participants also described a "masking effect," in which physical effort was not perceived as traditional exercise due to immersion in gameplay. Technical challenges related to controller responsiveness were reported, but they did not appear to substantially reduce overall engagement.
CONCLUSIONS: Findings from this mixed methods pilot study suggest that AVGs, delivered using an adapted controller such as the GAIMplank, appear feasible and enjoyable in this small pilot sample, supporting the need for further evaluation in larger, controlled studies. While standardized cognitive or mental health outcomes were not assessed, participant feedback indicates potential psychological benefits that warrant further investigation. Future studies should explore the long-term effects of AVG interventions and identify strategies for maximizing their benefits.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05310279; https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05310279.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：行动障碍成人主动视频游戏干预：混合方法单臂初步研究
摘要：背景：由于环境障碍和缺乏可及的运动选择，行动障碍成人参与体力活动的机会有限。主动视频游戏通过将运动融入趣味性游戏玩法中，有望增加体力活动。然而，多数商用主动视频游戏控制器无法供严重行动受限者使用。GAIMplank是一种新型自适应游戏控制器，可将躯干动作转化为游戏操作，弥补了这一可及性缺口，使下肢功能受限者能够坐姿参与。
目的：本研究旨在评估基于GAIMplank的6周干预在行动障碍成人中的可行性与可接受性，并评估参与者在游戏过程中的感知用力、愉悦感和投入度。此外，通过定性反馈表征参与者的干预体验，为这一人群中的适应性运动游戏实施提供参考。
方法：共6名因卒中或帕金森病导致行动障碍的成人（2名女性；平均年龄65.2岁，SD 12.4）参与了同步混合方法单臂初步研究。干预为每周2次主动视频游戏课程，持续6周，使用GAIMplank控制器玩游戏。基线自我报告测量包括身体功能、运动期望和体力活动水平。游戏过程中收集感知用力、投入度和愉悦感评分（0-10评分量表）。此外，在第1、5、12次课程后完成体力活动和运动游戏愉悦感问卷。干预后评估干预的可接受性、适当性和可行性（0-5评分量表）。定性数据通过课程评论和干预后半结构化访谈收集。采用描述性统计汇总定量数据，主题分析处理定性数据，并通过整合检验收敛性。
结果：参与者报告游戏过程中感知用力的中位数为5（IQR 3-6），愉悦感和投入度水平较高（中位数分别为9，IQR 6-10和10，IQR 8-10）。干预反响良好，可接受性、适当性和可行性评分均较高。定性结果突显了游戏的投入度和愉悦感，以及参与者对游戏过程中心理刺激、持续注意力和积极情绪体验的感知。多名参与者还描述了“掩蔽效应”，即因沉浸于游戏而未将体力付出感知为传统运动。控制器响应性相关的技术挑战被报告，但并未显著降低整体投入度。
结论：该混合方法初步研究结果表明，使用GAIMplank等自适应控制器提供的主动视频游戏在本小样本中具有可行性和愉悦性，支持在更大规模对照研究中进一步评估的必要性。虽然未评估标准化认知或心理健康结局，但参与者反馈提示潜在的心理获益，值得进一步研究。未来研究应探索主动视频游戏干预的长期效果，并确定最大化其益处的策略。
试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05310279；https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05310279
关键词：主动视频游戏；行动障碍；可行性；心理获益；数字干预

title: Modeling Between-Group Differences in Dynamics of Psychological Constructs in the Presence of Measurement Non-Invariance: A Stepwise Approach.
summary: Researchers analyzing intensive longitudinal data often aim to detect between-group differences in dynamics of psychological constructs, such as positive and negative affect. These constructs are usually latent (not directly observable). To validly compare groups of individuals in their dynamic processes, the latent constructs must be measured equally across the individuals. If this is not the case - that is, if measurement invariance is violated for some items - this partial non-invariance must be accounted for. Otherwise, the group-specific estimates of the dynamic process may be biased. To aid researchers in obtaining unbiased group-specific estimates despite partial measurement non-invariance, we present an extension of the Three-Step Latent Vector Autoregression, a novel method that separates the estimation of the measurement model and the structural model. We expand this method to multi-group modeling, where differences in structural parameters (e.g., regression coefficients) are captured by allowing these parameters to vary across the groups of individuals. Measurement heterogeneity between and within these groups is captured by group- or person-specific MM parameters. Through two simulation studies, we demonstrate that the method performs well in obtaining correct estimates of a dynamic process despite the presence of measurement heterogeneity. The method is further illustrated with an empirical example.

相关性：是
主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量
优先级：常规收录
标题：测量非等值存在下心理构念动态的组间差异建模：一种分步方法
摘要：分析密集纵向数据的研究人员通常旨在检测心理构念（如积极和消极情感）动态过程中的组间差异。这些构念通常是潜变量（不可直接观测）。为了有效比较个体群体在其动态过程中的差异，潜构念必须在个体间被等值测量。如果情况并非如此——即某些条目的测量等值性被违反——则必须考虑这种部分非等值性。否则，组别的动态过程估计可能会产生偏差。为帮助研究者在存在部分测量非等值的情况下获得无偏的组别特定估计，我们提出了三步骤潜向量自回归方法的一种扩展，这是一种将测量模型与结构模型估计分离的新方法。我们将该方法扩展至多组建模，其中结构参数（如回归系数）的差异通过允许这些参数在不同个体群体间变化来捕捉。组间和组内的测量异质性则通过组别或个体特定的测量模型参数来捕捉。通过两项模拟研究，我们证明该方法在存在测量异质性的情况下能够较好地获得动态过程的正确估计。该方法还通过一个实证案例进行了进一步说明。
关键词：密集纵向数据；测量非等值；三步骤潜向量自回归；组间差异；动态过程

title: Effects of Gender-Affirming Surgery on Interoceptive Awareness.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The inability to correctly identify or appraise internal bodily stimuli, interoceptive awareness (IA), has been shown to be reduced in individuals with body-image dissatisfaction and mental health conditions such as depression and PTSD. IA has not been investigated in relation to gender dysphoria in the transgender and gender diverse (TGD) population, and how this may change in relation to gender-affirming procedures. This study aims to assess pre- and postoperative IA in patients who underwent gender-affirming chest surgery using the Multidimensional Assessment of Interoceptive Awareness (MAIA-2), a previously validated survey.
METHODS: The MAIA-2 survey was administered preoperatively and then repeated at 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months postoperatively to patients who underwent gender-affirming chest surgery between December 2021 and April 2023 at a single institution. The survey was administered once more in September 2024 to collect long-term data. A paired-samples t test was used to compare postoperative mean values to preoperative baselines and obtain P-values. Significance was set as P<0.05.
RESULTS: Twenty-three patients completed the 1-week postoperative survey, 18 patients through 1 month, 16 patients through 3 months, and 13 patients filled out the entire survey set with an average long-term follow-up period of 2.10 years postsurgery. For overall IA, there were significant improvements at each survey interval when compared to preoperative scores. There was a significant increase in the trusting subcategory score at 1 week sustained to long-term follow-up, in the not-distracting score at 1 week and 3 months, and in the not-worrying score at 1 month, sustained to long-term follow-up. There was a nonsignificant upward trend in the attention regulation and self-regulation categories.
CONCLUSION: Gender-affirming chest surgery significantly improves IA early in the postoperative period, sustained to long-term follow-up, demonstrating increased mind-body congruity within TGD patients. Our findings add to the growing body of literature on IA, provide new insight into the postoperative experiences of individuals undergoing gender-affirming surgery, and support providers in more effectively advocating for gender-affirming care.

相关性：是
主题标签：心脑轴/心脑耦合
优先级：常规收录
标题：性别肯定手术对内感受知觉的影响
摘要：背景：无法正确识别或评估内部身体刺激的内感受知觉（IA）已被证实在身体意象不满及抑郁、创伤后应激障碍等心理健康状况的个体中有所降低。目前，IA尚未在跨性别与性别多元（TGD）人群中与性别焦虑相关联进行研究，也未探讨其如何随性别肯定手术而变化。本研究旨在使用先前已验证的量表——多维内感受知觉评估量表（MAIA-2），评估接受性别肯定胸部手术患者的术前及术后IA。
方法：对2021年12月至2023年4月期间在单一机构接受性别肯定胸部手术的患者，于术前及术后1周、1个月、3个月重复施测MAIA-2量表。2024年9月再次施测一次以收集长期数据。采用配对样本t检验比较术后均值与术前基线，获取P值，显著性水平设为P<0.05。
结果：23名患者完成术后1周调查，18名完成1个月，16名完成3个月，13名完成全套调查，平均长期随访期为术后2.10年。在总体IA方面，与术前得分相比，每个调查时间点均有显著改善。信任子维度得分在术后1周显著升高并持续至长期随访；不分散注意子维度得分在术后1周及3个月显著升高；不担忧子维度得分在术后1个月显著升高并持续至长期随访。注意调节和自我调节维度呈非显著上升趋势。
结论：性别肯定胸部手术在术后早期显著改善IA，并持续至长期随访，表明TGD患者身心一致性增强。本研究发现丰富了日益增长的IA研究文献，为接受性别肯定手术个体的术后体验提供新见解，并支持医疗服务提供者更有效地倡导性别肯定照护。
关键词：内感受知觉；性别肯定手术；性别焦虑；身心一致性；MAIA-2

title: Network structure and mental health correlates of the Mount Sinai Resilience Scale.
summary: The Mount Sinai Resilience Scale (MSRS) assesses cognitive, behavioral, and emotional resilience processes, yet the interrelationships among these processes, including which are most central and most strongly associated with mental health outcomes, remain poorly characterized. This study used network analysis to characterize the structure of MSRS-assessed resilience processes and their associations with clinical outcomes in a population-based sample of U.S. adults (N = 1794) enriched for elevated perceived stress and trauma exposure. Participants completed the MSRS and validated measures of depressive, anxiety, and posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms and well-being. Regularized Gaussian graphical models were estimated to characterize network structure and centrality, with clinical outcomes incorporated as nodes to identify unique associations with individual MSRS items. The network demonstrated moderate density (157 of 276 possible edges), reflecting widespread conditional associations among resilience processes. Engagement in meaningful activities, perceived positive impact of spirituality, and active emotional recovery demonstrated the highest centrality, while emotional awareness and directly facing fears also showed high expected influence. Staying hopeful about the future, directly facing fears, and engaging in meaningful activities were consistently associated with lower depressive, anxiety, and PTSD symptoms and higher well-being. Forgiveness was positively associated with PTSD symptoms, suggesting a more complex role in trauma-related adaptation. Overall, MSRS resilience processes were organized around interconnected domains of meaning, spirituality, and emotional regulation. Hope, behavioral approach to feared experiences, and engagement in meaningful activities emerged as resilience processes with consistent associations across multiple mental health outcomes, highlighting their potential relevance for resilience-focused interventions.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：西奈山复原力量表的网络结构及其与心理健康的相关性
摘要：西奈山复原力量表（MSRS）评估认知、行为及情绪性复原力过程，然而这些过程之间的相互关系——包括哪些过程最为核心、哪些与心理健康结局关联最强——仍缺乏充分表征。本研究采用网络分析，在一个以高感知压力和创伤暴露为富集特征的美国成年人人群样本（N = 1794）中，刻画了MSRS所测复原力过程的结构及其与临床结局的关联。参与者完成了MSRS以及抑郁、焦虑、创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）症状和幸福感的验证性测量。研究估计了正则化高斯图模型以表征网络结构和中心性，并将临床结局作为节点纳入，以识别其与各MSRS条目的独特关联。网络呈现中等密度（276条可能边中的157条），反映了复原力过程之间广泛的条件关联。参与有意义的活动、感知到灵性的积极影响以及主动情绪恢复具有最高的中心性，而情绪觉察和直面恐惧也表现出较高的预期影响。对未来保持希望、直面恐惧以及参与有意义的活动 consistently 与较低的抑郁、焦虑和PTSD症状及较高的幸福感相关联。宽恕与PTSD症状呈正相关，提示其在创伤相关适应中具有更复杂的作用。总体而言，MSRS复原力过程围绕意义、灵性和情绪调节等相互关联的领域组织。希望、对恐惧体验的行为趋近以及参与有意义的活动成为与多种心理健康结局具有一致关联的复原力过程，凸显了其在以复原力为导向的干预中的潜在相关性。
关键词：复原力；网络分析；心理健康；西奈山复原力量表；创伤

title: Is Moral Identity Flexible or Firm? Evidence From Experience Sampling Data.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Theories of moral identity diverge in whether moral identity primarily reflects stable individual differences ("firm" models) or situationally driven fluctuations ("flexible" models). Despite extensive theorizing, little empirical work has quantified the relative contribution of these two sources of variability in everyday life.
METHODS: Using experience sampling methodology, 224 university students reported up to five times daily over 7 days on the salience of their moral identity and the occurrence of morally relevant events. Multilevel models decomposed moral identity variance into between-person and within-person components and examined associations with everyday moral and immoral experiences.
RESULTS: Moral identity exhibited substantial variability at both levels, with 55%-57% of variance attributable to stable between-person differences and the remainder to residual within-person fluctuations. Moral and immoral events were associated with higher momentary salience. Between persons, higher propensities for acting morally were associated with stronger chronic moral identity, whereas higher propensities for acting immorally were associated with weaker chronic moral identity. Individuals with stronger moral identities showed smaller event-related fluctuations.
CONCLUSION: Moral identity in everyday life reflects a balanced combination of trait-like stability and state-like fluctuation. These findings provide no empirical support for claims that moral identity is predominantly situationally flexible in typical populations.

标题：道德认同是灵活的还是稳定的？来自经验抽样数据的证据
摘要：引言：道德认同的理论在道德认同主要反映稳定的个体差异（“稳定”模型）还是情境驱动的波动（“灵活”模型）上存在分歧。尽管理论探讨广泛，但很少有实证研究量化日常生活中这两类变异性来源的相对贡献。方法：采用经验抽样方法，224名大学生在7天内每天最多报告5次其道德认同的显著性和道德相关事件的发生情况。多层模型将道德认同的方差分解为人际间和个体内成分，并检验其与日常道德及不道德经历的关系。结果：道德认同在两个层面均表现出显著变异性，其中55%-57%的方差归因于稳定的人际间差异，其余归因于残差的个体内波动。道德和不道德事件均与更高的瞬时显著性相关。在人际间层面，更高道德行为倾向与更强的慢性道德认同相关，而更高不道德行为倾向与较弱的慢性道德认同相关。道德认同越强的个体，其事件相关波动越小。结论：日常生活中的道德认同反映了特质样稳定性与状态样波动的平衡组合。这些发现不支持道德认同在典型人群中主要具有情境灵活性的主张。
关键词：道德认同；经验抽样；多层模型；个体内变异；日常道德体验

title: Whole-brain cholinergic modulation following computerized cognitive training in healthy older adults: a [18F]FEOBV PET study.
summary: The cholinergic system is central to attention, learning, and neuroplasticity and undergoes progressive degeneration with aging. Neuroplasticity-based computerized cognitive training is a scalable, non-pharmacological strategy to support cognitive health in older adults, yet its neurobiological mechanisms remain unclear. [18F]Fluoroethoxybenzovesamicol (FEOBV) positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies presynaptic cholinergic terminals via vesicular acetylcholine transporter (VACht) binding, providing an index of cholinergic integrity and neurotransmission capacity. This offers a unique opportunity to examine training-induced cholinergic plasticity. In the INHANCE double-blind, active-controlled randomized clinical trial, 92 cognitively intact older adults (≥ 65 years; mean age 71.9) were randomized to 35 h of speed-based cognitive training (BrainHQ; Double Decision and Freeze Frame) or a non-speeded active control (Double Klondike Solitaire and Bricks Breaking Hex) over 10 weeks. Participants underwent neuropsychological assessment and [18F]FEOBV PET imaging at baseline and post-intervention. Voxel-wise analyses using threshold-free cluster enhancement assessed training-related changes in cholinergic signal. Training significantly increased cholinergic binding in the anterior cingulate, medial prefrontal cortex, insula, and orbitofrontal cortex, with greater increases in the intervention group compared to controls, who showed no significant change. Exploratory cross-sectional analyses revealed age-related reductions in FEOBV binding across frontal, striatal, and parietotemporal regions, and higher baseline cholinergic binding in prefrontal and insular regions was associated with better baseline attentional performance. These findings provide the first in vivo evidence that computerized cognitive training can enhance cholinergic integrity in healthy aging, identifying cholinergic plasticity as a potential neurobiological mechanism of cognitive training and a target for interventions aimed at supporting cognitive resilience in aging.

标题：健康老年人计算机化认知训练后的全脑胆碱能调节：一项[18F]FEOBV PET研究
摘要：胆碱能系统对注意力、学习和神经可塑性至关重要，并随衰老而进行性退化。基于神经可塑性的计算机化认知训练是一种可推广的非药物策略，用于支持老年人的认知健康，但其神经生物学机制尚不清楚。[18F]氟乙氧基苯并维沙莫尔（FEOBV）正电子发射断层扫描（PET）通过囊泡乙酰胆碱转运体（VAChT）结合定量突触前胆碱能末梢，提供胆碱能完整性和神经传递能力的指标。这为考察训练诱导的胆碱能可塑性提供了独特机会。在INHANCE双盲、主动对照随机临床试验中，92名认知完好的老年人（≥65岁；平均年龄71.9岁）被随机分配接受35小时的速度型认知训练（BrainHQ；Double Decision和Freeze Frame）或非速度型主动对照训练（Double Klondike Solitaire和Bricks Breaking Hex），为期10周。参与者在基线和干预后接受神经心理学评估和[18F]FEOBV PET成像。采用无阈值聚类增强的体素分析评估训练相关的胆碱能信号变化。训练显著增加了前扣带回、内侧前额叶皮层、脑岛和眶额叶皮层的胆碱能结合，干预组的增幅大于对照组，对照组无显著变化。探索性横断面分析显示，FEOBV结合在额叶、纹状体和颞顶叶区域存在年龄相关减少，而前额叶和脑岛区域较高的基线胆碱能结合与较好的基线注意表现相关。这些发现提供了首个体内证据，表明计算机化认知训练可增强健康衰老过程中的胆碱能完整性，将胆碱能可塑性确定为认知训练的潜在神经生物学机制，以及支持衰老中认知韧性的干预靶点。
关键词：胆碱能系统；认知训练；PET成像；神经可塑性；健康衰老

title: Development of an AI-Enabled Remote Loneliness Assessment System for Older Adults Using Behavioral and Speech Data From IoT Sensors and Smart Speakers.
summary: Loneliness is a critical risk factor for adverse health outcomes in older adults, yet remains under-detected due to social stigma, time constraints, and reliance on episodic self-report. We describe HomePal, a passive system designed to support future assessment of loneliness-relevant behavioral patterns in older adults living alone. HomePal integrates in-home sensors, smart speakers, and phone communication logs to capture mobility, environmental engagement, sedentary behavior, sleep, TV use, voice characteristics, and communication patterns over 3 months. Because loneliness overlaps conceptually and empirically with related constructs such as depression and social isolation, we emphasize a construct-driven modality selection framework in which each behavioral indicator is treated as inherently ambiguous and interpretation depends on converging evidence across modalities rather than any single channel. This article details the system's development, including participant-centered deployment procedures, methods for translating sensor data into clinically interpretable behavioral patterns, and a planned semi-supervised learning framework linking behavioral indicators to biweekly UCLA Loneliness Scale assessments alongside planned analyses of convergent and discriminant validity. Illustrative case examples demonstrate the feasibility of deriving multimodal behavioral indicators in real-world home environments. We provide a methodological foundation for passive, ecologically valid AI-based loneliness assessment in older adults.

标题：基于物联网传感器和智能音箱的行为与语音数据开发面向老年人的AI远程孤独感评估系统
摘要：孤独感是老年人不良健康结果的关键风险因素，但由于社会污名、时间限制以及对间断性自我报告的依赖，其长期未被充分检测。我们描述了HomePal——一种被动式系统，旨在支持未来对独居老年人孤独相关行为模式的评估。HomePal整合了居家传感器、智能音箱和电话通信日志，在3个月内捕捉活动能力、环境参与度、久坐行为、睡眠、电视使用、语音特征和通信模式。由于孤独感在概念上和经验上与抑郁和社交隔离等相关构念重叠，我们强调一种以构念驱动的模态选择框架，其中每个行为指标被视为本质上具有模糊性，其解释依赖于跨模态的汇聚证据而非单一通道。本文详细介绍了系统的开发，包括以参与者为中心的部署流程、将传感器数据转化为临床可解释行为模式的方法，以及一个计划中的半监督学习框架，该框架将行为指标与双周UCLA孤独感量表评估相关联，并附有计划的聚合效度和区分效度分析。案例示例证明了在真实家庭环境中获取多模态行为指标的可行性。我们为老年人被动式、生态效度高的基于AI的孤独感评估提供了方法学基础。

title: Brief online parent-led early intervention for childhood autism: A randomised-controlled trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Child behavioural and emotion regulation, and social communication; and parental confidence and mental health, all contribute to developmental outcomes for autistic children; however, there are limited programmes which integrate support across these domains.
METHODS: We report on a parallel, assessor-masked randomised controlled trial used to evaluate a brief, parent-led intervention, ParentWorks-Spectrum. Parents of 100 children aged 2-5 years with autism Level 2/3 and behavioural difficulties were randomly assigned (1:1) to ParentWorks-Spectrum (n = 49) or Waitlist (n = 51). ParentWorks-Spectrum involved 12-15 weekly 60- to 90-min online sessions of parenting intervention that covered three synergistic targets: child behavioural/emotional regulation, child social communication, and parental teamwork and mental health. Efficacy was assessed for primary (child conduct problems, Eyberg Child Behavior Inventory behavioural intensity and problem, and Social Responsiveness Scale, Second Edition autism features) and secondary (child social-emotional functioning and global functioning, parent sense of competence, parenting practices, mental health, and inter-parental conflict) outcomes.
RESULTS: At postintervention, there were moderate to large improvements in the Intervention (n = 45) compared with the Waitlist group (n = 46) on three of four primary outcome measures: conduct problems (diff = -0.91, 95% confidence interval = -1.55 to -0.26), Eyberg Child Behavior Inventory intensity (diff = -27.84, 95% confidence interval = -43.76 to -11.92), and Social Responsiveness Scale, Second Edition total (diff = -11.76, 95% confidence interval = -22.84 to -0.68). Effects were maintained at 3-month follow-up. Improvements were found for all but one secondary outcome and did not significantly differ for mothers versus fathers.
CONCLUSIONS: A brief synergistic intervention delivered by telehealth that integrates child and parenting domains has benefits across core and associated autism features, and positive functioning in parents, including fathers.Trial registration: ANZCTR #12618001866291 https://www.anzctr.org.au/Trial/Registration/TrialReview.aspx?id=381133&isReview=true.

标题：简短的在线家长主导式儿童自闭症早期干预：一项随机对照试验
摘要：背景：儿童的行为与情绪调节、社交沟通能力，以及家长的信心和心理健康，均对自闭症儿童的发展结局有重要影响；然而，目前很少有项目能整合这些领域提供综合支持。方法：我们报告了一项平行、评估者盲法的随机对照试验，用于评估一项简短的家长主导式干预项目“ParentWorks-Spectrum”。100名2-5岁患有2/3级自闭症并伴有行为困难的儿童的家长被随机分配（1:1）至ParentWorks-Spectrum组（n=49）或等待名单组（n=51）。ParentWorks-Spectrum包括12-15次每周60-90分钟的在线家长干预课程，涵盖三个协同目标：儿童行为/情绪调节、儿童社交沟通，以及家长协作与心理健康。主要结局指标包括儿童行为问题（Eyberg儿童行为量表的行为强度与问题分数，以及社交反应量表第二版的自闭症特征），次要结局指标包括儿童社交情绪功能与整体功能、家长胜任感、养育实践、心理健康及父母间冲突。结果：在干预结束后，与等待名单组（n=46）相比，干预组（n=45）在四项主要结局指标中的三项上表现出中到大程度的改善：行为问题（差异=-0.91，95%置信区间=-1.55至-0.26）、Eyberg儿童行为量表强度（差异=-27.84，95%置信区间=-43.76至-11.92）和社交反应量表第二版总分（差异=-11.76，95%置信区间=-22.84至-0.68）。效果在3个月随访时得以维持。除一项次要结局外，其余均有所改善，且母亲与父亲之间无显著差异。结论：一项通过远程医疗提供的、整合儿童与家长领域的简短协同干预，对自闭症核心及相关特征以及家长（包括父亲）的积极功能均有益处。试验注册：ANZCTR #12618001866291 https://www.anzctr.org.au/Trial/Registration/TrialReview.aspx?id=381133&isReview=true。

title: Interpretable but Not Necessarily Meaningful: Language, Voice, and Clinical Inference in AI-Based Mental Health Prediction-A Commentary on Wang and Sambamoorthi (2026).
summary: The rapid integration of artificial intelligence into clinical voice research has created promising opportunities for the early identification of mental health concerns, particularly among individuals with communication impairments. In their recent study, Wang and Sambamoorthi (2026) developed an interpretable and fairness-aware Random Forest model that predicts mental health disorders using acoustic features derived from the Bridge2AI-Voice dataset. By organizing these features into clinician-friendly domains of voice stability, speech prosody, and voice clarity, the authors achieved solid predictive performance, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of approximately 0.83 to 0.84. The model revealed etiology-specific acoustic patterns and employed SHapley Additive Explanations and partial dependence plots to enhance transparency. Furthermore, the demonstration of strong gender fairness, including perfect counterfactual prediction invariance, represents a commendable step toward responsible artificial intelligence in voice science. These contributions position the study as a significant advancement in the development of ethical and clinically relevant voice-based screening tools.

标题：可解释但不一定有意义：基于AI的心理健康预测中的语言、声音与临床推断——对Wang和Sambamoorthi（2026）的评论
摘要：人工智能在临床语音研究中的快速整合为心理健康问题的早期识别创造了有前景的机会，尤其是在存在沟通障碍的个体中。Wang和Sambamoorthi（2026）在其近期研究中开发了一种可解释且具有公平性意识的随机森林模型，利用来自Bridge2AI-Voice数据集的声学特征预测心理健康障碍。通过将这些特征组织为临床友好的语音稳定性、言语韵律和语音清晰度等领域，作者取得了良好的预测性能，接受者操作特征曲线下面积约为0.83至0.84。该模型揭示了病因特异性的声学模式，并采用SHapley加性解释和偏依赖图以增强透明度。此外，对强性别公平性的展示，包括完美的反事实预测不变性，代表了在语音科学中迈向负责任人工智能的可贵一步。这些贡献使该研究在开发合乎伦理且具有临床相关性的基于语音的筛查工具方面具有重要意义。

title: Digital Phenotyping in Health Research: Scoping Review of Methods, Gaps, and Opportunities.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Wearable and connected digital devices continuously generate large volumes of real-world behavioral, physiological, and environmental data, offering new opportunities for health monitoring and personalized care. Digital phenotyping has emerged as a promising paradigm; yet, there is limited consensus regarding how such data should be analyzed. Inconsistent analytical practices and insufficient methodological reporting may compromise reproducibility, comparability, and the validity of findings.
OBJECTIVE: This scoping review examined current analytical practices in digital phenotyping in health research, identified methodological gaps, and highlighted the need for transparency and standardized approaches.
METHODS: Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and Web of Science, with Google Scholar used as a complementary source. Eligible studies were published up to December 31, 2024, involved human populations, and used wearable digital devices in longitudinal health research. Studies were screened independently by multiple reviewers using predefined eligibility criteria. Data extraction focused on 6 methodological domains: sample size determination, variable selection and definition, data cleaning and preprocessing, digital phenotyping methods, predictive modeling, and statistical significance handling in large-scale data contexts.
RESULTS: A total of 162 studies were included. Most studies were published from 2018 onward (n=144, 89%) and were conducted primarily in North America (n=92, 57%). Activity trackers (n=81, 50%), smartphones (n=35, 22%), accelerometers (n=26, 16%), and smartwatches (n=24, 15%) were the most frequently used devices. The most common outcomes were activity level (n=67, 41%), sleep (n=65, 40%), step counts (n=63, 39%), and heart rate (n=46, 28%). Heterogeneity and limited reporting were observed across all methodological domains. Preprocessing was the most frequently reported component (n=88, 54%), although specific aspects such as missing-data handling remained inconsistently described (n=35, 22%). Sample size determination methods were reported in only 30% (n=48) of studies, and variable selection methods were described in 27% (n=43). Digital phenotyping approaches were identified in 30% (n=48) of studies and predominantly used regression-based models. Predictive modeling approaches were reported in 17% (n=28) of studies, with substantial diversity in algorithms and limited reporting of validation procedures. Only 4.3% (n=7) of studies explicitly discussed statistical challenges related to large or high-dimensional datasets. Practices varied across health fields, with no domain consistently demonstrating comprehensive reporting across all methodological components.
CONCLUSIONS: Digital phenotyping research is expanding rapidly, but methodological practices remain heterogeneous and insufficiently standardized. By providing a cross-domain overview of how wearable-derived longitudinal data are currently processed and analyzed in health research, this review highlights recurring gaps in the reporting and justification of analytical choices, particularly regarding sample size determination, preprocessing, variable definition, predictive modeling, and statistical inference. These findings emphasize the need for clearer analytical frameworks and more consistent reporting practices to improve transparency, reproducibility, and methodological rigor in wearable-based digital health research.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420251234000; https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251234000.

相关性：是

优先级：常规收录  
标题：健康研究中的数字表型：方法、缺口与机遇的范围综述  
摘要：背景：可穿戴和互联数字设备持续生成大量真实世界的行为、生理和环境数据，为健康监测和个性化诊疗提供了新机遇。数字表型已成为一种有前景的范式，然而关于此类数据应如何分析，目前共识有限。不一致的分析实践和不充分的方法学报告可能损害结果的可重复性、可比性和有效性。目的：本范围综述考察了健康研究中数字表型的当前分析实践，识别方法学缺口，并强调透明性和标准化方法的必要性。方法：在PubMed、Scopus、Embase和Web of Science中进行文献检索，并以Google Scholar作为补充来源。纳入研究截至2024年12月31日发表，涉及人群，并在纵向健康研究中使用可穿戴数字设备。多名评审者使用预定义纳入标准独立筛选研究。数据提取聚焦6个方法学领域：样本量确定、变量选择与定义、数据清洗与预处理、数字表型方法、预测建模以及大规模数据情境下的统计显著性处理。结果：共纳入162项研究。多数研究发表于2018年及以后（n=144，89%），主要在北美洲开展（n=92，57%）。最常用的设备为活动追踪器（n=81，50%）、智能手机（n=35，22%）、加速度计（n=26，16%）和智能手表（n=24，15%）。最常见的结果为活动水平（n=67，41%）、睡眠（n=65，40%）、步数（n=63，39%）和心率（n=46，28%）。所有方法学领域均观察到异质性和报告不足。预处理是报告频率最高的组分（n=88，54%），但缺失数据处理等具体方面仍描述不一致（n=35，22%）。样本量确定方法仅在30%（n=48）的研究中报告，变量选择方法在27%（n=43）中描述。数字表型方法在30%（n=48）的研究中被识别，且主要使用基于回归的模型。预测建模方法在17%（n=28）的研究中报告，算法多样性显著且验证程序报告有限。仅4.3%（n=7）的研究明确讨论了与大规模或高维数据集相关的统计挑战。各健康领域的实践存在差异，没有任何领域在所有方法学组分上一致展现全面报告。结论：数字表型研究正在快速扩展，但方法学实践仍异质且标准化不足。通过提供可穿戴来源纵向数据在当前健康研究中处理和分析方式的跨领域概览，本综述强调了分析选择报告和论证中的反复缺口，特别是在样本量确定、预处理、变量定义、预测建模和统计推断方面。这些发现强调需要更清晰的分析框架和更一致的报告实践，以提高基于可穿戴数字健康研究的透明性、可重复性和方法学严谨性。试验注册：PROSPERO CRD420251234000；https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251234000。  
关键词：数字表型；可穿戴设备；纵向数据；方法学；范围综述

title: Latent profiles of generative artificial intelligence use among Chinese college students: Associations with depression and anxiety.
summary:
BACKGROUND: While generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has been rapidly adopted by college students, its relationship with mental health remains unclear. Most studies treat AI users as homogeneous, overlooking heterogeneity in GenAI use. This study identified latent profiles of GenAI use among Chinese college students and examined their associations with depression and anxiety.
METHODS: A cross-sectional survey of 5748 Chinese college students assessed AI usage, motivations, AI literacy, dependency, and symptoms of depression and anxiety using the Beck Depression Inventory-II and Beck Anxiety Inventory. Latent profile analysis identified usage patterns. An exploratory random-forest classifier with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evaluated whether these profiles could be predicted from psychological and demographic correlates not used for profile construction and identified key distinguishing factors.
RESULTS: Four profiles were identified: Rational-Tool, Moderate-Recreational, Problem-Dependent, and Light-Exploratory. The Problem-Dependent profile (15%), characterized by high escapism motivation, low AI literacy, and high dependency, showed the highest depression and anxiety levels, whereas the Rational-Tool profile, characterized by high AI literacy and instrumental motivation, showed the most favorable outcomes. The profiles were recovered with good discrimination (accuracy = 0.81; macro-average AUC = 0.89), with the Problem-Dependent profile being the most distinguishable (AUC = 0.94). SHAP analysis identified depression, smartphone addiction, and executive-function difficulties as key correlates of the Problem-Dependent profile, whereas conscientiousness was central to the Rational-Tool profile.
CONCLUSIONS: GenAI use profiles were associated with different levels of depression and anxiety among college students. Person-centered prevention strategies should focus on usage motivation, AI literacy, and dependency rather than frequency alone.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：中国大学生生成式人工智能使用的潜在剖面：与抑郁和焦虑的关联
摘要：背景：虽然生成式人工智能（GenAI）已被大学生迅速采用，但其与心理健康的关系仍不清楚。多数研究将人工智能使用者视为同质群体，忽略了GenAI使用中的异质性。本研究识别了中国大学生GenAI使用的潜在剖面，并考察了其与抑郁和焦虑的关联。
方法：对5748名中国大学生进行横断面调查，使用贝克抑郁量表第二版和贝克焦虑量表评估人工智能使用情况、动机、人工智能素养、依赖程度及抑郁和焦虑症状。采用潜在剖面分析识别使用模式。使用带SHapley加性解释（SHAP）的探索性随机森林分类器，评估这些剖面是否可从未用于剖面构建的心理和人口统计学相关因素中预测，并识别关键区分因素。
结果：识别出四个剖面：理性工具型、中度娱乐型、问题依赖型和轻度探索型。问题依赖型剖面（15%）以高逃避动机、低人工智能素养和高依赖性为特征，表现出最高的抑郁和焦虑水平；而理性工具型剖面以高人工智能素养和工具性动机为特征，表现出最有利的结果。各剖面具有良好的判别效度（准确率=0.81；宏平均AUC=0.89），其中问题依赖型剖面最易区分（AUC=0.94）。SHAP分析识别出抑郁、智能手机成瘾和执行功能困难是问题依赖型剖面的关键相关因素，而尽责性是理性工具型剖面的核心因素。
结论：大学生中GenAI使用剖面与不同程度的抑郁和焦虑相关。以个体为中心的预防策略应关注使用动机、人工智能素养和依赖性，而不仅仅是使用频率。
关键词：生成式人工智能；潜在剖面分析；抑郁；焦虑；大学生心理健康

title: Changes in mental health outcomes of middle-aged and older adults during the COVID-19 pandemic: A scoping review.
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic negatively impacted mental health, particularly among middle-aged and older adults, who have emerged as especially vulnerable. This scoping review synthesizes findings from 44 population-based studies retrieved from six databases, aiming to map changes in mental health outcomes during the pandemic and identify associated factors. During the global spread and response phase of the pandemic (May 2020-December 2021), a notable rise in depressive symptoms, anxiety symptoms, stress, distress, loneliness, and poor well-being was documented, highlighting a decrease in overall mental health of middle-aged and older adults. Whereas some studies from the transition period toward the endemic phase of the pandemic (2022-2023), began reporting signs of stabilization or improvement, particularly in depressive symptoms, anxiety symptoms and stress. Factors influencing these negative mental health outcomes were multidimensional (demographic, socioeconomic, health-related, behavioral, and COVID-19-related factors). Female sex, old age, being married, unemployment, lower education status, higher income, poor physical health, limited physical activity, perceived threat of COVID-19, social isolation, and lack of support were mainly associated with worsening mental health changes during the pandemic among middle-aged and older adults. However, there is little research highlighting population-level factors (COVID-19 cases, deaths, vaccination status, etc.) associated with these changes. Also, the evidence remains limited regarding mental health changes during the transition to the endemic phase, possibly due to shifts in research priorities, but it is essential to continue monitoring mental health outcomes to track long-term changes and to prepare for future public health emergencies.

相关性：是

优先级：常规收录
标题：COVID-19疫情期间中老年人心理健康结局的变化：一项范围综述
摘要：COVID-19疫情对心理健康产生了负面影响，其中中老年人尤为脆弱。本范围综述综合了从六个数据库中检索到的44项基于人群的研究，旨在描绘疫情期间心理健康结局的变化并识别相关因素。在疫情的全球传播与应对阶段（2020年5月至2021年12月），抑郁症状、焦虑症状、压力、困扰、孤独感和幸福感低下显著增加，表明中老年人整体心理健康水平下降。而部分来自疫情向地方性流行阶段过渡时期（2022-2023年）的研究开始报告稳定或改善的迹象，尤其是在抑郁症状、焦虑症状和压力方面。影响这些负面心理健康结局的因素是多维度的（人口统计学、社会经济、健康相关、行为及COVID-19相关因素）。女性、高龄、已婚、失业、教育水平较低、收入较高、身体健康状况差、体力活动有限、感知到COVID-19威胁、社会隔离及缺乏支持主要与疫情期间中老年人心理健康恶化相关。然而，很少有研究关注与这些变化相关的人群层面因素（如COVID-19病例数、死亡数、疫苗接种状况等）。此外，关于向地方性流行阶段过渡期间心理健康变化的证据仍然有限，这可能是由于研究重心的转移，但持续监测心理健康结局以追踪长期变化并为未来突发公共卫生事件做好准备仍至关重要。
关键词：COVID-19；心理健康；中老年人；范围综述；纵向变化

title: Identification of suicidal ideation in major depressive disorder: A machine learning approach with multimodal digital features.
summary: Current detection models for suicidal ideation (SI) among depressed patients have primarily relied on clinical and biological features. This study aims at enhancing the real-world applicability of these models by using multimodal digital features. Patients self-administered the Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) and 20-item Toronto Alexithymia Scale (TAS-20). Their multimodal features (facial, acoustic and linguistic features) were obtained using ecological momentary assessment (EMA) with our self-developed smartphone application over 7 days. The Structured Interview Guide for the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HDRS) were conducted to identify clinically rated SI. Mood description recordings obtained from EMA were processed through natural language processing, Openface, and OpenSmile to obtain linguistic, facial and acoustics features, respectively. Multimodal features and questionnaires were then used for training and testing machine learning algorithms. The study was conducted and reported under the TRIPOD+AI guideline. Among the recruited 99 patients with major depressive disorder (MDD), 38 (mean age = 49.3 ± 9.7 y, 76% female) had SI while 61 (mean age = 51.5 ± 11.5 y, 76% female) did not have SI. Among the 10 machine learning models evaluated, the CatBoost classifier demonstrated the strongest detection performance, achieving an AUC of 0.79 (p < .001), accuracy of 0.79 and F1-score of 0.73. K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Naive Bayes models also provided comparable results. Multimodal features were correlated with SI among MDD patients. Machine learning algorithms have modest performance in identifying SI among patients with MDD using multimodal digital features, including facial expressions, vocal characteristics and language use. However, larger and more diverse datasets are needed to enhance the generalizability and accuracy of these machine learning approaches in real-world clinical settings.

相关性：是

优先级：常规收录
标题：重度抑郁障碍中自杀意念的识别：基于多模态数字特征与机器学习的方法
摘要：当前针对抑郁患者自杀意念（SI）的检测模型主要依赖临床和生物学特征。本研究旨在通过使用多模态数字特征来提升这些模型的现实世界适用性。患者自我报告完成医院焦虑抑郁量表（HADS）和20项多伦多述情障碍量表（TAS-20）。通过我们自行开发的智能手机应用程序，采用生态瞬时评估（EMA）在7天内获取患者的多模态特征（面部、声学和语言特征）。采用汉密尔顿抑郁量表结构化访谈指南（HDRS）来识别临床评定的自杀意念。从EMA获取的情绪描述录音分别通过自然语言处理、OpenFace和OpenSmile进行处理，以获得语言、面部和声学特征。随后使用多模态特征和问卷数据进行机器学习算法的训练与测试。本研究按照TRIPOD+AI指南进行和报告。在招募的99名重度抑郁障碍（MDD）患者中，38名（平均年龄=49.3±9.7岁，76%为女性）存在自杀意念，而61名（平均年龄=51.5±11.5岁，76%为女性）无自杀意念。在评估的10种机器学习模型中，CatBoost分类器显示出最强的检测性能，AUC达0.79（p<.001），准确率为0.79，F1得分为0.73。K近邻（KNN）、人工神经网络（ANN）和朴素贝叶斯模型也提供了相当的结果。多模态特征与MDD患者的自杀意念相关。机器学习算法利用多模态数字特征（包括面部表情、声音特征和语言使用）识别MDD患者的自杀意念表现出中等水平的性能。然而，需要更大且更多样化的数据集来提升这些机器学习方法在真实世界临床场景中的泛化性和准确性。
关键词：自杀意念；重度抑郁障碍；多模态数字特征；生态瞬时评估；机器学习

title: Digital mental health apps for young people in Europe: A systematic cross-country analysis.
summary: Mental health smartphone applications have become widely available for self-management and support, offering young people new pathways for help-seeking. Despite their increasing popularity, little is known about how app accessibility, content, and features vary across countries, languages, and cultural contexts. This study aimed to systematically examine these differences by drawing on data from the available app stores. Both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store were searched across seven European countries (Croatia, France, Ireland, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, and Türkiye) using four keywords: mental health, psychological wellbeing, self-help, and stress. App results were screened through redefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the included apps were systematically characterized based on their aims, features, and linguistic accessibility. Over 900 apps were initially identified, and 171 met the inclusion criteria. The most commonly encountered apps were structured journaling and meditation apps, and most were partially paid and primarily available in English, highlighting a predominance of commercially oriented apps and a limited availability of local-language apps and minimal cultural adaptation. Together, the findings underscore the need for research and policy to prioritize cross-country accessibility, particularly for non-English speaking youth, to ensure equitable access to digital mental health resources.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：[心理健康与数字心理干预]
优先级：常规收录
标题：欧洲青少年数字心理健康应用：一项系统性跨国分析
摘要：心理健康智能手机应用已广泛用于自我管理和支持，为青少年提供了寻求帮助的新途径。尽管这类应用日益普及，但人们对应用的可及性、内容和功能在不同国家、语言和文化背景下的差异知之甚少。本研究旨在通过获取应用商店的可得数据，系统考察这些差异。研究在七个欧洲国家（克罗地亚、法国、爱尔兰、波兰、葡萄牙、塞尔维亚和土耳其）的苹果App Store和Google Play Store中，使用四个关键词（心理健康、心理幸福感、自助和压力）进行搜索。通过重新界定的纳入和排除标准对应用结果进行筛选，并对纳入应用的目标、功能和语言可及性进行系统特征化描述。初步识别出900余款应用，其中171款符合纳入标准。最常见的应用为结构化日记和冥想类应用，多数为部分付费且主要以英语提供，凸显出商业化应用占主导地位，本地语言应用有限且文化适应性极低。总体而言，研究结果强调研究与政策需优先关注跨国可及性问题，特别是针对非英语青少年的可及性，以确保数字心理健康资源的公平获取。
关键词：数字心理健康应用；青少年；跨国分析；应用商店；可及性

title: The impact of Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behaviour Therapy for psychosis on post-traumatic stress symptoms in daily life: ESM outcomes of the STAR Trial.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: People with psychosis have high rates of post-traumatic stress-disorder (PTSD). The STAR (Study of Trauma And Recovery) randomised controlled trial found that a Trauma-Focused therapy integrated with Cognitive Behaviour Therapy for psychosis (TF-CBTp) added to Treatment-As-Usual (TAU) reduced PTSD symptoms in people with psychosis compared to TAU only. We hypothesized that TF-CBTp would also reduce PTSD symptoms in daily life, using Experience Sampling Methodology (ESM), which would be associated with improvements on a clinical measure of PTSD.
METHODS: Participants were adults with PTSD and schizophrenia-spectrum diagnoses, a subsample of the STAR trial (N=153; TF-CBTp+TAU=73, TAU=80). Participants completed ESM assessments of intrusive memories, hyperarousal, dissociation, avoidance and negative trauma-related cognitions through a smartphone app multiple times daily over six days, at baseline and 9-months post-randomisation (end-of-therapy).
RESULTS: No between-group differences were found in ESM measures of momentary PTSD symptoms at 9-months. Significant timepoint×therapy interactions indicated greater decrease over time in hyperarousal, negative cognitions, and avoidance, and in variability of intrusive memories, in TF-CBTp+TAU compared to TAU. ESM measures at 9-months were significantly associated with improvements on the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5.
CONCLUSION: While findings are tentatively in favour of TF-CBTp, the robust reductions in PTSD symptoms found in the STAR trial using retrospective outcome measures were not fully replicated with ESM, suggesting these methodologies may be capturing different features of symptom expression and processes of therapeutic change. Including both approaches in future research could provide a fuller picture of therapy effects on 'in-the-moment' versus reflective reports of experiences.
translation:
相关性：是
主题标签：EMA/ESM 与密集纵向测量；心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：重点推荐
标题：创伤聚焦认知行为疗法对精神病患者日常生活中创伤后应激症状的影响：STAR试验的ESM结果
摘要：引言：精神病患者中创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）的患病率较高。STAR（创伤与康复研究）随机对照试验发现，在常规治疗（TAU）基础上整合创伤聚焦治疗与精神病认知行为疗法（TF-CBTp）相比单纯TAU可减轻精神病患者的PTSD症状。我们假设，使用经验取样法（ESM）测量，TF-CBTp还能减少日常生活中的PTSD症状，并与临床PTSD测量的改善相关。方法：参与者为患有PTSD和精神分裂症谱系诊断的成年人，为STAR试验的一个亚样本（N=153；TF-CBTp+TAU=73，TAU=80）。参与者在基线和随机化后9个月（治疗结束）通过智能手机应用程序每天多次完成侵入性记忆、高唤醒、解离、回避和创伤相关负性认知的ESM评估，持续六天。结果：在9个月时， momentary PTSD症状的ESM测量未发现组间差异。显著的时间点×治疗交互作用表明，与TAU相比，TF-CBTp+TAU在高唤醒、负性认知和回避以及侵入性记忆变异性方面随时间下降幅度更大。9个月时的ESM测量与临床医生 administered PTSD量表（DSM-5版）的改善显著相关。结论：虽然研究结果初步支持TF-CBTp，但STAR试验中使用回顾性结局测量发现的PTSD症状的稳健减少未在ESM中得到完全复制，提示这些方法可能捕捉了症状表达和治疗改变过程的不同特征。在未来研究中同时纳入两种方法，可更全面地呈现治疗对“即时”体验报告与反思性体验报告的影响。
关键词：创伤聚焦认知行为疗法；精神病；创伤后应激障碍；经验取样法；日常生活

title: Prospective Links between Intraindividual Measures of Negative Affect and Physical Well-being among Couples Coping with Cancer.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Research examining associations between intraindividual variability in affective experiences and health stems largely from non-clinical samples and individuals versus within a dyadic context. We sought to examine this linkage in couples coping with cancer.
METHODS: 233 patients with cancer and their spouses/partners (mean age = 52.5) completed twice-daily ecological momentary assessments for 14 days. Nine negative affect items were used to compute intraindividual negative affect means, standard deviations (SDs, capturing overall dispersion), and mean square successive differences (MSSDs, capturing occasion-to-occasion shifts). Upon study entry and 12 months later, participants completed a measure of physical well-being. Within- and across-partner associations between negative affect dynamics and 12-month change in physical well-being were examined using an Actor-Partner Interdependence Model framework.
RESULTS: When SD was used as the indicator of negative affect intraindividual variability, higher mean negative affect predicted declines in physical well-being for caregivers (actor effect, P=.035), and greater patient variability predicted declines in caregiver physical well-being (partner effect, P=.036). When MSSD was used as the indicator of intraindividual variability, greater patient variability predicted declines in their own physical well-being more strongly among those with lower average negative affect (patient mean x patient MSSD interaction, P=.021) and for patients whose partners had greater negative affect variability (patient MSSD x caregiver MSSD interaction, P=.013).
CONCLUSIONS: Future work could examine intervention strategies to minimize negative affect and foster equanimity in this population, potentially tailoring based on participants' own mean levels and their partner's variability.

标题：癌症应对夫妻中负性情绪个体内测量与躯体健康的前瞻性关联
摘要：目的：关于情感体验的个体内变异与健康之间关联的研究主要来自非临床样本，且多针对个体而非二元情境。本研究旨在考察癌症应对夫妻中的这种关联。方法：233名癌症患者及其配偶/伴侣（平均年龄=52.5岁）完成了为期14天、每日两次的生态瞬时评估。采用九个负性情绪条目计算个体内负性情绪均值、标准差（SD，反映整体离散程度）和均方逐次差（MSSD，反映逐次波动）。参与者在入组时及12个月后分别完成躯体健康测量。采用行动者-伴侣相互依赖模型框架，检验负性情绪动态与12个月躯体健康变化在个体内及跨伴侣间的关联。结果：当以SD作为负性情绪个体内变异指标时，较高的负性情绪均值预测照护者躯体健康下降（行动者效应，P=.035），患者较大的情绪变异性预测照护者躯体健康下降（伴侣效应，P=.036）。当以MSSD作为个体内变异指标时，患者较大的情绪变异性对其自身躯体健康下降的预测作用在平均负性情绪较低者中更强（患者均值×患者MSSD交互，P=.021），且当伴侣具有较大负性情绪变异性时该效应更为显著（患者MSSD×照护者MSSD交互，P=.013）。结论：未来研究可探索减少该人群负性情绪并促进情绪平稳的干预策略，可能需根据参与者自身均值水平及其伴侣的情绪变异性进行个体化调整。
关键词：负性情绪；个体内变异；生态瞬时评估；躯体健康；夫妻二元分析

title: Acceptance and vagal reactivity: Insights from a laboratory-based study of emotion regulation in late life.
summary: Acceptance (i.e., embracing emotions and thoughts without judging them) is an emotion regulation strategy that can benefit mental and physical health. To shed more light on its proximal physiological mechanisms, the present laboratory-based study examined links between the habitual use of acceptance and vagal reactivity during instructed emotion regulation in late life, when acceptance may become particularly important. In a sample of 129 older adults (aged 64-83), we examined habitual emotional acceptance (using questionnaires) and vagal reactivity (using respiratory sinus arrhythmia) during instructed emotion regulation (as participants watched loss-themed film clips while instructed to regulate their emotions, controlling for respiratory sinus arrhythmia reactivity during "just-watch" trials). Specificity analyses examined (a) other habitual emotion regulation strategies (i.e., detachment, reappraisal) and (b) sympathetic nervous system reactivity (using preejection period) during emotion regulation. Results showed that habitual emotional acceptance (but not detachment or reappraisal) was associated with greater respiratory sinus arrhythmia (but not preejection period) reactivity during instructed emotion regulation. Results remained stable when controlling for age, gender, respiration rate and amplitude, and health behaviors. These findings show that habitual acceptance is linked to greater vagal reactivity during instructed emotion regulation and provide novel insights into late-life emotion regulation. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

标题：接纳与迷走反应性：基于实验室的晚年情绪调节研究启示
摘要：接纳（即不加评判地拥抱情绪和想法）是一种有益于心理和身体健康的情绪调节策略。为更深入地揭示其近端生理机制，本研究在实验室条件下考察了晚年期（此时接纳可能尤为重要）习惯性接纳使用与指令性情绪调节期间迷走反应性之间的关系。研究样本包括129名老年人（年龄64-83岁），我们通过问卷测量习惯性情绪接纳，并在指令性情绪调节任务中（参与者观看丧失主题电影片段并被指示调节情绪，控制“仅观看”试次中的呼吸性窦性心律不齐反应性）测量迷走反应性（以呼吸性窦性心律不齐为指标）。特异性分析考察了（a）其他习惯性情绪调节策略（即抽离、重新评价）和（b）情绪调节期间交感神经系统反应性（以射血前期为指标）。结果显示，习惯性情绪接纳（而非抽离或重新评价）与指令性情绪调节期间更大的呼吸性窦性心律不齐反应性（而非射血前期反应性）相关。在控制年龄、性别、呼吸频率和幅度及健康行为后，结果保持稳定。这些发现表明，习惯性接纳与指令性情绪调节期间更大的迷走反应性相关，为晚年情绪调节提供了新的见解。（PsycInfo数据库记录（c）2026 APA，版权所有）
关键词：接纳；迷走反应性；情绪调节；晚年；呼吸性窦性心律不齐

title: Emotional conceptual structures in high depression and anxiety: Combining low-dimensional and network models.
summary: Emotional differentiation-the ability to distinguish between distinct emotions-has been identified as a protective factor against psychopathology, yet most research has focused on experiential-level differentiation with limited understanding of how depression and anxiety relate to the conceptual structure of emotion knowledge. We conducted two complementary studies. Study 1 (N = 1,311, aged 8-25, collected during 2023) used similarity and transition probability ratings to construct low-dimensional spaces (via INdividual Differences SCALing) and network models, examining associations with self-reported levels of depression and anxiety symptoms. To examine these findings with a different sample, Study 2 (N = 88, aged 18-23, collected during 2022) combined 14-day experience sampling with pre-post semantic similarity assessments, testing whether daily emotional covariation patterns relate to changes in conceptual structure and symptom levels. Study 1 revealed that higher symptoms were associated with reduced differentiation in low-dimensional emotion space (lower weight in Dimension 1), denser similarity networks (e.g., reflected by shorter path lengths), and increased transition probabilities. Study 2 replicated these patterns and demonstrated plasticity in semantic emotion networks: Participants showed decreased Dimension 1 weight and looser network organization over time. More extensive emotional covariation predicted increased Dimension 1 weight, which mediated relationships with depressive symptom changes; however, this effect was abolished after controlling for baseline Beck's Depression Inventory. Depression was associated with rigid, congruent covariation patterns, while anxiety was linked to unstable, incongruent patterns. These findings suggest depression and anxiety are characterized by compressed, less differentiated emotion concept structures, offering insights for targeted interventions enhancing emotional health. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

标题：高抑郁与焦虑中的情绪概念结构：结合低维模型与网络模型
摘要：情绪分化——即区分不同情绪的能力——已被认定为心理病理学的保护因素，然而大多数研究聚焦于体验层面的分化，对抑郁和焦虑如何与情绪知识的概念结构相关联的理解仍有限。我们开展了两项互补研究。研究1（N = 1,311，年龄8–25岁，2023年收集）使用相似性和转移概率评分，通过个体差异标度构建低维空间和网络模型，并检验其与自我报告的抑郁和焦虑症状水平的关联。为在不同样本中检验这些发现，研究2（N = 88，年龄18–23岁，2022年收集）将14天经验采样与前后语义相似性评估相结合，检验日常情绪共变模式是否与概念结构及症状水平的变化相关。研究1显示，较高症状与低维情绪空间中分化程度降低（维度1权重较低）、相似性网络更密集（如路径长度更短）以及转移概率增加相关。研究2复制了这些模式，并证明了语义情绪网络的可塑性：参与者随时间表现出维度1权重下降和网络组织松散化。更广泛的情绪共变预测维度1权重增加，并在抑郁症状变化的关系中起中介作用；然而，在控制基线贝克抑郁量表得分后，该效应消失。抑郁与刻板、一致的情绪共变模式相关，而焦虑与不稳定、不一致的模式相关。这些发现表明，抑郁和焦虑以压缩的、分化不足的情绪概念结构为特征，为增强情绪健康的有针对性干预提供了见解。（PsycInfo数据库记录（c）2026 APA，版权所有）
关键词：情绪分化；情绪概念结构；经验采样；抑郁与焦虑；网络模型

title: Assessing Psychiatric Symptoms in Autistic Youth Using the K-CAT®.
summary:
PURPOSE: While highly prevalent, mental health (MH) challenges in autistic youth often go unrecognized due in part to the lack of an accurate, comprehensive MH assessment tool. The K-CAT® was developed to address barriers to identification of MH concerns in the general population offering efficient electronic measurement of up to nine MH domains. While several features support its use with autistic youth, the K-CAT® has neither been extensively used nor studied with this population. Therefore, this study evaluated how the K-CAT® performed with autistic youth with varying presentations.
METHODS: One hundred fifty-five 7-to-17-year-old autistic youth without intellectual disability and their caregivers completed the K-CAT® and several additional measures remotely. Data on K-CAT® administration and results were analyzed and compared across relevant clinical characteristics, including age, language level, and autism severity.
RESULTS: The K-CAT® identified a range of MH concerns, and prevalence estimates aligned with previous research. However, K-CAT® completion appeared more difficult for younger participants and for autistic youth with lower receptive language scores. Several K-CAT® Child Version scores were significantly associated with receptive language level whereas all K-CAT® Parent Version scores were associated with autism severity estimates. While K-CAT® results were highly correlated with existing measures, parent-child agreement was relatively low and variable across subgroups of autistic youth.
CONCLUSIONS: Results may signal challenges with using the existing K-CAT® to assess autistic youth. K-CAT® adaptations are likely necessary to improve accessibility, linguistic clarity, and diagnostic specificity and will be important to promote scalable, equitable MH screening for autistic youth.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预

标题：使用K-CAT®评估自闭症青少年精神症状
摘要：目的：虽然心理健康问题在自闭症青少年中高度普遍，但往往未被识别，部分原因是缺乏准确、全面的心理健康评估工具。K-CAT®的开发旨在解决普通人群中心理健康问题识别的障碍，可对多达九个心理健康领域进行高效的电子化测量。尽管其多项特征支持其用于自闭症青少年，但K-CAT®在该人群中的使用和研究均十分有限。因此，本研究评估了K-CAT®在不同表现的自闭症青少年中的表现。方法：155名7至17岁无智力障碍的自闭症青少年及其照护者远程完成了K-CAT®及多项补充测量。研究对K-CAT®的实施过程和结果数据进行了分析，并比较了相关临床特征（包括年龄、语言水平和自闭症严重程度）。结果：K-CAT®识别出了一系列心理健康问题，患病率估计与既往研究一致。然而，年龄较小及接受性语言得分较低的自闭症青少年完成K-CAT®的难度更大。多项K-CAT®儿童版得分与接受性语言水平显著相关，而所有K-CAT®家长版得分均与自闭症严重程度估计显著相关。虽然K-CAT®结果与现有测量高度相关，但亲子一致性相对较低，且在自闭症青少年的不同亚组间存在差异。结论：研究结果提示现有K-CAT®在评估自闭症青少年时可能存在挑战。K-CAT®的适应性调整很可能有助于提高可及性、语言清晰度和诊断特异性，这对促进自闭症青少年可扩展、公平的心理健康筛查具有重要意义。

关键词：自闭症青少年；精神症状评估；K-CAT®；数字化心理健康筛查；亲子一致性

title: Item drift in the Youth Self-Report: IRT gradient analysis with suicidal ideation and self-harm items as illustrative examples.
summary: Recent increases in adolescent psychological problems have often been interpreted as evidence of a generalized deterioration in youth mental health. However, long-term trends in self-reported psychological distress have yielded a mixed picture and have not consistently paralleled increases in endorsement of specific symptoms, including suicide- and self-harm-related indicators. This discrepancy raises a measurement question: can item endorsement change even when overall latent distress remains relatively stable? We applied a time-anchored item response theory framework to Youth Self-Report (YSR) data from four repeated cross-sectional cohorts of Polish adolescents assessed in 2000, 2011, 2013, and 2018 (N = 3,920). Multiple-group graded response models were used to estimate cohort differences in latent distress and temporal changes in item functioning. Probability-gradient analyses were used to trace diffuse, severity-dependent changes in item functioning across the latent trait continuum. Latent levels of psychological distress increased modestly between 2000 and 2011 and then remained relatively stable through 2018. In contrast, item-level analyses revealed selective temporal drift in the relation between item endorsement and latent distress. Distinct patterns were observed, including severity-dependent drift, gradient reversal, and stable item functioning. Suicide- and self-harm-related YSR items showed higher endorsement probabilities at equivalent levels of underlying distress in later cohorts, especially at moderate-to-high levels of latent internalizing severity. Apparent stability in broad adolescent self-reported distress can conceal changes in how specific YSR items relate to underlying distress. Monitoring youth mental health may therefore benefit from item-level approaches that account for temporal changes in item functioning, while avoiding direct interpretation of single YSR items as full clinical measures of suicidality or self-harm.

相关性：是
主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：青少年自评量表条目的漂移：以自杀意念与自伤条目为例的IRT梯度分析
摘要：近年来青少年心理问题的增加常被解读为青少年心理健康普遍恶化的证据。然而，自我报告心理困扰的长期趋势呈现出混杂图景，并未始终与特定症状（包括自杀和自伤相关指标）的报告率上升保持一致。这一差异引出了一个测量问题：当整体潜在困扰保持相对稳定时，条目报告率是否仍可能发生变化？本研究将时间锚定的项目反应理论框架应用于四波重复横断面队列中波兰青少年的青少年自评量表（Youth Self-Report, YSR）数据，调查年份为2000年、2011年、2013年和2018年（N = 3,920）。采用多组等级反应模型估计潜在困扰的队列差异及条目功能的跨时间变化。使用概率梯度分析追踪潜在特质连续谱上条目功能的弥散性、严重程度依赖性变化。潜在心理困扰水平在2000年至2011年间适度上升，此后至2018年保持相对稳定。相反，条目层面分析揭示了条目报告率与潜在困扰之间关系的选择性时间漂移。研究观察到不同模式，包括严重程度依赖性漂移、梯度反转和稳定的条目功能。在后期队列中，自杀和自伤相关的YSR条目在同等潜在困扰水平下表现出更高的报告概率，尤其在潜在内化严重程度的中高层面。广泛的青少年自我报告困扰的表观稳定性可能掩盖了特定YSR条目与潜在困扰之间关系的变化。因此，监测青少年心理健康可能需要纳入考虑条目功能跨时间变化的条目层面方法，同时避免将单个YSR条目直接解读为自杀倾向或自伤的完整临床测量指标。
关键词：项目反应理论；条目功能漂移；青少年自评量表；自杀意念；自我伤害

title: Relationships between counselor statements and student connection to mental health care: A cross-sectional analysis of digital screening platform conversations.
summary: Objective: To examine the relationship between counselor communication techniques and students seeking referrals to care within the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention's (AFSP's) Interactive Screening Program's (ISP's) text-based chats. Participants: Data included 14,931 text-based chats between students and counselors from 58 U.S. colleges that used the ISP between 2009 and 2024. Methods: Natural Language Processing was used to analyze ISP counselor communication techniques within the online chats. Results: Counselor informing statements (aOR: 1.98, 95% CI: 1.78-2.21), emotional reactions (aOR: 1.11, 95% CI: 1.02-1.20), and longer dialogue length (aOR: 1.30, 95% CI: 1.28-1.32) were positively associated with seeking a referral. Counselor interpretations (aOR: 0.32, 95% CI: 0.29-0.35), explorations (aOR: 0.32, 95% CI: 0.28-0.36), and normalizing statements (aOR: 0.69, 95% CI: 0.61-0.78) were negatively associated with seeking a referral. Conclusions: Findings advance understanding of how counselors might prioritize using specific language in text-based chats to support students seeking a referral to care.

标题：咨询师陈述与学生心理健康照护连接之间的关系：数字筛查平台对话的横断面分析
摘要：目的：检验美国自杀预防基金会（AFSP）互动筛查项目（ISP）文本聊天中咨询师沟通技巧与学生寻求转介照护之间的关系。参与者：数据包括2009年至2024年间使用ISP的58所美国高校学生与咨询师之间的14,931次文本聊天。方法：采用自然语言处理技术分析ISP在线聊天中咨询师的沟通技巧。结果：咨询师的信息告知陈述（aOR：1.98，95% CI：1.78-2.21）、情绪反应（aOR：1.11，95% CI：1.02-1.20）和更长的对话篇幅（aOR：1.30，95% CI：1.28-1.32）与寻求转介呈正相关。咨询师的解释性陈述（aOR：0.32，95% CI：0.29-0.35）、探索性陈述（aOR：0.32，95% CI：0.28-0.36）和正常化陈述（aOR：0.69，95% CI：0.61-0.78）与寻求转介呈负相关。结论：研究结果增进了对咨询师如何在文本聊天中优先使用特定语言以支持学生寻求照护转介的理解。

title: Gratitude and savoring interventions for older adults: a narrative review.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Gratitude and savoring have great potential to support well-being in older age, but most studies on positive psychology interventions have been conducted among healthy young adults. This narrative review explored gratitude and savoring interventions for older adults, with or without dementia, including (1) the characteristics of these interventions, (2) their acceptability for older users, and (3) their effect on mental health.
RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: Scopus, PubMed, PsychInfo, Web of Science, and CINAHL were searched in December 2023 and April 2025. Studies were eligible if they examined gratitude or savoring interventions among older adults. Multi-component intervention studies were excluded. Two researchers independently screened 2423 studies and assessed methodological quality using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Numerical and narrative data were extracted and synthesized regarding intervention characteristics, acceptability, and effectiveness.
RESULTS: Of the 11 included articles, five examined gratitude, five examined savoring, and one compared both. Only one study included participants with dementia. Adherence was generally high, suggesting a good fit, but participant evaluation was lacking. Four acceptability themes were highlighted concerning the target group, setting and delivery mode, dosage, and content and tailoring. Most studies showed improved well-being and reduced psychopathology, although not consistently on all outcome measures.
DISCUSSION AND IMPLICATIONS: There is initial evidence that gratitude and savoring interventions could be suitable to promote mental health among older adults with relatively preserved cognitive function. Future research should examine the need for tailoring in terms of dose, delivery method and content, and applicability to more diverse groups of older adults.

标题：感恩与品味干预在老年人中的应用：一项叙述性综述
摘要：背景与目标：感恩与品味在支持老年幸福感方面具有巨大潜力，但大多数积极心理学干预研究均在健康的年轻成年人中开展。本叙述性综述探讨了针对老年人（含或不含痴呆症）的感恩与品味干预，包括：(1) 这些干预的特征；(2) 老年用户对其的可接受性；(3) 其对心理健康的影响。研究方法与设计：于2023年12月和2025年4月检索了Scopus、PubMed、PsychInfo、Web of Science和CINAHL数据库。纳入标准为考察老年人感恩或品味干预的研究，排除多成分干预研究。两名研究者独立筛选了2423项研究，并使用混合方法评估工具评估方法学质量。提取并综合了关于干预特征、可接受性和有效性的数值及叙述性数据。结果：在纳入的11篇文章中，5篇考察感恩干预，5篇考察品味干预，1篇对两者进行比较。仅1项研究纳入痴呆症参与者。依从性总体较高，表明干预适配性良好，但缺乏参与者评价。关于目标群体、场景与实施方式、剂量以及内容与个性化调整，提炼出四个可接受性主题。大多数研究显示幸福感提升和精神病理症状减少，但并非在所有结局指标上均一致显著。讨论与启示：初步证据表明，感恩和品味干预可能适用于认知功能相对保留的老年人以促进心理健康。未来研究应考察在剂量、实施方式和内容方面的个性化调整需求，以及其在更多元老年群体中的适用性。
关键词：感恩干预；品味干预；老年人；心理健康；积极心理学

title: Precision psychiatry in clinical practice: What is clinically actionable, what is promising, and what remains experimental?
summary: Precision psychiatry seeks to improve individual-level prediction, treatment selection, monitoring, and prevention by integrating clinical, biological, behavioural, digital, and contextual information. This structured narrative review assessed the clinical readiness of major approaches using a purpose-specific framework covering validity, external replication, incremental utility, actionability, patient benefit, feasibility, equity, and governance. Approaches considered clinically actionable in selected settings included structured longitudinal assessment and decision-linked measurement-based care as precision-enabling infrastructure, therapeutic drug monitoring for selected medications and indications, and selected pharmacogenetic gene-drug interactions. Digital phenotyping, artificial intelligence-assisted decision support, neuroimaging and electrophysiological markers, peripheral biomarkers, and multimodal prediction models were classified as promising but not yet ready for routine use. Polygenic risk scores, multiomic subtyping, diagnostic neuroimaging, fully automated treatment selection, and automated prediction of suicide or acute deterioration remained predominantly experimental. Across domains, major barriers included inadequate external validation and calibration, uncertain incremental utility, limited prospective evidence of patient benefit, implementation challenges, cost, underrepresentation of diverse populations, privacy concerns, and unresolved accountability. Precision psychiatry is best understood as a dynamic translational continuum whose value should be judged by whether it supports better, safer, more equitable, and more humane clinical decisions.

标题：临床实践中的精准精神病学：哪些具有临床可操作性，哪些具有前景，哪些仍处于实验阶段？
摘要：精准精神病学旨在通过整合临床、生物学、行为、数字和环境信息，改善个体层面的预测、治疗选择、监测和预防。本结构化叙述性综述采用一项专门框架评估了主要方法的临床就绪度，该框架涵盖效度、外部重复验证、增量效用、可操作性、患者获益、可行性、公平性和治理。在特定情境中被认为具有临床可操作性的方法包括：作为精准赋能基础设施的结构化纵向评估和与决策挂钩的基于测量的照护、针对特定药物和适应证的药物治疗监测，以及选定的药物基因组学基因-药物相互作用。数字表型、人工智能辅助决策支持、神经影像和电生理标志物、外周生物标志物以及多模态预测模型被归类为具有前景但尚未可用于常规临床使用。多基因风险评分、多组学分型、诊断性神经影像、全自动治疗选择以及自杀或急性恶化的自动预测仍主要处于实验阶段。在各领域，主要障碍包括外部验证和校准不足、增量效用不确定、患者获益的前瞻性证据有限、实施挑战、成本、多样化人群代表性不足、隐私问题以及问责机制不明确。精准精神病学应被理解为一个动态的转化连续体，其价值应取决于它是否有助于做出更好、更安全、更公平且更人性化的临床决策。
关键词：精准精神病学；数字表型；基于测量的照护；生物标志物；临床就绪度

title: Multimethod examination of change in autistic preschoolers' emotion dysregulation in the context of parenting stress intervention.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Many autistic preschoolers experience heightened emotion dysregulation and rely heavily on parents for co-regulatory support, which may be compromised by elevated parenting stress.
METHODS: We examined secondary outcomes of a randomized trial (ClinicalTrials.gov - NCT03459625) to assess downstream effects of parent stress-reduction interventions (MBSR vs. Psychoeducational Support) on emotion dysregulation in autistic children with diverse developmental and behavioral profiles (N = 117). We also explored cross-method, cross-context correspondence between parent report of children's regulatory tendencies and observational ratings derived from independent and dyadic parent-child problem-solving tasks.
RESULTS: Parent-reported child dysregulation and observed dyadic dysregulation decreased significantly across groups, with reduced parenting stress predicting decreased parent-reported dysregulation. Conversely, observed child independent dysregulation remained relatively stable. Meaningful multimethod associations were identified.
CONCLUSIONS: Results suggest important collateral benefits of parenting stress reduction during the sensitive postdiagnostic period and highlight the sensitivity and utility of parent-reported and observed dyadic dysregulation as trial outcomes, including the new Emotion Dysregulation Inventory-Young Child. Implications for conceptualization and measurement of emotion dysregulation in autism are discussed, as are considerations for optimizing environmental supports.

标题：多方法考察育儿压力干预背景下自闭症学龄前儿童情绪失调的变化
摘要：背景：许多自闭症学龄前儿童经历显著的情绪失调，并高度依赖父母提供共同调节支持，而父母压力升高可能损害这一支持功能。方法：我们考察了一项随机试验（ClinicalTrials.gov - NCT03459625）的次要结局，以评估父母减压干预（正念减压疗法 vs. 心理教育支持）对具有不同发育和行为特征的自闭症儿童（N = 117）情绪失调的下游影响。我们还探讨了父母报告儿童调节倾向与基于独立及二元亲子问题解决任务的观察性评分之间的跨方法、跨情境一致性。结果：父母报告的儿童失调和观察到的二元失调在两组中均显著下降，父母压力降低可预测父母报告的失调减少。相反，观察到的儿童独立失调保持相对稳定。发现了有意义的跨方法关联。结论：结果提示，在敏感的诊后阶段减轻父母压力具有重要的附带益处，并突显了父母报告和观察到的二元失调作为试验结局指标的敏感性和实用性，包括新的儿童情绪失调量表-低龄版。本文还讨论了自闭症情绪失调的概念化与测量意义，以及优化环境支持的考量。

title: Evaluating temporal associations between executive functioning, stress and physical activity among adolescents at risk for type 2 diabetes: protocol for an ecological momentary assessment study.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Adolescent-onset type 2 diabetes (T2D) has increased in prevalence in recent decades. However, the efficacy of preventative interventions targeting health behaviours is limited, and key developmental factors that may influence effectiveness, such as executive functioning (EF) and stress, are often overlooked. Within-person fluctuations in EF and stress are linked to the adoption and maintenance of physical activity, a critical component of T2D prevention, yet little is known about the between- and within-person temporal variability of these constructs or their relationship with physical activity in adolescents at risk for T2D. Ecological momentary assessment (EMA) is ideal to capture these processes in real-time to inform intervention development and personalisation.
METHODS AND ANALYSES: We will enrol a subset of participants from a larger intervention study involving assigned-female-at-birth adolescents aged 12-17 years, with elevated depression symptoms (CES-D≥21) and T2D risk (BMI≥85th percentile) and diabetes family history. Prior to the intervention, a minimum of 50 participants will complete a 7-day EMA protocol consisting of repeated daily gamified EF assessments and brief surveys about EF, stress and physical activity. Participants will simultaneously wear an activity monitor to provide objective measures of physical activity. Recruitment began in Spring 2024 and is ongoing. Multilevel models will be used to separate between- and within-person variability and to estimate short-term lagged within-person associations between EF/stress and subsequent physical activity across 15-60 min windows. Primary analyses are planned for Winter 2026.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The Colorado Multiple Institutional Review Board approved this study (COMIRB#22-0180). Findings will be disseminated in peer-reviewed journals and conference presentations.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05543083.

摘要：引言：近年来，青少年起病的2型糖尿病（T2D）患病率持续上升。然而，针对健康行为的预防性干预效果有限，且可能影响干预有效性的关键发展因素，如执行功能（EF）和压力，常被忽视。执行功能和压力的个体内波动与体力活动的采纳和维持有关，而体力活动是T2D预防的关键组成部分，但关于T2D风险青少年中这些构念的个体间和个体内时间变异性及其与体力活动的关系，目前知之甚少。生态瞬时评估（EMA）是实时捕捉这些过程以指导干预开发和个性化的理想方法。
方法与分析：我们将从一项更大规模的干预研究中招募亚组参与者，纳入对象为出生时指定女性、年龄12-17岁、具有较高抑郁症状（CES-D≥21）和T2D风险（BMI≥第85百分位）且有糖尿病家族史的青少年。在干预前，至少50名参与者将完成一项为期7天的EMA方案，包括每日重复的游戏化执行功能评估以及关于执行功能、压力和体力活动的简短调查。参与者将同时佩戴活动监测仪以获取体力活动的客观测量数据。招募始于2024年春季，目前仍在进行中。将使用多层模型分离个体间和个体内变异，并估计执行功能/压力与随后15-60分钟窗口内体力活动之间的短期滞后个体内关联。主要分析计划于2026年冬季进行。

title: Speech-based relapse prediction in psychosis using explainable AI: Protocol for the international multicentre observational TRUSTING study.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: The course of psychotic disorders typically involves relapses. Early warning signs vary between individuals and are difficult to detect in clinical practice, especially in outpatient settings. Speech provides a quantitative clinical marker for detecting such early warning signs. The EU Horizon project TRUSTING (A TRUSTworthy speech-based AI monitoring system for the prediction of relapse in individuals with schizophrenia) aims to develop and evaluate a speech-based monitoring system for predicting imminent psychotic relapses. The study will examine the potential for prospective relapse prediction, and feasibility and usability of the monitoring system.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: In this multicentre observational study, n=240 remitted and at-risk-of-relapse adults with psychotic disorders and a comparison group with n=120 healthy participants (matched by age and sex) will be examined at six sites and in six different languages (German, French, Dutch, English, Czech and Turkish). The follow-up period is 6 months. The TRUSTING smartphone app will be used to collect weekly voice recordings through speech tasks; information on medication adherence, substance use, mood, anxiety and sleep quality; and motor data from a tapping task. Primary endpoints encompass model performance for relapse prediction, user adherence, transcription quality, usability of recordings and overall system usability. The primary analysis of user adherence, transcription quality, usability of recordings and overall system usability will be an unadjusted description of the respective proportions using 95% Wilson confidence intervals. Regarding relapse prediction, the predictive value of the risk estimates for relapse occurrence will be assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Exploratory analysis will be performed on potential speech-based markers associated with relapse risk.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This study has been approved by swissethics (Business Administration System for Ethics Committees number: 2025-01177). Findings from this project will be disseminated through peer-reviewed journal publications and presentations at relevant scientific conferences, as well as at public events related to mental health.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT07397975.

title: The Effectiveness of Interoceptive-Based Interventions to Reduce Adult Anxiety Sensitivity: A Systematic Review.
summary:
PURPOSE: Anxiety sensitivity is defined as the fear of anxiety-related sensations and is linked to the top three preventable causes of disease and death in the US. Interoception is related to anxiety sensitivity and can be addressed by occupational therapists. Interoception encompasses sensing/feeling/noticing, understanding/interpreting, and acting upon one's internal bodily sensations. Interoceptive-based interventions are starting to be used to decrease adult anxiety sensitivity. This review examines the effectiveness of interoceptive-based interventions on adult anxiety sensitivity that can be used by occupational therapists.
METHODS: Sources: Ovid, CINAHL (EBSCOhost), PsycInfo (Ovid), SCOPUS. Inclusion criteria: interoceptive interventions, persons over age 17 years with anxiety symptoms, level 4 or higher studies, minimum of 14 participants. Exclusion criteria: written before 1999, qualitative, non-peer-reviewed, not available in English, comorbidities or subtypes of anxiety.
RESULTS: Sixteen articles were reviewed, 10 level II studies, one level III-1 study, and four level III-2 studies examining the effect of interoceptive-based interventions on adult anxiety sensitivity. Interventions examined were mindfulness, interoceptive exposure, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), and combinations of those. All studies showed significant anxiety sensitivity reduction for participants identified with high anxiety sensitivity. Strong evidence supports the use of mindfulness alone and interoceptive exposure with CBT. Moderate evidence supports interoceptive exposure alone. Insufficient evidence currently supports the use of combinations of interoceptive exposure with mindfulness and of interoceptive exposure with CBT.
CONCLUSION: Findings support certain interoceptive-based interventions as effective in reducing elevated anxiety sensitivity. More research is needed to examine the less studied combinations, dosages and types of exposures, inclusion of neurophysiological outcome measures, and assessment of long-term effects, and to explore the mechanisms behind this association and its impact on occupational performance and participation.

标题：基于内感受的干预对降低成人焦虑敏感性的有效性：一项系统综述
摘要：目的：焦虑敏感性被定义为对焦虑相关感觉的恐惧，并与美国三大可预防的疾病和死亡原因相关。内感受与焦虑敏感性有关，且可由职业治疗师介入处理。内感受涵盖对自身内部身体感觉的感知/觉察、理解/解释以及据此采取行动。基于内感受的干预措施正开始用于降低成人焦虑敏感性。本综述考察了职业治疗师可采用的基于内感受的干预措施对成人焦虑敏感性的有效性。方法：数据来源：Ovid、CINAHL (EBSCOhost)、PsycInfo (Ovid)、SCOPUS。纳入标准：内感受干预、年龄17岁以上伴有焦虑症状者、证据等级4级或以上研究、至少14名参与者。排除标准：1999年前发表、质性研究、非同行评审、非英文文献、伴有合并症或特定焦虑亚型。结果：共纳入16篇文章，包括10项II级研究、1项III-1级研究和4项III-2级研究，考察基于内感受的干预对成人焦虑敏感性的影响。所考察的干预包括正念、内感受暴露、认知行为疗法（CBT）及其组合。所有研究均显示，对于被识别为高焦虑敏感性的参与者，焦虑敏感性显著降低。强证据支持单独使用正念以及内感受暴露联合CBT；中等证据支持单独使用内感受暴露；目前证据不足以支持内感受暴露联合正念以及内感受暴露联合CBT的组合方案。结论：研究结果支持特定基于内感受的干预措施能有效降低升高的焦虑敏感性。未来需进一步研究较少考察的组合方案、暴露剂量与类型、纳入神经生理学结局指标、评估长期效果，并探索这一关联背后的机制及其对职业表现和参与的影响。

title: Coming of Age With Generative Artificial Intelligence: The High Stakes of Automating Adolescent Development.
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly transforming the context in which adolescents develop, presenting both opportunities and risks. Adolescence is a sensitive life period during which the accomplishment of key psychosocial developmental tasks-including social belonging, emotion regulation, autonomy, and identity formation-leads to lifelong consequences. Here, we synthesize interdisciplinary research on how adolescents' use of GenAI chatbots such as ChatGPT may have unique impacts during this life stage. Although GenAI may provide low-stakes opportunities to simulate social interactions, scaffold emotional regulation, and support identity exploration in some contexts, it also threatens to displace or thwart essential developmental experiences. Risks include increasing social isolation, undermining distress tolerance, distorting expectations for human relationships, compromising identity and purpose development, and exposing youth to biased, inaccurate, or sexually inappropriate content. We call for a developmental science framework to guide future research, technology design, and policy. Longitudinal studies are needed-especially those that examine specific use cases, address all domains of development holistically, account for varying levels of vulnerability across stages and populations of adolescence, leverage interdisciplinary and academic-industry partnerships, and incorporate the perspectives of youth. As adolescents increasingly integrate GenAI into their daily lives, we must urgently address how these tools are shaping their transition to adulthood.

标题：生成式人工智能的成年礼：自动化青少年发展的高风险博弈
摘要：生成式人工智能（GenAI）正迅速改变青少年发展的环境，既带来机遇也伴随风险。青春期是一个敏感的人生阶段，在此期间完成关键的社会心理发展任务——包括社会归属、情绪调节、自主性和身份形成——会产生终身影响。本文综合了跨学科研究，探讨青少年使用ChatGPT等GenAI聊天机器人可能在这一生命阶段产生的独特影响。尽管GenAI在某些情境下可能提供低风险的社交互动模拟、情绪调节支架和身份探索支持，但它也有取代或阻碍关键发展体验的威胁。风险包括加剧社会隔离、削弱痛苦耐受能力、扭曲对人际关系的预期、损害身份与目标感发展，以及使青少年接触有偏见、不准确或性不当的内容。我们呼吁以发展科学框架指导未来研究、技术设计与政策制定。亟需开展纵向研究——尤其是考察具体使用情境、整体涵盖发展各领域、考虑青春期不同阶段和人群脆弱性差异、利用跨学科与学术界-产业界合作、并纳入青少年视角的研究。随着青少年日益将GenAI融入日常生活，我们必须紧急审视这些工具如何塑造其向成年期的过渡。
关键词：生成式人工智能；青少年发展；情绪调节；身份形成；数字心理健康

title: Lived experiences, adherence, and transformation in patients with treatment-resistant depression undergoing transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS): An interpretative phenomenological study.
summary: Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) poses a critical challenge, particularly where conventional treatments fail. Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) has shown clinical efficacy, yet little is known about how patients in Peruvian contexts perceive this intervention. This study explored patients' lived experiences of TMS, emphasising how adherence, acceptance, and perceived efficacy were shaped by subjective, relational, and contextual factors. Using Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA), five women aged 21-38 with TRD completed a 30-session protocol at a specialised mental health centre in Arequipa, Peru. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, clinical logbooks, and clinical observations, and analysed following SRQR standards. Four experiential themes emerged: perceptions of TMS, factors influencing adherence, emotional evolution, and reflections shaping the therapeutic experience. Findings reveal that adherence was sustained not only by expectations of efficacy but also by therapeutic alliance, emotional validation, and embodied safety. TMS was re-signified as an integrative experience involving relational, emotional, and existential dimensions.

标题：难治性抑郁症患者经颅磁刺激（TMS）治疗中的生活体验、依从性与转变：一项诠释现象学研究
摘要：难治性抑郁症（TRD）构成重大临床挑战，尤其在常规治疗无效的情况下。经颅磁刺激（TMS）已显示出临床疗效，但关于秘鲁背景下患者如何感知这一干预措施的研究甚少。本研究探索了患者对TMS的生活体验，着重考察依从性、接受度和感知疗效如何受到主观、关系性和情境性因素的影响。采用诠释现象学分析（IPA）方法，五名年龄在21至38岁之间的女性TRD患者在秘鲁阿雷基帕一家专业精神卫生中心完成了30次治疗疗程。数据通过半结构化访谈、临床日志和临床观察收集，并依照SRQR标准进行分析。研究浮现出四个体验主题：对TMS的感知、影响依从性的因素、情绪演变，以及塑造治疗体验的反思。研究发现，依从性的维持不仅依赖于对疗效的期待，还受治疗联盟、情绪验证和具身安全感的影响。TMS被重新定义为一种整合关系性、情绪性和存在性维度的整体性体验。
关键词：难治性抑郁症；经颅磁刺激；生活体验；依从性；诠释现象学分析

title: How Does Brief Mindfulness Training Influence Neurophysiology During Working Memory in Musicians With Music Performance Anxiety?
summary: Musicians rely on working memory to perform but this can be impacted by performance anxiety. This exploratory study examined whether a mindfulness training program would show beneficial effects on working memory in musicians with music performance anxiety (MPA). Twenty musicians underwent fMRI while performing a common working memory task, a letter n-back task (time 1). Ten of these musicians then participated in two weeks of mindfulness training, while the other ten did not. All participants then completed the same fMRI session two weeks later (time 2). The mindfulness group had significantly less neural activity than controls after the intervention in bilateral middle occipital gyri, bilateral lingual gyri, and in the right cuneus, suggesting improved attention regulation abilities. The mindfulness group also showed a significant reduction in activity following the mindfulness training in the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and in the right supplementary motor area, suggesting enhanced attentional and cognitive efficiency. No differences were observed in the control group from pre-to post-training. These results suggest that the mindfulness group revealed more efficient working memory neural processing following mindfulness training. Results are preliminary and exploratory but do warrant replication and justify further investigation of mindfulness as a tool to help musicians with performance anxiety.
