标题：简短正念训练如何影响音乐表演焦虑音乐家工作记忆期间的神经生理活动？
摘要：音乐家依赖工作记忆进行表演，但表演焦虑可能会影响这一能力。本探索性研究考察了正念训练项目是否会对患有音乐表演焦虑（MPA）的音乐家的工作记忆产生有益影响。二十名音乐家在执行一项常见的工作记忆任务——字母n-back任务时接受了fMRI扫描（时间点1）。其中十名音乐家随后参加了为期两周的正念训练，另外十名未接受训练。所有参与者在两周后完成了相同的fMRI扫描（时间点2）。干预后，正念组在双侧枕中回、双侧舌回和右侧楔叶的神经活动显著低于对照组，表明注意力调节能力有所改善。正念组在正念训练后右侧背外侧前额叶皮层和右侧辅助运动区的活动也显著降低，表明注意力和认知效率得到增强。对照组在训练前后未观察到差异。这些结果表明，正念组在正念训练后表现出更高效的工作记忆神经加工。研究结果具有初步性和探索性，但确实值得重复验证，并为进一步研究正念作为帮助音乐家应对表演焦虑的工具提供了依据。

title: Personality trait and state associations with cognitive functioning and variability in middle-aged and older adults.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Personality characteristics are recognized as early indicators of later cognitive functioning, yet existing studies have primarily focused on trait-level trends. How well these between-person differences uncover daily cognitive functioning processes remains unclear. Addressing this entails examining momentary personality states, which may accumulate over time to influence longer-term cognitive outcomes. Accordingly, this study investigates associations between personality traits and states and momentary cognitive functioning and variability.
METHODS: We conducted a three-week ecological momentary assessment study of middle-aged and older adults (N = 183). We used Bayesian Mixed-Effects Location Scale Models to capture contingencies between personality and momentary cognitive functioning/variability. Additionally, we used machine learning (elastic net regression) to identify profiles of personality state-cognition contingencies and individuals who exhibit stronger associations.
RESULTS: At the trait level, higher conscientiousness was associated with poorer working memory and processing speed. Higher openness was associated with better cognitive functioning and lower variability for episodic memory and processing speed. At the state level, conscientiousness was associated with better working memory performance, while neuroticism was associated with variable episodic memory functioning. Extraversion was associated with working and episodic memory functioning/variability. Finally, sociodemographic, health, and personality trait variables emerged as top predictors of individual differences in within-person associations.
DISCUSSION: By investigating within-person associations between personality and cognitive ability, we demonstrate that trait-level associations do not necessarily generalize to state-level ones. Profiles of top predictors of individual differences in state-level associations may be promising targets for intervention, but interventions should be tailored with between- and within-person differences in mind.

标题：中老年人人格特质与状态对认知功能及其波动性的关联研究
摘要：目的：人格特征被认为是后期认知功能的早期指标，但现有研究主要关注特质层面的趋势。这些个体间差异在多大程度上能揭示日常认知功能过程仍不清楚。解决这一问题需要考察瞬时人格状态，这些状态可能随时间累积而影响长期认知结果。因此，本研究探讨人格特质和状态与瞬时认知功能及其波动性之间的关联。方法：我们对中老年人（N = 183）进行了一项为期三周的生态瞬时评估研究。采用贝叶斯混合效应位置尺度模型捕捉人格与瞬时认知功能/波动性之间的权变关系。此外，我们使用机器学习（弹性网络回归）识别人格状态-认知权变关系的剖面以及关联更强的个体。结果：在特质层面，更高的尽责性与较差的工作记忆和处理速度相关。更高的开放性（经验开放性）与更好的认知功能及情景记忆和处理速度的较低波动性相关。在状态层面，尽责性与更好的工作记忆表现相关，而神经质与情景记忆功能的波动性相关。外向性与工作和情景记忆功能/波动性相关。最后，社会人口学、健康和人格特质变量成为个体内关联个体差异的首要预测因子。讨论：通过考察人格与认知能力之间的个体内关联，我们证明特质层面的关联不一定推广到状态层面。状态层面关联个体差异的首要预测因子剖面可能是干预的有前景靶点，但干预应根据个体间和个体内差异进行定制。
关键词：生态瞬时评估；人格特质；人格状态；认知功能；中老年人

title: Noradrenergic infraslow rhythm during sleep is the critical link between heart-rate dynamics and memory consolidation.
summary: Recent work shows that the brain's arousal system remains active during sleep, with rhythmic locus coeruleus (LC) activity shaping sleep architecture and supporting memory consolidation. The LC releases norepinephrine (NE) in infraslow (~0.02 Hz) bouts that gate NREM sleep spindles. Here, we demonstrate that heart rate (HR) fluctuations during NREM are tightly phase-locked to these NE rhythms, identifying the LC as a key driver of very-low-frequency HR variability (VLF-HRV), an understudied autonomic signal. Using optogenetics, transient LC inhibition blunts HR slowing, whereas LC activation produces rapid HR acceleration, demonstrating a direct LC-HR relationship during sleep that is maintained across a defined range of LC activity levels but breaks down when LC activity becomes excessive. We further show that infraslow HR variability is a cross-species marker of spindle-dependent memory processing. In mice, the amplitude of HR decelerations during NREM correlates with spindle activity and subsequent memory performance. Remarkably, human sleepers show the same pattern: stronger VLF-HR fluctuations during NREM correspond to increased spindle expression and better overnight memory retention. These findings reveal a mechanistic pathway through which graded changes in LC activity, up to a critical level, modulates autonomic physiology during sleep and identify infraslow HR variability as a non-invasive marker of brainstem function and memory-promoting sleep. Because LC degeneration occurs early in neurodegenerative disease, sleep-derived HR metrics may provide a scalable indicator of emerging neuromodulatory dysfunction.

标题：睡眠期间去甲肾上腺素超慢节律是心率动态与记忆巩固之间的关键桥梁
摘要：近期研究表明，大脑唤醒系统在睡眠期间仍保持活跃，蓝斑核（LC）的节律性活动塑造睡眠结构并支持记忆巩固。LC以超慢（约0.02 Hz）爆发模式释放去甲肾上腺素（NE），调控非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠纺锤波。本研究发现，NREM期间的心率（HR）波动与这些NE节律紧密锁相，从而将LC确定为极低频心率变异性（VLF-HRV）——一种尚未充分研究的自主神经信号——的关键驱动因素。利用光遗传学技术，短暂抑制LC可减弱心率减慢，而激活LC则可引起快速心率加速，表明睡眠期间LC与心率之间存在直接关系，该关系在一定的LC活动水平范围内得以维持，但当LC活动过度时即被破坏。本研究进一步证明，超慢心率变异性是跨物种的纺锤波依赖性记忆加工标志物。在小鼠中，NREM期间心率减速幅度与纺锤波活动及后续记忆表现相关。值得注意的是，人类睡眠者表现出相同模式：NREM期间更强的VLF心率波动对应于更高的纺锤波表达和更好的过夜记忆保持。这些发现揭示了一条机制通路，即LC活动的分级变化（直至临界水平）在睡眠期间调节自主神经生理功能，并确定超慢心率变异性可作为脑干功能和记忆促进性睡眠的无创标志物。由于LC变性在神经退行性疾病早期即已发生，睡眠衍生心率指标可能为新兴的神经调质功能障碍提供可扩展的指示指标。
关键词：去甲肾上腺素；超慢节律；心率变异性；睡眠纺锤波；记忆巩固

title: School nurses' perspectives on key features of a mobile app to support early identification of adolescent mental health problems: a qualitative study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adolescent mental ill health is increasing globally and in Sweden, with rising levels of stress, anxiety, depression, and sleep problems. Many adolescents do not seek help due to stigma, fear of judgement, and limited mental health literacy. School nurses play a key role in early identification and preventive support. Digital tools may complement relational nursing practices and lower thresholds for help-seeking, but little is known about what features school nurses consider feasible and useful in their daily practice.
OBJECTIVE: To explore school nurses' perspectives on key features and content of a mobile app intended to support early identification and management of mental health problems among high school students.
METHODS: An exploratory qualitative study was conducted using semi-structured interviews with ten school nurses working in upper secondary schools. Interviews were held via Zoom, transcribed verbatim, and analysed using reflexive thematic analysis (RTA). COREQ guidelines informed the study's design and reporting.
RESULTS: Two overarching themes emerged. First, Fostering mental wellbeing: the school nurse as a trusted ally in a complex world highlighted how early identification often relies on relational continuity, trust, and interpretation of indirect indicators such as somatic complaints or behavioural changes. Second, Nurturing minds: the digital dance of support and solitude reflected nurses' belief that a mobile app could support time management, self-regulation, psychoeducation, and accessible communication. Feasibility, however, depended on safeguarding confidentiality, maintaining professional boundaries, preventing workload escalation, and managing the "anonymity paradox," in which anonymity can both facilitate disclosure and hinder safe escalation.
CONCLUSIONS: School nurses perceive that a mobile app could complement face-to-face care by supporting early identification and self-management among adolescents. Successful implementation requires aligning digital features with relational nursing practice, ensuring ethical governance, and integrating clear escalation pathways. Thoughtfully designed mHealth solutions have potential to strengthen preventive mental health support within school health services.
CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

标题：学校护士对支持青少年心理健康问题早期识别的移动应用关键特征的看法：一项定性研究
摘要：背景：全球及瑞典青少年心理不健康状况日益加剧，压力、焦虑、抑郁和睡眠问题水平持续上升。许多青少年因污名化、害怕被评判以及心理健康素养有限而不寻求帮助。学校护士在早期识别和预防性支持方面发挥着关键作用。数字工具可能补充关系型护理实践并降低求助门槛，但关于学校护士认为哪些功能在其日常实践中可行且有用，目前知之甚少。
目的：探讨学校护士对旨在支持高中生心理健康问题早期识别和管理的移动应用关键特征与内容的看法。
方法：采用探索性定性研究设计，对十名在高中工作的学校护士进行半结构化访谈。访谈通过Zoom进行，逐字转录，并采用反思性主题分析（RTA）进行分析。研究设计与报告遵循COREQ指南。
结果：出现两个 overarching主题。第一，“促进心理健康：学校护士作为复杂世界中的可信赖盟友”强调，早期识别往往依赖于关系连续性、信任以及对躯体主诉或行为改变等间接指标的解读。第二，“滋养心灵：支持与独处的数字舞蹈”反映了护士的信念，即移动应用可支持时间管理、自我调节、心理教育和可及性沟通。然而，可行性取决于保障保密性、维持专业边界、防止工作量增加，以及管理“匿名悖论”——即匿名既可促进自我表露，也可能阻碍安全升级转介。
结论：学校护士认为，移动应用可通过支持青少年的早期识别和自我管理来补充面对面照护。成功实施需要将数字功能与关系型护理实践相结合，确保伦理治理，并整合明确的升级转介路径。精心设计的移动健康解决方案有望加强学校健康服务中的预防性心理健康支持。
临床试验编号：不适用。
关键词：学校护士；移动应用；青少年心理健康；早期识别；定性研究

title: Art on Prescription in individuals at risk of suicide: A pilot study.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Mental health disorders and suicidal behaviors are a major public health issue worsened by the COVID-19 pandemic. Social prescribing initiatives such as Art on Prescription aim to integrate artistic activities into healthcare to promote well-being and reduce depressive symptoms. This pilot study aimed to assess the impact of an Art on Prescription program on individuals at risk of suicide.
METHODS: An AoP program was implemented in Montpellier coordinated by the Department of Emergency Psychiatry and Acute Care at Montpellier University Hospital, in partnership with MO.CO. (Montpellier Contemporain). Fifty-one adults, referred after an emergency visit for suicidal ideation or a suicide attempt, were enrolled between 2022 and 2024. The program was delivered through five successive cycles. Each participant was enrolled in one cycle only, led by an artist, and included one museum visit followed by five weekly creative sessions. Depressive symptoms (PHQ-9, Patient Health Questionnaire-9) and well-being (WEMWBS, Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Wellbeing Scale) were assessed at the end of each of the five creative sessions. Wilcoxon tests and Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) were used for analysis.
RESULTS: Among the 29 participants with complete data from the first to the fifth creative sessions, a significant improvement in well-being was observed (mean WEMWBS increase: +2.24; P=0.02), whereas the decrease in depressive symptoms was not statistically significant (PHQ-9: -0.79; P=0.12). In the full sample (n=51), the comparison between the first and third creative sessions showed a significant decrease in depressive symptoms (-0.65; P=0.05), but a non-significant increase in well-being (+1.22; P=0.11). GEE models confirmed a significant negative association between PHQ-9 and WEMWBS scores (β=-1.1; P<0.001), with no significant effect of time or interaction.
CONCLUSIONS: The Art on Prescription program appears to have a positive impact on well-being and depressive symptoms in individuals at risk of suicide. These findings support the potential value of innovative, non-pharmacological interventions as a complement to traditional psychiatric care, aligned with recovery-oriented approaches.

标题：艺术处方在自杀风险个体中的应用：一项试点研究
摘要：目的：心理健康障碍和自杀行为是一个重大的公共卫生问题，且因COVID-19大流行而进一步加剧。社会处方倡议（如“艺术处方”）旨在将艺术活动融入医疗保健，以促进幸福感并减轻抑郁症状。本试点研究旨在评估“艺术处方”项目对自杀风险个体的影响。方法：在蒙彼利埃实施了一项艺术处方项目，由蒙彼利埃大学医院急诊精神病学与急性期监护科与MO.CO.（蒙彼利埃当代艺术中心）合作协调。研究对象为2022年至2024年间因自杀意念或自杀未遂急诊就诊后转介的51名成年人。该项目分五个连续周期实施，每名参与者仅参加一个周期，由一名艺术家带领，内容包括一次博物馆参观及随后五次每周创意工作坊。在五次创意工作坊每次结束时评估抑郁症状（PHQ-9，患者健康问卷-9）和幸福感（WEMWBS，沃里克-爱丁堡心理健康幸福感量表）。采用Wilcoxon检验和广义估计方程（GEE）进行数据分析。结果：在拥有从第一次到第五次创意工作坊完整数据的29名参与者中，幸福感显著改善（WEMWBS平均增加：+2.24；P=0.02），而抑郁症状的下降未达到统计学显著性（PHQ-9：-0.79；P=0.12）。在全样本（n=51）中，第一次与第三次创意工作坊的比较显示抑郁症状显著下降（-0.65；P=0.05），但幸福感增加不显著（+1.22；P=0.11）。GEE模型确认PHQ-9与WEMWBS评分之间存在显著的负向关联（β=-1.1；P<0.001），时间效应及交互作用不显著。结论：艺术处方项目对自杀风险个体的幸福感和抑郁症状具有积极影响。这些发现支持创新性非药物干预作为传统精神科护理补充手段的潜在价值，符合以康复为导向的治疗理念。
关键词：艺术处方；自杀风险；幸福感；抑郁症状；社会处方

title: Primary care brief mindfulness training for veterans with psychological distress: Protocol for a hybrid type I effectiveness-implementation randomized controlled trial.
summary: Psychological distress, encompassing PTSD, depression, and anxiety-is highly prevalent among Veterans receiving care in Veterans Health Administration (VHA) primary care settings, yet it frequently goes untreated or undertreated. Traditional psychotherapies and psychiatric medications are often misaligned with Veterans' preferences for self-reliance, low-stigma formats, and skill-based approaches. Primary Care Brief Mindfulness Training (PCBMT) was developed as a brief, transdiagnostic, group-based mindfulness intervention co-facilitated by licensed mental health providers and Veteran peer specialists in VHA primary care. Two preliminary randomized controlled trials (RCTs) demonstrated reductions in PTSD and depression severity relative to control conditions. An ongoing study extends this work through a Hybrid Type I effectiveness-implementation trial at three geographically and demographically diverse VHA sites (Phoenix, San Diego, St. Louis). Three hundred primary care patients with clinically significant psychological distress are being randomized 1:1 to PCBMT or Moving Forward (MF), a transdiagnostic problem-solving group that serves as an active comparison condition. The primary outcome is change in total psychological distress as measured by the Depression Anxiety and Stress Scale (DASS-21) from baseline to post-intervention (8 weeks). Secondary aims will test transdiagnostic mediators (mindfulness, emotion regulation, psychological flexibility, thought suppression) and explore social determinants of health (SDOH) as potential moderators of initiation, completion, and clinical benefit. A qualitative implementation aim, guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR), will characterize barriers and facilitators to support future scale-up. This protocol describes participant selection criteria, intervention conditions, facilitator training, outcome measurement, and analytic strategy. Trial Registration:ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT-06162741.

标题：基层医疗简式正念训练用于心理困扰退伍军人：一项混合I型有效性-实施随机对照试验方案
摘要：心理困扰——包括创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、抑郁和焦虑——在退伍军人健康管理局（VHA）基层医疗机构就诊的退伍军人中高度普遍，但往往未得到治疗或治疗不足。传统心理治疗和精神科药物常常与退伍军人对自力更生、低污名化形式和基于技能的方法的偏好不一致。基层医疗简式正念训练（PCBMT）被开发为一种简短的、跨诊断的、以团体为基础的正念干预，由持证心理健康服务提供者和退伍军人同伴专家在VHA基层医疗中共同实施。两项初步随机对照试验（RCT）表明，与对照条件相比，PCBMT可减轻PTSD和抑郁严重程度。一项正在进行的研究通过混合I型有效性-实施试验在三个地域和人口统计学多样化的VHA站点（菲尼克斯、圣地亚哥、圣路易斯）扩展了这项工作。三百名具有临床显著心理困扰的基层医疗患者正在按1：1随机分配接受PCBMT或Moving Forward（MF）——一种作为主动对照条件的跨诊断问题解决团体。主要结局指标是从基线到干预后（8周）由抑郁焦虑压力量表（DASS-21）测量的总体心理困扰变化。次要目标将检验跨诊断中介变量（正念、情绪调节、心理灵活性、思维抑制），并探索健康的社会决定因素（SDOH）作为启动、完成和临床获益的潜在调节变量。一项由实施研究综合框架（CFIR）指导的定性实施目标将描述支持未来推广的障碍和促进因素。本方案描述了参与者选择标准、干预条件、引导者培训、结局测量和分析策略。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT-06162741。
关键词：正念训练；心理困扰；退伍军人；基层医疗；随机对照试验

title: Effects of circle dance (CircleCare) on the physical and mental health of women caregivers of older adults with Alzheimer's disease: a randomized controlled study.
summary: Dancing can be an alternative to traditional intervention programs for caregivers. This study aims to examine the effects of the Brazilian Circle Dance Program (CircleCare) on the physical and mental health of family caregivers of older adults with Alzheimer's disease (AD). Twenty-five caregivers over the age of 50 were randomized into an Intervention Group (IG, n = 13, CircleCare, 60 min, 2x/week for 12 weeks) and a Control Group (CG, n = 12, without intervention). Physical health was assessed using measures of functional mobility, walking speed, and lower limb strength. Mental health was assessed using measures of cognition, caregiver burden, perceived stress, depressive symptoms, and quality of life. Frailty was assessed using the frailty phenotype. The Statistical analysis was performed using two-way repeated-measures ANOVA (significance level 5%). Only the IG shows improvements in functional mobility (p < 0.001), burden (p = 0.001), stress level (p = 0.045) and contribution to a transition from pre-frail to non-frail. However, CircleCare was not sufficient to induce applied responses concerning walking speed, lower limb strength, cognition and quality of life. CircleCare can be considered as an intervention option for caregivers of older people with AD, especially middle-aged and older women, as it was effective in improving functional mobility, burden, stress level and contributed to the transition from pre-frailty to non-frailty. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Number NCT03081533. Registered 2 March 2017, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03081533.

标题：圆圈舞（CircleCare）对阿尔茨海默病老人女性照护者身心健康的影响：一项随机对照研究
摘要：舞蹈可作为照护者传统干预项目的替代方案。本研究旨在探讨巴西圆圈舞项目（CircleCare）对阿尔茨海默病（AD）老人家庭照护者身心健康的影响。25名50岁以上照护者被随机分为干预组（IG，n=13，CircleCare，60分钟，每周2次，持续12周）和对照组（CG，n=12，无干预）。身体健康通过功能性移动能力、步行速度和下肢力量进行评估。心理健康通过认知、照护负担、感知压力、抑郁症状和生活质量进行评估。衰弱采用衰弱表型评估。统计分析采用双因素重复测量方差分析（显著性水平5%）。仅干预组在功能性移动能力（p<0.001）、照护负担（p=0.001）、压力水平（p=0.045）方面有所改善，并促进了从衰弱前状态向非衰弱状态的转变。然而，CircleCare不足以诱导步行速度、下肢力量、认知和生活质量方面的应用性反应。CircleCare可被视为AD老人照护者的一种干预选择，尤其是中老年女性照护者，因其在改善功能性移动能力、照护负担、压力水平方面有效，并有助于从衰弱前状态向非衰弱状态转变。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov编号NCT03081533。注册日期：2017年3月2日，https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03081533。

title: Affect and pleasure in social contexts among patients with schizophrenia and negative symptoms: An ecological momentary assessment study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Social anhedonia is an essential part of schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSD), as well as a part of the negative symptom domain. Ecological momentary assessment (EMA) has emerged as a valuable method for assessing momentary emotional experiences in daily life of patients with negative symptoms, while minimizing retrospective reporting bias. However, few EMA studies have examined how patients with SSD and negative symptoms experience social contexts, and findings are inconsistent. The present study aimed to extend this line of research by examining associations between social context and positive affect, negative affect, and pleasure in patients with SSD and prominent negative symptoms.
METHODS: Twenty-six participants with SSD completed one week of EMA assessments. Repeated momentary ratings of social context, affect, and pleasure were collected, and multilevel analyses were conducted to examine within-person associations between social context and emotional experience.
RESULTS: Participants reported significantly greater positive affect in social contexts compared to non-social contexts. In contrast, social context was not significantly associated with negative affect or consummatory pleasure. Time lagged analyses of experienced affect following a social context were not significant, and social context did not moderate the association between anticipatory and consummatory pleasure.
CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that patients with SSD and prominent negative symptoms experience greater positive affect in social contexts compared to being alone, without corresponding increases in consummatory pleasure, highlighting a potential dissociation between affective and hedonic processes in daily social experiences.

标题：精神分裂症伴阴性症状患者社会情境中的情感与快感体验：一项生态瞬时评估研究
摘要：背景：社会快感缺失是精神分裂症谱系障碍（SSD）的核心组成部分，也是阴性症状域的重要方面。生态瞬时评估（EMA）已成为评估阴性症状患者日常生活中瞬时情绪体验的有效方法，同时能最大程度减少回顾性报告偏倚。然而，少有EMA研究探讨SSD伴阴性症状患者如何体验社会情境，且研究结果不一致。本研究旨在通过考察社会情境与SSD伴显著阴性症状患者的积极情感、消极情感及快感之间的关联，拓展该研究方向。方法：26名SSD参与者完成了一周的EMA评估。收集社会情境、情感和快感的重复瞬时评级，并采用多层分析考察社会情境与情绪体验的个体内关联。结果：参与者报告在社会情境中的积极情感显著高于非社会情境。相比之下，社会情境与消极情感或消费性快感无显著关联。社会情境后经验性情感的时间滞后分析不显著，且社会情境未调节预期性快感与消费性快感之间的关联。结论：研究结果表明，SSD伴显著阴性症状患者在社会情境中体验到的积极情感高于独处时，但消费性快感未见相应增加，提示日常社会体验中情感与快感过程可能存在分离。
关键词：生态瞬时评估；精神分裂症；阴性症状；社会情境；快感缺失

title: The Impact of Mindfulness as a Session-Introduction on Symptoms and Alliance in Individual Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy With Children and Adolescents: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Mindfulness is increasingly being implemented in child and adolescent therapy. However, little is known about its effectiveness in individual settings within a clinical outpatient context. We investigated the effects of session-introducing mindfulness interventions (IG-M) compared to session-introducing relaxation interventions (CG-R) and no standardized session-introduction (CG) on symptomatic outcome and therapeutic alliance in cognitive-behavioral therapy using a randomized controlled design.
METHOD: One thousand four hundred and seventy-eight of 90 outpatient adolescents (11-19 years) diagnosed with depression, an anxiety disorder, or a hyperkinetic disorder were assessed. Symptomatic outcome was assessed by the German version of the Youth Self-Report 11-18R at five measurement time points (pre, 3rd, 10th, 17th therapy session, post), therapeutic alliance was assessed by the German version of the Therapeutic Alliance Scales for Children after every therapy session (1st-24th therapy session). Statistical analyses were conducted using multilevel modeling. The RCT was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04034576).
RESULTS: Multilevel modeling revealed a significant decrease of symptomatic outcome in IG-M compared to CG, but not compared to CG-R, over time. A significant increase in therapeutic alliance over time was observed from the therapists' perspective with no group differences. Therapeutic alliance from patients' perspective significantly increased in IG-M and significantly decreased in CG. There was no statistically meaningful change in therapeutic alliance from the patients' perspective in CG-R.
CONCLUSION: IG-M had positive effects on symptomatic outcome and therapeutic alliance compared to CG, but did not outperform CG-R. Future studies that control confounding variables are highly relevant to understand the role of mindfulness in individual youth psychotherapy.

标题：正念作为疗程引入对儿童青少年个体认知行为疗法中症状与治疗联盟的影响：一项随机对照试验
摘要：目的：正念在儿童和青少年治疗中的应用日益增多。然而，关于其在临床门诊情境下个体治疗设置中的有效性知之甚少。本研究采用随机对照设计，考察了疗程引入式正念干预（IG-M）与疗程引入式放松干预（CG-R）及无标准化疗程引入（CG）相比，对认知行为疗法中症状结局和治疗联盟的影响。方法：对90名门诊青少年（11–19岁）中的1478例患有抑郁、焦虑障碍或多动障碍的患者进行评估。症状结局采用德国版青少年自评量表11-18R在五个测量时间点（治疗前、第3次、第10次、第17次治疗 session、治疗后）进行评估；治疗联盟采用德国版儿童治疗联盟量表在每个治疗 session（第1次至第24次）后进行评估。统计分析采用多层模型。该RCT已在ClinicalTrials.gov注册（NCT04034576）。结果：多层模型显示，随时间推移，IG-M的症状结局显著下降，相较于CG，但与CG-R相比无显著差异。从治疗师视角观察到治疗联盟随时间显著提升，但组间无差异。从患者视角来看，IG-M的治疗联盟显著增加，而CG显著下降。CG-R从患者视角的治疗联盟无统计学显著变化。结论：IG-M在症状结局和治疗联盟方面相较于CG具有积极效果，但未优于CG-R。未来控制混杂变量的研究对于理解正念在个体青少年心理治疗中的作用至关重要。
关键词：正念；认知行为疗法；儿童青少年；治疗联盟；随机对照试验

title: Kids These Days! A Cross-Temporal Meta-Analysis of Changes in Emotional and Behavioral Problems of Population-Based Samples Over the Past Decades.
summary: There is a general belief that mental health problems are increasing in younger generations, though little objective comparisons exist. The current meta-analysis examines changes in subclinical mean-level overall symptom burden and shifts in specific domains among population-based samples of youth (1-18 years) globally over the last four decades. We search systematically in PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, EBSCO and Google Scholar with pre-registered criteria. Included studies (k = 175, N = 418,528) use the standardized and cross-culturally validated Child Behavior Checklist with parent-, teacher-, and self-report. A cross-temporal meta-analysis is conducted with data points between 1981 to 2019. Age, sex, response rate, and geographic continent, used as moderators. Meta-regression analyses, with year of data collection as a predictor, shows overall symptom burden did not change in the past 40 years except for some decreases in early childhood (parent report), middle childhood (self-report) and teenage boys (self-report). There is evidence of change in specific symptom domains. We find strong, multi-informant evidence for decreased externalizing problems (parent report and self-report in girls) including aggression in middle childhood over time (parent report and self-report), and internalizing problems (parent and teacher report of boys and girls) in middle childhood. Single-informant changes show varying patterns in subscales of internalizing problems with increases in anxiety/depression in teens (parent report) and somatic complaints in teenage boys (self-report) next to a decrease in withdrawn/depressed symptoms (self-report of children and youth overall and parent report in middle childhood). Further single-informant changes suggest an increase in social problems in European teens (self-report) and a decrease in rule-breaking behavior (parent report). Finally, contradicting results were found for attention problems (an increase based on parent report and a decrease in middle childhood boys based on teacher report) and thought problems (an increase based on parent report and decrease in teenage boys based on self-report). However, the finding regarding attention problems should be interpreted cautiously given declining reliability of the subscale over time and evidence suggesting potential measurement non-invariance. In sum, our results do not support concerns that young people today have more overall symptom burden than previous generations, rather, they show a different composition of symptom profiles. However, an important limitation of the study is that post COVID-19 changes were not studied.

标题：当今的孩子们！基于人群样本的情绪与行为问题跨年代变化的横断元分析
摘要：人们普遍认为年轻一代的心理健康问题正在增加，但少有客观比较。本元分析考察了全球1-18岁基于人群样本在过去四十年中亚临床平均总体症状负担的变化及特定领域的变化。我们按照预注册标准系统检索了PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus、EBSCO和Google Scholar。纳入研究（k=175，N=418,528）使用了标准化且跨文化验证的儿童行为核查表，涵盖父母、教师和自我报告。采用跨时间元分析方法，数据点介于1981年至2019年。年龄、性别、应答率和地理大洲作为调节变量。以数据收集年份为预测变量的元回归分析显示，过去40年总体症状负担未发生变化，仅在幼儿期（父母报告）、童年中期（自我报告）和青少年男生（自我报告）中有所下降。特定症状领域存在变化证据。我们发现了强有力且多信息源一致的证据，表明外化问题随时间减少（女孩的父母报告和自我报告），包括童年中期的攻击行为（父母报告和自我报告），以及童年中期的内化问题（男孩和女孩的父母及教师报告）。单一信息源的变化显示内化问题分量表的不同模式：青少年焦虑/抑郁增加（父母报告）和青少年男生躯体主诉增加（自我报告），而退缩/抑郁症状减少（儿童和青少年整体自我报告及童年中期父母报告）。进一步的单一信息源变化显示欧洲青少年社交问题增加（自我报告）和违规行为减少（父母报告）。最后，注意力问题（父母报告增加而童年中期男生教师报告减少）和思维问题（父母报告增加而青少年男生自我报告减少）的结果相互矛盾。然而，鉴于该分量表随时间的信度下降及潜在测量非不变性的证据，注意力问题的发现应谨慎解读。总之，我们的结果不支持当代年轻人总体症状负担高于前几代人的担忧，而是显示症状画像的构成不同。但本研究的重要局限在于未考察COVID-19后的变化。
关键词：跨时间元分析；情绪与行为问题；儿童行为核查表；心理健康趋势；青少年

title: Loneliness, not isolation, is the missing link between social connectedness and mental health among midlife to older U.S. adults.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: To investigate whether loneliness or social isolation serves as the main pathway connecting social connectedness dimensions to mental health outcomes among midlife to older adults.
METHODS: We examined longitudinal data from 4,963 adults aged 40-65 at baseline in the U.S. national MIDUS study (2004-2014). Social connectedness was assessed across six areas: neighborhood social cohesion, social integration, family support, friend support, social contribution, and community contribution. Loneliness and social isolation (contact frequency) were measured at baseline; psychological distress and depressive symptoms were evaluated at follow-up. Structural equation modeling with inverse probability weighting was used to explore both direct and indirect pathways.
RESULTS: Most social connectedness dimensions showed significant direct protective associations with psychological distress. Loneliness consistently functioned as a pathway linking social connectedness to both outcomes, with the strongest indirect effects for family support (psychological distress: β = -0.032, p < 0.001; depression: β = -0.015, p < 0.001). The loneliness pathway was more pronounced among women, particularly for depression (women: β = -0.023 to -0.020, all p < 0.001).
DISCUSSION: Loneliness, rather than structural isolation, acts as the main pathway from social connectedness to mental health. While social connectedness helps reduce isolation, it does not necessarily lead to improvements in mental health. Interventions should prioritize relationship quality to enhance mental health.

标题：孤独感而非社会隔离，是中年至老年美国成年人社会联结与心理健康之间缺失的关键环节
摘要：目的：考察在中年至老年人中，孤独感或社会隔离是否构成社会联结各维度与心理健康结局之间的主要通路。方法：我们分析了美国全国MIDUS研究（2004-2014）中基线年龄40-65岁的4963名成年人的纵向数据。社会联结从六个方面进行评估：邻里社会凝聚力、社会整合、家庭支持、朋友支持、社会贡献和社区贡献。孤独感和社会隔离（接触频率）在基线时测量；心理困扰和抑郁症状在随访时评估。采用基于逆概率加权的结构方程模型探索直接和间接路径。结果：大多数社会联结维度对心理困扰表现出显著的直接保护性关联。孤独感始终作为将社会联结与两种结局连接起来的通路，其中家庭支持的间接效应最强（心理困扰：β = -0.032，p < 0.001；抑郁：β = -0.015，p < 0.001）。孤独感通路在女性中更为显著，尤其在抑郁方面（女性：β = -0.023至-0.020，均p < 0.001）。讨论：孤独感而非结构性隔离，是连接社会联结与心理健康的主要通路。虽然社会联结有助于减少隔离，但并不必然带来心理健康的改善。干预措施应优先关注关系质量以提升心理健康。
关键词：孤独感；社会联结；心理健康；纵向研究；中年至老年人

title: Maternal Adverse Childhood Experiences and Child Socio-Emotional and Behavioural Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Prenatal Mechanisms.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pregnancy represents a crucial period for understanding key pathways contributing to the intergenerational effects of adverse childhood experiences (ACEs). However, prenatal mechanisms linking maternal ACEs to subsequent child mental health outcomes are still poorly understood compared to postnatal ones.
OBJECTIVE: To review the biopsychosocial mechanisms during pregnancy that may contribute to the relationship between maternal ACEs and child socio-emotional and behavioural development.
DATA SOURCES: We systematically searched PubMed, PsycInfo and Web of Science from inception up to February 2026.
STUDY SELECTION AND DATA EXTRACTION: We included peer-reviewed observational studies (cohort, case-control, cross-sectional) evaluating prenatal biological, psychological, or social mechanisms linking maternal ACEs to child socio-emotional/behavioural outcomes (Ages 0-18); qualitative studies and grey literature were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened studies and extracted data on study design, mediators and effect sizes, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer.
SYNTHESIS: Narrative synthesis was used to summarise study characteristics, mediation pathways and analytical strategies in tabular form. Results were synthesised by type of prenatal mechanism.
RESULTS: Of 2641 records identified, 122 full texts were assessed and 13 studies met inclusion criteria. Prenatal maternal depression and anxiety emerged as the most frequently studied mechanisms, showing some evidence of independent effects irrespective of postnatal factors, but most of the findings point towards a 'chain-of-risk' model, where prenatal mental health interacts with the postnatal environment. Biomedical antepartum risks and maternal-fetal attachment also showed mediating effects, but without accounting for postnatal influences. The small number of eligible studies underscores the limited exploration of prenatal transmission pathways.
CONCLUSIONS: Prenatal mental health difficulties, particularly in interaction with postnatal factors, may play a role in the intergenerational transmission of ACEs. Further studies using robust methods to disentangle prenatal and postnatal contributions are needed to inform targeted interventions.

主题标签：心理健康与数字心理干预
优先级：常规收录
标题：母亲不良童年经历与儿童社会情绪及行为结局：产前机制的系统综述
摘要：背景：妊娠是理解不良童年经历（ACEs）代际效应关键通路的重要时期。然而，与产后机制相比，连接母亲ACEs与后续儿童心理健康结局的产前机制仍知之甚少。目的：综述妊娠期可能促成母亲ACEs与儿童社会情绪及行为发展之间关系的生物心理社会机制。数据来源：我们系统检索了PubMed、PsycInfo和Web of Science，检索时间从建库至2026年2月。研究选择与数据提取：我们纳入了经同行评审的观察性研究（队列研究、病例对照研究、横断面研究），这些研究评估了连接母亲ACEs与儿童社会情绪/行为结局（0-18岁）的产前生物学、心理学或社会学机制；排除定性研究和灰色文献。两名评审员独立筛选研究并提取研究设计、中介变量和效应量的数据，分歧由第三名评审员裁定。综合方法：采用叙述性综合以表格形式总结研究特征、中介通路和分析策略。结果按产前机制类型进行综合。结果：在识别的2641条记录中，评估了122篇全文，13项研究符合纳入标准。产前母亲抑郁和焦虑是最常被研究的机制，显示出独立于产后因素的某些效应证据，但大多数发现指向“风险链”模型，即产前心理健康与产后环境相互作用。产前生物医学风险因素和母胎依恋也显示出中介效应，但未纳入产后影响。符合条件的研究数量较少，凸显了产前传递通路探索的局限性。结论：产前心理健康困难，特别是与产后因素相互作用时，可能在ACEs的代际传递中发挥作用。未来需要使用稳健方法以区分产前和产后贡献的研究，以指导针对性干预。
关键词：不良童年经历；产前机制；儿童心理健康；代际传递；系统综述

title: Parental responses to negative emotions predict neural not physiological regulation in children: Evidence from frontal alpha asymmetry and respiratory sinus arrhythmia.
summary: Effective emotion regulation (ER) supports children's socioemotional health, yet little is known about parental influences on biological systems underlying ER. This longitudinal study examined whether supportive and nonsupportive parental responses predicted children's neural and physiological regulation during negative emotional experiences at ages 6 and 9 (N = 240-265; 48% male; 76% White, 15% Black, 8% multiracial, and 1% Asian). Data at ages 6 and 9 were collected in 2013-2014 and 2016-2017, respectively. During frustration and disappointment tasks, electroencephalogram (EEG), and electrocardiogram (ECG) were recorded. Multivariate multilevel models showed that, at the between-person level, higher nonsupportive parenting predicted lower frontal alpha asymmetry (FAA) at both ages, suggesting a more withdrawal-related neural profile. Supportive parenting was unrelated to FAA or respiratory sinus arrhythmia (RSA). Across waves, at the within-person level, greater RSA withdrawal was associated with greater right-lateralized FAA. Overall, findings highlight that nonsupportive parenting exerts a robust and enduring influence on children's neural, but not physiological regulation, underscoring the importance of emotion socialization practices for promoting adaptive neural regulatory functioning during middle childhood.

标题：父母对负性情绪的反应预测儿童的神经而非生理调节：来自额叶alpha不对称性和呼吸性窦性心律不齐的证据
摘要：有效的情绪调节（ER）支持儿童的社会情绪健康，然而关于父母对ER背后的生物系统影响的研究仍较少。这项纵向研究考察了支持性和非支持性父母反应是否预测儿童在6岁和9岁负性情绪体验期间的神经和生理调节（N = 240-265；48%为男性；76%白人，15%黑人，8%多种族，1%亚裔）。6岁和9岁数据分别于2013-2014年和2016-2017年收集。在挫折和失望任务中，记录脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG）。多变量多层模型显示，在个体间层面，较高的非支持性养育预测两个年龄段的额叶alpha不对称性（FAA）较低，表明更倾向于退缩相关的神经特征。支持性养育与FAA或呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）无关。跨波次中，在个体内层面，较大的RSA退缩与较大的右侧化FAA相关。总体而言，研究结果强调非支持性养育对儿童神经而非生理调节具有稳健而持久的影响，凸显了情绪社会化实践对促进童年中期适应性神经调节功能的重要性。
关键词：情绪调节；额叶alpha不对称性（FAA）；呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）；父母养育方式；神经生理调节

title: Feeling worse, feeling more overprotected: An experience sampling study among adolescents.
summary: Parental overprotection is often blamed for rising youth emotional problems; yet evidence on everyday processes is limited. This 7-day Experience Sampling study examined linkages between perceived overprotection and adolescent affect. Adolescents (N = 143; Mage = 15.8, age range = 11-18; 64% girls, 92% Dutch/Belgian) provided momentary reports on overprotection (intrusion, unnecessary worry, unneeded help) and affect. Preregistered Dynamic Structural Equation Models showed within-person associations between overprotection and negative (not positive) affect. Overprotection was associated with higher concurrent negative affect. Negative affect predicted more overprotection several hours later but not vice versa, except for "unneeded help," which was reciprocally associated with fear. These findings guide future research on adolescents' affective antecedents of experienced overprotection and on when, for whom, and which aspects of overprotection are harmful rather than protective.

标题：感觉更糟，感觉被过度保护更多：一项针对青少年的经验取样研究
摘要：父母过度保护常被归咎于青少年情绪问题的上升；然而，关于其日常过程的证据十分有限。这项为期7天的经验取样研究考察了感知到的过度保护与青少年情感之间的关联。青少年（N = 143；平均年龄 = 15.8岁，年龄范围 = 11-18岁；64%为女孩，92%为荷兰裔/比利时裔）提供了关于过度保护（侵扰、不必要的担忧、不需要的帮助）和情感的即时报告。预先注册的动态结构方程模型显示，过度保护与消极（而非积极）情感之间存在个体内关联。过度保护与更高的同时性消极情感相关。消极情感预测数小时后更多的过度保护，但反之则不成立，唯独“不需要的帮助”与恐惧之间存在相互关联。这些发现为未来研究青少年情感前因对过度保护体验的影响，以及何时、对谁、哪些方面的过度保护是有害而非保护性的提供了指引。
关键词：经验取样；过度保护；青少年；消极情感；动态结构方程模型

title: The Problem of Temporal Misalignment in Longitudinal Causal Research.
summary: A common goal of longitudinal research in psychology and related disciplines is the study of causal effects over time. An often overlooked assumption in this context is temporal alignment, referring to a match between the timescale at which a longitudinal process operates, the timescale at which data were collected, and the time frame in measurements. We present multiple scenarios, representing both the analysis of intensive longitudinal data and panel data, in which this assumption is violated due to time aggregation (i.e., aggregating scores over multiple occasions) and/or systematic undersampling (i.e., measurement intervals that are too long in relation to the longitudinal process). Our simulations demonstrate the large biases that can occur in estimates of lag-0 and lag-1 effects using various modeling approaches, even when there is no effect in the data. We discuss implications of these results and briefly consider future lines of methodological research to address this problem.

优先级：常规收录
标题：纵向因果研究中的时间错配问题
摘要：心理学及相关学科纵向研究的一个常见目标是对随时间变化的因果效应进行考察。在这一背景下，一个常被忽视的假设是时间对齐，即纵向过程运行的时间尺度、数据收集的时间尺度以及测量中的时间框架三者之间的匹配。我们呈现了多种情境，分别涉及密集纵向数据的分析和面板数据的分析，其中该假设因时间聚合（即在多个场合上对得分进行汇总）和/或系统性欠采样（即测量间隔相对于纵向过程过长）而遭到违背。我们的模拟表明，即使数据中不存在效应，多种建模方法对滞后0期和滞后1期效应的估计也可能产生较大偏差。我们讨论了这些结果的意义，并简要展望了解决该问题的未来方法学研究方向。
关键词：时间对齐；纵向因果推断；密集纵向数据；时间聚合；欠采样
